The iteration limit also leads to final validation: a run can succeed if a candidate was evaluated and the retained graph passes. A run consisting only of invalid calls fails with no_evolution_candidate_evaluated.

title.zh: 源数据预览与字段说明
title.en: Source data preview and field explanations

text.zh: 上传 SQL、CSV 或 TXT 后，构图面板即可读取原始数据预览，无需先运行构图。构图完成后仍可展开查看。SQL 和 CSV 可切换表，查看字段、声明类型、主外键、字段含义及示例行；TXT 展示原文开头的内容。读取预览不会启动构图，也不会修改已保存的图或会话活动图。
text.en: After uploading SQL, CSV, or TXT, the construction panel can preview the retained source before a build starts. The preview remains available after construction. SQL and CSV provide a table selector, fields, declared types, keys, descriptions, and sample rows; TXT displays an excerpt from the beginning of the original text. Reading the preview neither starts construction nor changes a saved or active session graph.

rows.zh: 来自可识别的 SQL 字段注释，优先于其他说明。并非所有数据库方言的注释语法都能读取。
rows.en: An identifiable SQL column comment takes precedence over other descriptions. Not every database dialect’s comment syntax is supported.

rows.zh: 解释声明的主键、外键及引用目标，属于结构事实，不等于完整业务定义。
rows.en: Explains a declared primary key, foreign key, or referenced field: structural facts, not a complete business definition.

rows.zh: 仅为常见字段名提供需核实的提示，例如 name、status、quantity、DisplayName。不会据此编造币种、单位、统计口径或状态值映射。
rows.en: Offers a tentative hint for recognized names such as name, status, quantity, and DisplayName. It does not invent currency, units, population definitions, or status-code mappings.

rows.zh: 没有可用注释、键声明或受支持的名称提示时，明确显示未提供；需查阅数据字典或业务说明。
rows.en: Shown explicitly when no comment, key declaration, or recognized name hint is available; consult the data dictionary or domain documentation.

rows.zh: 每表最多 5 行，每个单元格最多展示 300 个字符；TXT 摘录最多 4,000 个字符。
rows.en: At most 5 rows per table, 300 displayed characters per cell, and a 4,000-character TXT excerpt.

rows.zh: SQL / CSV 预览限制源文件为 32 MiB；TXT 仅读取有界前缀，不因整个文件超过 32 MiB 拒绝摘录。响应上限为 4 MiB UTF-8，最多 128 张表、每表 256 列；CSV 表组还检查解压后的总大小。
rows.en: SQL/CSV preview caps the source at 32 MiB. TXT reads only a bounded prefix, so a larger file does not by itself prevent an excerpt. Responses are capped at 4 MiB UTF-8, with at most 128 tables and 256 columns per table; CSV bundles also check total uncompressed size.

rows.zh: 可确定时显示行数；大型 TXT 摘录或只读 SQLite 样本可能没有总行数。样本不是随机抽样，也不是完整数据统计。
rows.en: Counts appear when available. A partial TXT excerpt or read-only SQLite sample may have no total count. These are initial records, not a random sample or full statistics.

rows.zh: SQL 预览另有解析时间、token 数和单语句大小限制；SQLite 读取另限时间与单值大小。full_scale 构图配置不会放宽预览限制。
rows.en: SQL preview has separate parsing-time, token-count, and statement-size budgets; SQLite reads limit time and individual values. The full_scale construction profile does not raise preview limits.

text.zh: SQL 文本预览把 CREATE TABLE 和 INSERT ... VALUES 作为数据解析，不执行上传的 SQL；无法展示的语句或值会产生警告或占位内容。SQLite 镜像只读访问，虚拟表跳过，生成列等不受支持的结构会被拒绝。CSV 可随面板所选分隔符重新预览；TXT 始终显示原文摘录。大整数为避免浏览器精度丢失可能以字符串返回，二进制值不会原样显示。
text.en: SQL-text preview parses CREATE TABLE and INSERT ... VALUES as data without executing uploaded SQL; unsupported statements or values produce warnings or placeholders. SQLite images are read-only: virtual tables are skipped, while unsupported structures such as generated columns are rejected. CSV can be previewed again with the panel’s selected delimiter; TXT always shows the original excerpt. Large integers may be returned as strings to preserve browser precision, and binary values are not displayed verbatim.

text.zh: 预览读取的是保留的上传内容及 CSV 表组结构，不会套用尚未提交的 options.tables 等构图改动。看到样本不保证整个文件可以构图；预览失败也不等于构图一定失败。构图仍会独立检查完整源数据、配置、资源预算及最终结果。
text.en: Preview reads the retained upload and CSV-bundle schema; it does not apply pending construction changes such as options.tables. Visible samples do not guarantee the full source can be constructed, and a failed preview does not necessarily imply a failed build. Construction independently validates the full source, options, resource budgets, and final result.

blocks.code:
GET /api/personal-datasets/{dataset_id}/construction/source-preview
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets/{dataset_id}/construction/source-preview

# Optional CSV delimiter, URL-encoded when necessary
GET /api/personal-datasets/{dataset_id}/construction/source-preview?delimiter=%09

rows.zh: UTF-8 / BOM、表头、严格列数；单元格保留为字符串。
rows.en: UTF-8 / BOM, headers, strict column counts; cell values remain strings.

rows.zh: SQLite 兼容普通 DDL、字面值 INSERT、支持的 dump 事务标记，或 .sql 扩展名的 SQLite 镜像。
rows.en: SQLite-compatible ordinary DDL, literal INSERTs, supported dump transaction markers, or a SQLite database image with a .sql extension.

rows.zh: UTF-8 / BOM；auto 自动识别严格制表符表格否则逐行记录，lines 强制逐行记录，entities 通过 LLM 识别实体和关系。
rows.en: UTF-8 / BOM. auto recognizes a strict tab-delimited table or creates line records, lines forces line records, and entities uses an LLM to identify entities and relationships.

items.zh: 每行成为节点；可靠 PK 决定稳定标识，完整复合键参与编码。
items.en: Each row becomes a node. Reliable primary keys determine stable identities, including full composite keys.

items.zh: FK 从子表行连接到实际引用的父表行；相同列名不会自动产生关系。
items.en: Foreign keys connect child rows to actual referenced parent rows. Matching column names alone do not create relationships.

items.zh: 没有可靠 PK 时使用行位置，并记录警告；悬空引用不会创建虚假节点。
items.en: Without a reliable primary key, row positions are used and a warning is recorded. Dangling references do not create fake nodes.

items.zh: SQL 不连接生产数据库，也不运行任意数据库脚本；不支持的视图、触发器等需预先转成普通表。
items.en: SQL inputs do not connect to production databases or execute arbitrary scripts. Unsupported views and triggers must be converted into ordinary tables first.

text.zh: 普通文本可以是连续段落，也可以一行描述一个或多个事实。entities 不要求表头，也不要求每行恰好对应一条边；必须设置 mode=llm，不能同时设置 delimiter、primary_key、foreign_keys 或 tables。系统按原文顺序将全文切成带有限重叠的分块，发送给构图模型。每条保留关系的两个端点都必须出现在同一原文分块中，否则丢弃该候选。如果某个分块在重试后仍未返回合法结果或明确的“无关系”结果，或者调用失败，整个任务失败，不保存不完整的图。这些检查不能证明模型对关系的解释正确，使用前仍需核对原文。
text.en: Plain text may contain prose or one or more facts per line. entities needs no header and does not require one edge per line. It requires mode=llm and cannot be combined with delimiter, primary_key, foreign_keys, or tables. The system sends the full text to the construction model in source order, using chunks with bounded overlap. Both endpoints of a retained relationship must occur in the same source chunk; otherwise the candidate is discarded. If a chunk still returns neither valid output nor an explicit no-relationship result after retries, or its call fails, the entire build fails without saving a partial graph. These checks do not prove that the model interpreted the relationship correctly; review the original text before use.

blocks.code:
张三就职于星河公司。
李四向张三汇报。
星河公司位于合肥。

text.zh: SQL 入口按 SQLite 文件头识别数据库镜像，其余内容按 UTF-8 SQL 文本解析。默认 bounded 配置将镜像或 SQL 文本导入内存 SQLite；显式 full_scale 配置下的 SQLite 镜像改为只读文件访问。系统从 sqlite_master、table_xinfo 和 foreign_key_list 读取表、列、主键顺序及外键分组。文本只接受普通表和索引定义、字面值 INSERT 及受支持的导出事务标记；SELECT、WITH、UPDATE、RETURNING 等入口会被拒绝。镜像也检查视图、触发器、虚拟表和生成列，不能绕过构图输入约束。
text.en: The SQL loader identifies database images by the SQLite header and parses other input as UTF-8 SQL text. The default bounded profile imports images or SQL text into in-memory SQLite; an explicit full_scale profile accesses SQLite images as read-only files. sqlite_master, table_xinfo, and foreign_key_list supply tables, columns, ordered primary keys, and grouped foreign keys. Text accepts only ordinary table/index definitions, literal INSERTs, and supported dump transaction markers; SELECT, WITH, UPDATE, RETURNING, and other unsupported inputs are rejected. Images are also checked for views, triggers, virtual tables, and generated columns and cannot bypass construction input constraints.

text.zh: 关系比较不仅取决于可见文本。SQL 入口保存列声明类型及 BINARY、NOCASE、RTRIM 比较规则，构建外键对应关系时把父列放在等式左侧，由 SQLite 使用父列的类型亲和性与排序规则。比如父键声明 TEXT COLLATE NOCASE 时，大小写不同的引用可能对应同一父记录；不能在图侧改成任意字符串比较。SQL 标识符可按 SQLite 的 ASCII 大小写规则解析，数据单元格本身不会统一转为小写。
text.en: Relational comparison is not just visible string equality. SQL imports retain declared types and BINARY, NOCASE, or RTRIM collations. Foreign-key matching places the parent column on the left so SQLite applies its affinity and collation. A parent key declared TEXT COLLATE NOCASE can match a reference with different casing; the graph must not substitute arbitrary string comparison. SQL identifiers use SQLite’s ASCII case rules, while cell contents are not lowercased.

text.zh: CSV 严格校验表头和列数，保留字符串值：0012 不会自动变成数字，空串也不会统一变成 NULL。CSV 外键中的空串表示缺少引用；SQL 空串则是实际文本值，可能匹配父表中的空串。直接上传单个 CSV 时，API 可通过 options.table_name、primary_key、foreign_keys 和内联 tables 补充结构；内联表只接收名称、列、行和键定义等数据，不读取外部文件路径。column_types 只是说明性标签，不会把 CSV 字符串转换为数值。工作台配置后上传的 CSV 表组使用随文件保存的结构定义，详见多表输入。
text.en: CSV headers and row widths are validated strictly, and values remain strings: 0012 is not converted to a number, and empty strings are not universally converted to NULL. An empty CSV foreign-key value means no reference; an SQL empty string remains a text value that may match a parent key. For a directly uploaded single CSV, API options.table_name, primary_key, foreign_keys, and inline tables can supply structure. Inline tables accept data and key definitions, not external file paths. column_types is descriptive and does not convert CSV strings to numbers. CSV bundles configured in the workspace use the schema retained with their files; see multi-table inputs.

text.zh: 单元格必须是有限的 JSON 标量：字符串、数值、布尔值或 NULL。BLOB、嵌套数组、对象与非有限浮点数需要在导入前转换。CSV 的 amount="120.0" 仍是字符串，不能直接作为 SUM/AVG 的数值列；需要数值聚合时，应先准备具有明确数值类型的 SQL 数据，或使用数值标量的内联表。
text.en: Cells must be finite JSON scalars: strings, numbers, booleans, or NULL. BLOBs, nested arrays, objects, and nonfinite numbers need preprocessing. A CSV amount="120.0" remains a string and cannot directly serve as a numeric SUM/AVG column. Prepare typed SQL data or an inline table containing numeric scalars for numeric aggregation.

text.zh: 下面是说明性的 CSV 配置：上传文件的表头为 order_id,customer_id,amount，客户表作为内联数据提供。它展示键定义与数据类型边界，不属于电商报告中已经执行的测量。
text.en: The following illustrative CSV options assume an uploaded header of order_id,customer_id,amount and provide customers inline. They demonstrate key declarations and type boundaries; they are not part of the measured commerce report.

text.zh: 行标识由表名、主键模式和完整键值列表生成 SHA-256 派生标识。复合主键不能只取第一列；调换源行顺序不会改变有主键记录的身份。无可靠主键时使用表名与行位置，因此重排行会改变身份，报告会给出警告。CSV 未显式提供主键时，只检查 id、表名_id、单数表名_id 这类明确名称并验证非空唯一，不会仅凭某一列偶然唯一就把它认作主键。
text.en: Row identities are derived from the table name, key mode, and complete PK value list using SHA-256. A composite key cannot be reduced to its first column; reordering rows does not change keyed identities. Without a reliable key, identity uses the table name and row position, so reordering can change it and produces a warning. CSV key inference checks only explicit names such as id, table_name_id, and singular_table_name_id and verifies nonempty uniqueness; accidental uniqueness is insufficient.

blocks.code:
Keyed row:
row_id = "row_" + SHA256(JSON([table, "pk", [key_1, key_2, ...]]))[:40]

Keyless row:
row_id = "row_" + SHA256(JSON([table, "position", row_index]))[:40]

JSON is canonicalized; complete composite keys participate in identity.

text.zh: 构建初图时，所有源行先生成节点，再按声明外键的实际匹配添加边。外键目标的非空键必须唯一；重复目标会导致导入失败。含 NULL 的复合外键不产生关系，非空但找不到目标的悬空外键保留原行并记录警告。列类型与比较规则放在该表首条行记录的 relational_schema 中；后续表示变换必须继续保留这份语义，而不是只保留业务值。
text.en: Initial construction creates nodes for every row before adding actual declared-FK matches. Non-NULL referenced keys must be unique; duplicate targets fail import. A composite FK containing NULL creates no relationship. A non-NULL unmatched reference retains its row and produces a warning. Types and collations are stored in relational_schema on the first row of each table; later representations must preserve those semantics as well as business values.

text.zh: TXT 默认 auto 只自动识别列数一致、至少有一行数据的制表符表格；否则每一行成为 text 字段中的一条记录，包括空行。lines 强制逐行导入。显式 delimiter 可将 TXT 按指定分隔符作为严格表格读取，但不能和 lines 或 entities 同时使用。逐行导入不会凭空识别实体关系；需要语义关系时，在工作台明确选择“实体与关系”模式。
text.en: TXT auto only detects a tab-delimited table with consistent row widths and at least one data row; otherwise each line becomes a record with a text field, including blank lines. lines forces line records. An explicit delimiter imports a strict table but cannot be combined with lines or entities. Line import does not infer semantic relationships; select entity-and-relationship extraction explicitly in the workspace when needed.

title.zh: 多表 CSV 与键定义

text.zh: 工作台上传一个或多个 CSV 时，会打开表结构配置窗口。每个文件对应一张表；检查表名、表头、主键和外键后再上传。窗口按字段名提出键建议，建议不等于已验证的数据关系：仍需确认业务含义，构图时还会检查键的唯一性与实际引用。当前窗口按逗号读取 CSV 表头；不同分隔符的数据应先转换，或使用支持 delimiter 的 API 输入。
text.en: Uploading one or more CSV files in the workspace opens a schema dialog. Each file represents one table; review its table name, headers, primary key, and foreign keys before submission. Name-based key suggestions are not verified relationships: confirm their business meaning, and construction will check uniqueness and actual references. The dialog currently reads comma-separated headers; convert other delimiters or use API input that supports delimiter.

text.zh: 上传接口接收 files 与 csv_schema。csv_schema 使用 version="csv_bundle.v1"，tables 中逐一声明 file_name、name、columns、primary_key 和 foreign_keys。服务器将文件和定义保存为一个数据集，保留原始 CSV 内容。它不是任意 ZIP 上传入口，也不能在一次多文件请求中混合 CSV、SQL 和 TXT。表组至少一张、最多 128 张；文件名和表名必须满足唯一性要求。
text.en: The upload API accepts files and csv_schema. csv_schema uses version="csv_bundle.v1" and one tables entry per file, declaring file_name, name, columns, primary_key, and foreign_keys. The server retains the CSV contents and schema as one dataset. This is not an arbitrary ZIP-upload interface, and a multi-file request cannot mix CSV with SQL or TXT. A bundle contains 1–128 tables with unique file and table names.

text.zh: 构图使用已保存的表组定义，拒绝再用 options.tables、primary_key 或 foreign_keys 覆盖它。SQL 多表数据则由同一个 SQL 文件中的表与外键定义提供。直接单 CSV 的内联 tables 是另一种 API 输入方式，不能与已保存的表组混为一谈。
text.en: Construction uses the saved bundle definition and rejects overrides through options.tables, primary_key, or foreign_keys. For SQL, multiple tables and their foreign keys come from the same SQL file. Inline tables for a directly uploaded single CSV are a separate API mechanism and are not interchangeable with a retained bundle.

label.zh: 查看上传格式与数据集复用
label.en: See upload formats and dataset reuse

title.zh: 固定评测查询集与 DSL

text.zh: set_workload 仅在查询生成阶段接收一次 queries，数量必须等于 query_count。期望答案由源数据独立参考执行器计算，模型不提交答案。冻结后不得修改问题或计划来提高得分；同一计划分别编译为 SQL 并交由 GraphExecutor 在当前图上执行。
text.en: set_workload accepts queries once during workload generation, with exactly query_count plans. The source-table oracle computes expected answers; the model supplies no answers. Questions and plans cannot be changed after freezing to improve the score. Each plan is compiled to SQL and independently executed by GraphExecutor on the current graph.

rows.zh: 根别名固定 t0；沿已声明 FK 正向或反向连接，支持 inner / left，最多 3 跳。
rows.en: The root alias is t0. Follow declared foreign keys forward or in reverse using inner/left joins, up to three hops.

rows.zh: 限定列名，例如 t0.amount。比较支持 eq、ne、lt、le、gt、ge、in、contains、is_null、not_null。
rows.en: Use qualified column names such as t0.amount. Comparisons support eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, in, contains, is_null, and not_null.

rows.zh: 非聚合投影必须符合分组约束；结果保留重复记录。
rows.en: Nonaggregate projections must satisfy grouping constraints; results retain duplicate rows.

rows.zh: count、sum、min、max、avg；sum / avg 只接受数值列。空组 count 为 0，其余聚合为 null。
rows.en: count, sum, min, max, avg; sum/avg require numeric columns. Empty groups yield 0 for count and null for the other aggregates.

rows.zh: limit 要求确定性排序，order_by 覆盖输出别名；校验排序和同分组语义。
rows.en: limit requires deterministic ordering with output aliases covered by order_by; ordering and tie-group semantics are validated.

text.zh: GraphExecutor 只读取当前图，从记录节点、桥接边、属性实体和迁移字段恢复关系行。它不能读取源表或参考执行器答案。source_integrity_errors 还遍历所有源记录和声明 FK，校验记录标识、字段、关系与列语义，覆盖评测查询集没有访问的数据。
text.en: GraphExecutor reads only the current graph, reconstructing relational rows from row nodes, bridge edges, property entities, and relocated attributes. It cannot access source tables or oracle answers. source_integrity_errors also traverses every source record and declared FK, checking identity, fields, relationships, and column semantics, including data outside the workload.

text.zh: 查询覆盖包含关系遍历、可选关系、多跳、值筛选、NULL、聚合、分组与排序。15/15 表示该固定评测查询集的全部查询通过；它不是任意自然语言问题的正确率承诺。
text.en: Coverage includes relationships, optional joins, multiple hops, value filters, NULLs, aggregation, grouping, and sorting. A result of 15/15 means every query in that frozen workload passes; it does not establish correctness for arbitrary natural-language questions.

text.zh: 生成器先按表建立查询池，而不是让一张宽表占满整个测试集。每张表可贡献记录计数、明细、属性查找、排序、分组、空值检查等计划；status、category 等业务类别和 amount、price 等指标优先于纯标识符。主键或外键可以用于精确查找，但不会被当作金额去求和，也不会优先作为业务类别分组。筛选常量来自该列的实际样本，避免凭空构造永远无结果的测试条件。
text.en: The generator builds query pools per table rather than letting one wide table consume the workload. Tables contribute counts, details, attribute lookups, ordering, grouping, NULL checks, and other plans. Business categories such as status/category and measures such as amount/price rank ahead of identifiers. Keys support exact lookup, but are not treated as amounts to sum or preferred business grouping categories. Filter constants come from actual samples rather than invented values that always return empty results.

text.zh: 关系查询沿源数据的外键匹配索引展开，最多三步。生成阶段避免立即折返同一外键和反复使用同一有向关系；有实际可达行时才加入多跳计数或路径明细。LEFT JOIN 另保留缺少关联的记录。选择最终集合时先均衡根表覆盖，再轮换查询类别；最多生成 2,000 个计划。如果无法凑齐 query_count 个不同的可执行计划，会明确失败，不用改写问题文字或重复计划补足数量。
text.en: Relationship plans expand through source FK-match indexes for at most three steps. Generation avoids immediate backtracking over one FK and repeated use of a directed relation. Multi-hop counts and details require reachable source rows; LEFT JOIN plans retain unmatched records. Selection balances root-table coverage before rotating categories and considers at most 2,000 generated plans. Insufficient distinct executable plans cause an explicit failure rather than filling the set with reworded duplicates.

text.zh: 评测查询集有三个来源。options.queries 直接提供固定计划；rules 模式使用生成器的结果；LLM 模式把合法种子计划、领域描述、输入结构、样本和必需覆盖类别交给模型，再由 set_workload 校验。覆盖约束是相对于当前种子计划，不要求无外键数据凭空出现关系查询。显式提供的 queries 仍进行结构与语义验证，但不执行种子覆盖类别的补齐要求。
text.en: There are three workload sources: fixed plans in options.queries, generator output in rules mode, and model-generated plans in LLM mode. The model receives valid seeds, domain context, input structure, samples, and required categories; set_workload validates its response. Coverage requirements are relative to the seeds, so a source without FKs is not forced to invent relationship queries. Supplied queries still undergo structural and semantic validation, but do not have to fill the seed-category set.

rows.zh: 只更换 id 或问题文字，执行内容相同
rows.en: Only changing the ID or wording of an identical plan

rows.zh: 语义指纹相同，不能贡献新的查询覆盖。
rows.en: The semantic fingerprint is unchanged; this adds no distinct coverage.

rows.zh: 空值判断不接收比较值；用 {column, op}。
rows.en: NULL predicates take no value; use {column, op}.
limit=10 with only some output columns ordered

rows.zh: 必须排序全部输出别名，否则截取结果不确定。
rows.en: Every output alias must be ordered to make limiting deterministic.

rows.zh: 用任意等值列代替未声明 FK
rows.en: Using arbitrary column equality instead of a declared FK

rows.zh: joins 必须对应输入结构中的完整外键定义。
rows.en: joins must match a complete FK declared in the input.

rows.zh: SQL TEXT 列与浮点数直接比较
rows.en: Comparing a SQL TEXT column directly with a float

rows.zh: 不支持隐式 float→TEXT 比较；提供明确文本常量。
rows.en: Implicit float-to-TEXT comparison is unsupported; provide an explicit text literal.

text.zh: 冻结前会补齐空数组和 limit:null，对计划做语义去重并复制为规范 JSON；冻结后保存 workload_sha256，每次候选开始及最终返回前再次检查。下面的 COUNT 查询是说明性的可执行计划，可放入 queries 数组并设置 query_count=1；空值检查只统计缺失 amount，不把 NULL 当作零。
text.en: Before freezing, validation fills omitted lists and limit:null, deduplicates semantic plans, and creates a normalized JSON copy. workload_sha256 is checked before each candidate and before returning. The illustrative COUNT plan below can be placed in queries with query_count=1. It counts missing amount values without treating NULL as zero.

text.zh: 独立参考执行器对内存 SQL 数据复制原始连接，保留数据定义和比较规则；对于 full_scale 的只读 SQLite 文件，则核对文件身份后打开独立只读连接。CSV 与内联数据使用无额外 SQLite 类型转换的临时表，保留原有标量类型。同一 DSL 通过限定标识符与参数绑定编译为 SQL，筛选值不会拼成可执行语句。图侧独立执行同一逻辑，两侧只在比较结果时汇合。
text.en: For in-memory SQL input, the independent reference executor copies the original connection to preserve definitions and comparison rules. For a full_scale read-only SQLite file, it verifies file identity and opens a separate read-only connection. CSV and inline data use temporary tables without additional SQLite affinity conversion, preserving scalar types. The same DSL is compiled with qualified identifiers and bound parameters; filter values are not concatenated into executable SQL. The graph executes the logic independently, and the two paths meet only at result comparison.

text.zh: filters、projection、group_by 和聚合输入的 column 都引用源列，写成 t0.status、t1.amount 等 alias.column 形式。聚合产生的 cnt 等输出别名只能用于 order_by，不能放进 filters 充当源字段；当前 DSL 没有 HAVING。COUNT(*) 可用 *，但其他聚合需要有效列。若问题依赖聚合后筛选，不能靠把 cnt 改成某个源字段来冒充相同语义。
text.en: The column references in filters, projection, group_by, and aggregation inputs address source columns as alias.column, such as t0.status or t1.amount. Aggregate output aliases such as cnt are available to order_by, not to filters as source fields; the DSL currently has no HAVING. COUNT(*) can use *, while other aggregates require a valid column. A question that needs post-aggregation filtering cannot be preserved by substituting an arbitrary source column for cnt.

text.zh: JOIN 的方向相对于外键声明。若 orders.customer_id → customers.id，forward 从订单别名进入 customers，reverse 从客户别名进入 orders；反向遍历时仍保留 foreign_key.table=orders、ref_table=customers，不能交换子表与父表。from 是已经存在的表别名，table 是本步新加入的表，alias 为它分配新的别名。两种方向都只能使用已声明的完整外键。
text.en: JOIN direction is relative to the foreign-key declaration. For orders.customer_id → customers.id, forward starts from an orders alias and enters customers; reverse starts from a customers alias and enters orders. A reverse join still declares foreign_key.table=orders and ref_table=customers: do not swap child and parent. from is an existing alias, table names the table added by this step, and alias assigns its new alias. Both directions must use a complete declared foreign key.

text.zh: 私有构图子智能体跨阶段共有 12 个不同工具名：4 个读取或控制工具、7 个单步变换入口，以及 transform_batch 组合入口。optimize_graph 内含 6 类操作，单步入口合计覆盖 12 类变换策略；组合入口复用这些操作，不是第 13 类独立策略。这套工具与主智能体的公共 MCP 目录分开。
text.en: Across its phases, the private construction subagent exposes twelve distinct tool names: four read/control tools, seven single-transformation entry points, and transform_batch for composition. optimize_graph contains six operations, giving twelve single-transformation strategies in total. Composition reuses these operations rather than adding a thirteenth standalone strategy. These tools are separate from the main agent’s public MCP catalog.

rows.zh: 读取源数据结构、当前图数据结构、样本与真实节点/边 ID。
rows.en: Read source/current graph schemas, samples, and real node/edge IDs.

rows.zh: 生成阶段冻结一次评测查询集，不接受期望答案。
rows.en: Freeze the workload once during generation; expected answers are not accepted.

rows.zh: 返回当前图的逐题验证结果、通过数、错误和计时。
rows.en: Return per-query validation, pass count, errors, and timing for the current graph.

rows.zh: 请求最终验收；LLM 模式要求至少一个有效候选到达参考执行器，且当前查询全部通过。
rows.en: Request final validation. LLM mode requires at least one valid candidate evaluated against the oracle, and all current queries passing.

rows.zh: 按列值连接；已声明 FK 遵循源关系语义，其余关系标记 column_join。可选 edge_type。
rows.en: Join column values. Declared FKs retain source semantics; other relations carry column_join metadata. Optional edge_type.

rows.zh: 物化 2–3 步连续 FK 路径；保留中间 node_ids 与路径重数。每步含 table、columns、ref_table、ref_columns、direction。可选 edge_type。
rows.en: Materialize a 2–3-step FK path while preserving intermediate node_ids and multiplicity. Each step has table, columns, ref_table, ref_columns, and direction. Optional edge_type.

rows.zh: 去重属性值成为共享实体，保留源值；可选 edge_type，节点类型不能覆盖源表。
rows.en: Turn distinct attribute values into shared entities while retaining source values. Optional edge_type; node types cannot overwrite source tables.

rows.zh: 拆分多值类别，关系保留 position，源单元格不变；可选 edge_type、delimiter。
rows.en: Split multivalue categories and retain position on relationships without rewriting source cells. Optional edge_type and delimiter.

rows.zh: 候选键须非空且唯一；记录 identity_key，保留原始数据定义（DDL） 与稳定行 ID。
rows.en: Require a non-null unique candidate key; record identity_key while retaining source DDL and stable row IDs.

rows.zh: 删除提出的 identity_key 约束，保留源主键和记录标识。
rows.en: Remove a proposed identity_key constraint, retaining source PKs and row identity.

rows.zh: 执行下面 6 类结构变换；所有候选仍通过同一完整性与查询验收。
rows.en: Apply the six structural operations below; all candidates undergo the same integrity and query validation.

rows.zh: 组合 1–6 个单步变换，整体作为一个候选验收；禁止嵌套，结构或属性变换必须排在 materialize_join 之前。
rows.en: Compose 1–6 single transformations and evaluate the final graph as one candidate. No nested batches; structural or attribute changes must precede materialize_join steps.

rows.zh: 仅折叠恰好两条当前 FK 且无入向 FK 的桥接行；行数据及重数保存在边上。
rows.en: Collapse only a bridge row with exactly two current FKs and no incoming FK. Preserve row data and multiplicity on its edge.

rows.zh: 把业务字段移到当前关联边；可选 target_property、remove_from_node。
rows.en: Move a business field onto currently incident edges. Optional target_property and remove_from_node.

rows.zh: 共享实体保存 value，边标记 extracted_attribute；可选 remove_from_node。
rows.en: Store value on a shared entity and mark edges with extracted_attribute. Optional remove_from_node.

rows.zh: 可选 property、cascade；不能损失任何源记录或声明关系。
rows.en: Optional property and cascade; no source record or declared relationship may be lost.

rows.zh: 反转指定实际边；源 FK 的方向变化受关系完整性约束。
rows.en: Reverse specific existing edges; source FK direction remains subject to relational integrity.

rows.zh: 重命名业务节点/边类型，保留身份和语义。
rows.en: Rename business node/edge types while retaining identity and semantics.

text.zh: property 指 properties.data 内的业务字段，例如 status。data、table、row_index 等内部字段不能当作普通属性移动。非路径变换会使旧路径快捷边失效并先移除它们；重复图版本与相同参数的候选会被拒绝。
text.en: property refers to business fields inside properties.data, such as status. Internal fields such as data, table, and row_index cannot be moved as ordinary attributes. Non-path transformations invalidate and remove old shortcuts. Repeated candidates with the same graph version and arguments are rejected.

text.zh: 图表示可以改变，逻辑源行必须始终能从当前图恢复。resolve_rows 首先核对节点和边的 ID、真实端点以及 table、row_index、data 字段，然后读取三类当前存储：行节点自身的数据、承载桥接记录的行边、以及通过属性关联边或迁移字段记录指向的当前值。它返回独立副本供查询执行，不读历史图，也不从源表补回缺失字段。
text.en: Representations can change, but logical source rows must remain recoverable from the current graph. resolve_rows validates node/edge IDs, actual endpoints, and table, row_index, and data, then reads current row-node data, bridge rows on edges, and values reached through extracted-attribute links or relocation records. It returns detached rows for execution without reading historical graphs or repairing missing fields from source tables.

rows.zh: 相同行标识重复，或 data 不是字段对象。
rows.en: Duplicated logical identity or data that is not a column map.

rows.zh: 自身 data 与 row_endpoints 的完整外键角色
rows.en: Its own data and complete FK roles in row_endpoints

rows.zh: 声明的 row_endpoints 不是该边的真实端点。
rows.en: A row_endpoints entry is not an actual edge endpoint.

rows.zh: 源行 → 属性实体；extracted_attribute 指出原字段
rows.en: Row → attribute entity; extracted_attribute identifies the original column

rows.zh: 关联到错误表的行、实体缺少 value，或值与当前行冲突。
rows.en: Linking the wrong table’s row, missing entity value, or a conflicting row value.
relocated_attributes supplies row_id, column, and value

rows.zh: row_id 并非当前边的关联行，或多个位置存放冲突值。
rows.en: row_id is not incident to the edge, or storage locations disagree.

text.zh: 例如把订单 status 提取为共享状态实体时，查询读的是该实体当前的 value。如果实体仍写 paid，而原节点上留下 pending，resolve_rows 会拒绝冲突，不能任选一份让测试通过。如果状态字段从节点删除、属性关系也被删除，完整性校验会报告源字段丢失。即使当前评测查询集没有筛选 status，也不能接受这种候选。
text.en: When order status becomes a shared entity, queries read its current value. If it says paid while the row stores pending, resolve_rows rejects the conflict rather than choosing whichever passes. If both the row field and its attribute relationship are removed, integrity validation reports missing source data. The candidate remains invalid even when no workload query filters status.

text.zh: collapse_node 对源行有更严格条件：所属表不能被任何声明外键引用，当前行必须恰好连着两条属于该表的外键边，不能同时连着其他边，也不能折叠到自身。转换后的边仍保存原行数据与两个外键角色；重复购买分别成为不同的行边。这个约束针对桥接记录，不支持把任意高连接节点压成一条边。
text.en: collapse_node has stricter source-row conditions: no declared FK may reference its table, the row must have exactly two incident FK edges belonging to that table, and there can be no other incident edges or self-collapse. The resulting edge retains the original row and both FK roles; repeated purchases remain separate row edges. This targets bridge records rather than arbitrary highly connected nodes.

text.zh: materialize_join 也不只保存起点和终点。每条快捷边保留完整路径与中间节点序列；GraphExecutor 检查每一步是否对应当前外键邻接关系，再用路径计数核对该起点的快捷路径集合是否完整。缺少其中一条路径时，不启用这组不完整快捷边，而回到原始关系执行，避免把多跳连接的重复性悄悄压缩。
text.en: materialize_join stores more than endpoints: each shortcut retains the path and intermediate nodes. GraphExecutor checks every step against current FK adjacency, then counts paths to verify that the set for a start node is complete. An incomplete shortcut set is not enabled; execution falls back to original relationships so join multiplicity is not silently reduced.

text.zh: 候选缓存绑定当前图版本，接受新图后才重新生成；失败候选不会改变当前图。重复检查使用“当前图内容＋工具名＋参数”的摘要，因此同一方案在同一图上不会反复消耗查询评估预算。非路径变换先移除旧快捷边，因为节点、字段或方向变化可能让旧路径失效；如需继续物化，应依据新图重新生成。
text.en: Candidate examples are cached against the graph version and regenerated after accepting a new graph. Rejected candidates leave the incumbent unchanged. Duplicate detection fingerprints the graph, tool, and arguments, preventing repeated evaluation of the same proposal. Non-path transformations remove old shortcuts because changed nodes, fields, or directions can invalidate them; further materialization must use the new graph.

text.zh: transform_batch 的每一步使用对应工具的原始参数结构：{tool, arguments}。只有完整组合后的图参与查询和成本验收，不要求各个中间状态先获得性能收益；任意一步失败则丢弃整个候选。连续路径物化可以保留不同快捷路径，但后续普通变换会使快捷路径失效，因此此类顺序直接被拒绝。
text.en: Each transform_batch step uses its tool’s original {tool, arguments} schema. Only the complete resulting graph is evaluated for correctness and cost; intermediate changes do not each need to show a speed gain. Failure of any step discards the candidate. Consecutive materializations can retain distinct shortcut paths, but an ordinary transformation after them is rejected because it would invalidate those paths.

text.zh: 属性实体还可以成为实际查询入口。GraphExecutor 先根据当前图确认该表某列的全部非 NULL 行都被覆盖，且实体值与当前行值完全一致，再建立属性索引，用于 t0 根表筛选。覆盖不全、值已过期或拆词后的类别结构不能缩小扫描范围；执行器不会读取源表补全索引。报告用 physical_plan、source_rows_examined、attribute_index_hits 等字段记录是否使用该入口。
text.en: Attribute entities can also provide a physical access path. GraphExecutor first verifies from the current graph that every non-NULL row of a table/column is covered and each entity value exactly matches its live row value, then builds an attribute index for t0 root predicates. Partial, stale, or tokenized category structures cannot narrow a scan, and source tables are not consulted to complete the index. physical_plan, source_rows_examined, and attribute_index_hits record whether it was used.

title.zh: 正确性优先的成本验收

text.zh: 设 A 为通过查询数，L 为每题多次执行耗时中位数之和，P 为索引准备耗时，R 为预期查询执行次数。成本把索引准备分摊到预期使用量上，避免只测单次查询而忽略预处理。
text.en: Let A be the passed query count, L the sum of per-query median runtimes, P index preparation time, and R expected query runs. Cost amortizes index preparation over anticipated use instead of considering query latency alone.

blocks.code:
Cost(G) = L(G) + P(G) / expected_query_runs
gain(round) = (Cost(current, round) - Cost(candidate, round)) / Cost(current, round)

performance_pass = all_rounds_correct
  AND median(gain) > min_speedup
  AND wins_over_threshold >= ceil(2 * comparison_rounds / 3)
  AND median_gain_when_current_first > min_speedup
  AND median_gain_when_candidate_first > min_speedup

accept = source_integrity_ok AND graph_growth_within_limit AND (
  A(candidate) > A(current)
  OR (A(candidate) = A(current) = query_count AND performance_pass)
)

text.zh: 默认 expected_query_runs=100、min_speedup=0.05、max_graph_growth=3.0。双方全部查询正确时，不直接拿候选与旧基线计时比较，而是执行 comparison_rounds 组成对测量，交替先测当前图或候选图。每组都必须保持查询正确，收益中位数及两种执行顺序各自的收益中位数都要严格超过阈值，且至少三分之二组超过阈值。最终还会独立复验保留下来的图。
text.en: Defaults are expected_query_runs=100, min_speedup=0.05, and max_graph_growth=3.0. When both graphs answer every query correctly, comparison_rounds paired measurements alternate which graph runs first rather than comparing the candidate with a historical baseline timing. Every pair must remain correct; the overall median gain and the median for each order must strictly exceed the threshold, and at least two-thirds of pairs must exceed it. The retained graph is independently validated again before completion.

text.zh: 运行报告记录源数据完整性错误、逐题差异、资源超限和 no_measured_improvement 等结果。最终图全部通过后，具备策略签名的有效候选才可写入 accepted、no_gain 或 unsafe 经验；no_change、graph_growth_budget_exceeded、comparison_query_failure 和无签名候选不写入策略观察。拒绝候选时继续保留当前图。
text.en: The report records source-integrity errors, query differences, resource limits, and outcomes such as no_measured_improvement. Only after the final graph passes can eligible candidates with strategy signatures produce accepted, no_gain, or unsafe evidence. no_change, graph_growth_budget_exceeded, comparison_query_failure, and unsigned candidates do not produce strategy observations. Rejecting a candidate retains the current graph.

text.zh: 接受步骤在运行查询前设置多道检查。参数与图结构不合法时直接拒绝；候选与当前图相同时返回 no_change；节点与边总数超过初图规模乘以 max_graph_growth 时返回 graph_growth_budget_exceeded；完整源记录与外键核对失败时返回 source_fidelity_failed。只有通过这些检查，才运行完整冻结查询。source_fidelity_failed 是协议中的固定错误码，中文含义是源数据完整性检查失败。
text.en: Acceptance applies several gates before queries run. Invalid arguments or graph structure are rejected; an unchanged graph returns no_change; total nodes plus edges above initial size multiplied by max_graph_growth returns graph_growth_budget_exceeded; source-row or FK mismatch returns source_fidelity_failed. Only candidates passing the gates reach full query evaluation. source_fidelity_failed is the fixed protocol code for a source-integrity failure.

text.zh: 正确率使用通过查询的数量，不用自然语言回答质量评分。即使一个候选更慢，只要比当前图通过更多查询，也能成为下一轮的当前图；这种中间接受不代表已经达到发布条件。只有双方全部查询正确时，才按 min_speedup 比较成本。最后一次验证会重新执行实际保留下来的图，避免把曾经通过的候选或模型的结束请求误当作最终结果。
text.en: Correctness counts passing queries rather than scoring language-answer quality. A slower candidate can become the incumbent if it passes more queries; this intermediate acceptance does not satisfy publication requirements. Cost is compared against min_speedup only when both graphs pass every query. Final validation reruns the graph actually retained rather than treating an earlier candidate or a model finish request as the result.

text.zh: 每条查询先预热一次，再取 benchmark_repeats 个计时样本；每个样本自适应重复执行，目标至少运行 min_query_seconds，并受次数与总时间预算约束。报告将样本时间除以实际执行次数，再取中位数，各题相加得到 L。每轮索引准备单独计入 P，参考执行器耗时不计入图成本。结果预览最多 20 行，比较仍覆盖完整结果：无排序时保留重复行，有排序时检查次序和同分组。这里测量的是进程内 GraphExecutor，不是生产 NebulaGraph 的端到端延迟。
text.en: Each query receives one warmup followed by benchmark_repeats timing samples. A sample adaptively repeats execution toward min_query_seconds, subject to iteration and overall budgets. Its elapsed time is divided by its execution count; the median per-query value contributes to L. Each round separately measures index preparation as P, while SQL-reference time is excluded from graph cost. Previews show at most 20 rows, but comparison uses complete results, preserving duplicates and validating ordering and ties where specified. These are in-process GraphExecutor measurements, not production NebulaGraph end-to-end latency.

text.zh: 模型得到的逐题反馈包含是否正确、结果条数、错误与耗时，不包含 expected_preview 或 actual_preview 中的具体答案。完整答案预览保留在私有运行报告中。这样模型可以定位错误类型和慢查询，同时仍由执行器提供正确答案与最终判断。
text.en: Per-query model feedback includes correctness, row counts, errors, and timings, but excludes concrete answers in expected_preview and actual_preview. Those previews remain in the private run report. The model can identify error types and slow queries while executors remain responsible for answers and final acceptance.

text.zh: history[].comparison 保留每轮顺序、双方成本、收益、超过阈值的次数及接受判据。逐题 timing_iterations、measured_query_runs、warmup_runs 解释实际执行次数，不能再把 benchmark_repeats 当作总查询调用数。materialized_path_hits 统计计时执行命中的物化路径，不是新增边数。
text.en: history[].comparison retains each pair’s order, costs, gains, threshold wins, and acceptance criteria. Per-query timing_iterations, measured_query_runs, and warmup_runs describe actual executions; benchmark_repeats is not the total query-call count. materialized_path_hits counts shortcut use during timed executions, not added edges.

title.zh: 领域经验如何改变策略

text.zh: 领域画像支持 finance、academic、commerce、healthcare、social、general。自动识别基于领域描述、表名和列名；描述命中权重为数据结构的 2 倍，最高得分必须达到 3；当第二类也达到 3 且最高分不足它的 1.75 倍时归入 general。显式指定类别的 confidence 为 1。
text.en: Domain profiles support finance, academic, commerce, healthcare, social, and general. Automatic detection uses the domain description plus table/column names. Description matches have twice the schema weight; the leading score must reach 3; when the runner-up also reaches 3, a lead below 1.75× falls back to general. Explicit categories have confidence 1.

text.zh: DomainExperienceStore 按用户隔离，路径为 users/<user>/construction-experience/strategies.sqlite3。经验保存策略类型、结构计数、查询组合、正确性和成本收益；原始数据行、SQL、提示词、表列名及完整工具参数不进入可迁移经验。经验通过数据结构与逻辑行生成逻辑源摘要来去重；报告中的 source_sha256 单独记录原始文件字节摘要。
text.en: DomainExperienceStore is isolated per user at users/<user>/construction-experience/strategies.sqlite3. Transferable evidence contains strategy types, structural counts, query mix, correctness, and cost gains; it excludes raw rows, SQL, prompts, table/column names, and full tool arguments. Experience deduplicates sources using a digest of schema and logical rows; the report’s source_sha256 separately records the raw file-byte digest.

rows.zh: 比较对数化结构计数、查询族 Jaccard 与归一化查询组合；过滤不兼容上下文，最低相似度 0.35，默认最多返回 8 条。
rows.en: Compare log-transformed structural counts, query-family Jaccard, and normalized query mix. Filter incompatible contexts, require similarity ≥0.35, and return up to eight by default.
accepted: 0.25 + 0.75 × gain; no_gain: −0.25 + 0.75 × min(gain, 0); unsafe: −1. Clip gain to [−1, 1].

rows.zh: 先按相似度加权奖励，以 +2 平滑分母，再乘平均相似度，最后截断到 [−1, 1]。
rows.en: Similarity-weight rewards, smooth the denominator by +2, multiply by mean similarity, and clip to [−1, 1].

rows.zh: supported 需要 ≥3 个独立源、接受率 ≥2/3、无 unsafe 且平均收益为正；存在安全失败、no_gain 不少于 accepted 或评分非正时为 cautioned；其余为 candidate。
rows.en: supported requires ≥3 independent sources, acceptance ≥2/3, no unsafe outcome, and positive mean gain. Otherwise unsafe outcomes, no_gain ≥ accepted, or nonpositive scores yield cautioned; remaining patterns are candidate.

rows.zh: 领域先验与当前结构得分，加上相似度加权经验。supported 的经验权重为 1，其余为 0.35；unsafe 证据另有 0.75 惩罚。
rows.en: Combine domain/structure priors with similarity-weighted evidence. The evidence weight is 1 for supported and 0.35 otherwise; unsafe evidence adds a 0.75 penalty.

blocks.code:
policy_score = clip(
  (sum(reward_i * similarity_i) / (sum(similarity_i) + 2))
  * mean(similarity_i), -1, 1
)

priority = domain_and_structure_prior
         + evidence_weight * similarity * policy_score
         - safety_penalty

text.zh: 同一源、领域、策略与结构模式只保留最新证据，重复运行不会增加独立源数量。负反馈降低优先级而非永久禁用策略；相似结构也必须在新数据上重新验证。经验保留最多 2,048 条源模式证据与 256 个模式；写入回执保留最近 4,096 条及仍被证据引用的旧回执。
text.en: Keep only the latest evidence per source, domain, strategy, and structural pattern; rerunning the same source does not increase independent-source counts. Negative evidence lowers priority without permanently disabling a strategy. Similar structures still require validation on new data. Retain at most 2,048 source-pattern records and 256 patterns. Write receipts include the latest 4,096 plus older receipts still referenced by evidence.

text.zh: 经验检索发生在评测查询集冻结并测量基线之后，因此上下文包含实际查询组合，而不只是“电商”这个领域标签。当前构图期间的候选反馈立即返回模型；持久策略库则只在最终图通过之后更新，供后续任务使用。重新执行相同输入会替换该源与模式的最新观察，而不会把重试次数当成新的来源数量。
text.en: Experience is retrieved after workload freezing and baseline evaluation, so context includes the actual query mix rather than only a commerce label. Candidate feedback returns to the model during the current run. The persistent store is updated only after the final graph passes and serves later tasks. Repeating an input replaces that source-pattern’s latest observation instead of counting retries as additional sources.

text.zh: 策略摘要只识别可解释的结构特征。optimize_graph 若在同一批里混合多种 op，就不把整批效果归功于某一种策略；无法提取签名的候选仍可评估，只是不写可迁移证据。候选无变化、超过图增长上限也不记录策略观察。accepted 和 no_gain 必须附带全部查询通过的计数；不满足该条件的观察会归为 unsafe，收益归零。
text.en: Signatures use interpretable structural features. A batch mixing different optimize_graph operations is not credited to one strategy. A candidate without an extractable signature can still be evaluated, but adds no transferable evidence. Unchanged candidates and graph-growth rejections also create no observation. accepted and no_gain require counts showing every query passed; otherwise the observation becomes unsafe and its gain is reset to zero.

text.zh: 经验服务是可选指导。experience_enabled=false 时不检索也不写入；没有配置存储实例时报告 no_store；读取失败记为 unavailable，写入失败记为 write_failed。只要当前图通过完整验证，经验库暂时不可用不会把一个有效构图结果变成失败。报告中的这些状态应与“经验为空”的冷启动区分。
text.en: Experience is optional guidance. experience_enabled=false disables both reads and writes; an unconfigured store reports no_store, retrieval failure reports unavailable, and write failure reports write_failed. A temporarily unavailable store does not invalidate a graph that passes full validation. These states differ from an available but empty cold-start store.

text.zh: 候选最终排序还结合本轮实测热点：search_priority = measured_query_cost_share + 0.1 × priority。前一项是候选覆盖查询占当前总查询耗时的比例，后一项才是领域与经验优先级。transform_batch 当前没有独立策略签名，组合候选仍可验收并记入 history，但不会把整批收益归给单一策略并写入经验库。
text.en: Final proposal ordering also uses measured hotspots: search_priority = measured_query_cost_share + 0.1 × priority. The first term is the share of current query time covered by the proposal; the second contributes domain and experience priority. transform_batch currently has no standalone strategy signature: it can be evaluated and recorded in history, but its combined gain is not assigned to one strategy in the experience store.

text.zh: 完整电商示例使用地区、客户和订单三张表，展示关系基线、冻结查询、路径物化候选、成本拒绝与第二轮经验复用。示例包含可下载 SQL、参数文件和真实离线运行摘要。
text.en: The complete commerce example uses regions, customers, and orders to demonstrate the relational baseline, frozen queries, a materialized-path candidate, cost rejection, and evidence reuse in a second run. Downloadable SQL, configuration, and measured offline results are included.

title.zh: 电商构图：两轮策略进化

text.zh: 10 个节点、6 条外键关系、15 条查询；追踪候选从评估到经验更新的全过程。
text.en: 10 nodes, 6 FK relationships, and 15 queries. Follow a candidate through evaluation and evidence updates.

text.zh: 应用中先上传个人数据集，再从数据集面板启动构图。主智能体的 graph_construction 技能检查状态，并在 ready 后调用 load_constructed_graph。首次 build 使用 Backend 数据集接口；公共 MCP 目录没有同名的 build 工具。
text.en: In the application, upload a personal dataset and start construction from its dataset panel. The main agent’s graph_construction skill checks status and calls load_constructed_graph when ready. Initial builds use the Backend dataset API; there is no equivalent public MCP build tool.

blocks.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:21108/api/personal-datasets \
  -H "X-User-ID: YOUR_USER_ID" -F "file=@commerce.sql"

# Replace DATASET_ID with dataset.dataset_id from the upload response.
curl -X POST http://localhost:21108/api/personal-datasets/DATASET_ID/construction/build \
  -H "X-User-ID: YOUR_USER_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"options":{"mode":"rules","domain_category":"commerce","query_count":15}}'

text.zh: 排查自己的数据时，可沿技术报告的顺序检查：先核对节点与外键边数量，再查看 workload_coverage 是否对应预期业务，再检查 history 中的候选原因，最后比较 experience 的检索和写入状态。若所有查询通过但 accepted_candidates=0，应读取 no_measured_improvement 与成本，而不是直接判断构图失败。实测电商示例保留原始两轮结果；本页新增的小型配置与查询片段均仅用于说明机制。
text.en: When diagnosing your input, verify row-node and FK-edge counts, inspect workload_coverage for business scope, check candidate reasons in history, then compare experience retrieval and write states. If every query passes but accepted_candidates=0, inspect no_measured_improvement and cost rather than declaring the build failed. The measured commerce example retains its original two runs; additional snippets on this page are explanatory only.

title.zh: 构图状态与失败后处理

rows.zh: 源文件已保存，尚无可加载的构图结果；先看样本与配置，再发起构图。
rows.en: The source is retained but has no constructed graph to load. Review samples and options, then build.

rows.zh: 读取状态中的阶段、消息和进度；关闭页面或 HTTP 请求结束不会自动取消服务器任务。
rows.en: Read phase, message, and progress from status. Closing the page or ending the HTTP request does not automatically cancel the server task.

rows.zh: 保存图已可读取。再次 build 会复用现有结果，不会用新 options 重新运行构图。需要比较另一组构图配置时，使用新的数据集。
rows.en: The saved graph is available. A repeated build reuses it rather than rebuilding with new options. Use a new dataset to compare another build configuration.

rows.zh: 根据 failure_code、消息与报告定位问题，修正数据或配置后重试；失败不是可用图。
rows.en: Inspect failure_code, messages, and the report, correct the input or options, then retry. A failure is not a usable graph.

rows.zh: HTTP 等待超时，服务器可能仍在运行。先查询状态，不要立即另开重复任务。
rows.en: The HTTP wait timed out and the server may still be running. Check status before starting another task.

rows.zh: 同一数据集正在以不同配置构图，或并发容量已满。等待现有任务完成后再提交。
rows.en: The dataset is building with different options, or construction capacity is full. Wait for the active task before submitting again.

text.zh: 进度展示实际阶段和已有指标，不代表中间图已可发布。构图期间和恢复检查期间，图编辑会被拒绝；成功后再读取真实 revision 进行编辑。构图结果保存到数据集与加载到会话是两步，详见数据集与工作台操作说明。
text.en: Progress reports actual phases and available metrics; it does not publish an intermediate graph. Edits are rejected while construction or recovery checks are in progress. After success, read the current revision before editing. Saving a construction result and loading it into a session are separate actions; see the dataset and workspace guides.

label.en: Continue from a dataset to analysis

text.zh: 构图文档采用 construction_graph.v1。编辑前读取最新 graph 和 revision；preview 验证候选操作，commit 持久化同一组操作。请求携带 base_revision，防止用旧图覆盖新版本。
text.en: Constructed graphs use construction_graph.v1. Read the latest graph and revision before editing. Preview validates candidate operations; commit persists them. Include base_revision to prevent overwriting a newer revision with a stale graph.

rows.zh: 原始样本与字段说明，构图前即可读取
rows.en: Original samples and field descriptions, available before construction

rows.zh: 已保存图的类型与字段统计，以及源表结构；不包含原始样本值
rows.en: Saved-graph type/property statistics and source-table structure; no original sample values

rows.zh: 发起首次构图；已 ready 时复用现有图
rows.en: Start initial construction; reuse the saved graph when already ready

rows.zh: 同一请求结构，保存新版本
rows.en: Same request shape; persist a new revision

text.zh: 自动构图的候选验收与保存后编辑是两个阶段。构图子智能体在隔离副本上探索，并以源数据完整性和冻结查询选择结果；保存图后的 preview/commit 是用户明确请求的版本化编辑流程。每次编辑先读取真实 ID 与 base_revision，预览成功后提交完全相同的操作。出现 revision_conflict 时必须重新读取和预览，不能只把请求中的版本号加一后重放。
text.en: Automatic construction and saved-graph editing are separate phases. The subagent explores isolated candidates and selects results using source integrity and the frozen workload. Later preview/commit operations implement user-requested revisioned edits. Read actual IDs and base_revision, then commit exactly the operations successfully previewed. After revision_conflict, reread and preview instead of incrementing the revision and replaying the request.

text.zh: 提交成功后，数据集的图版本增加，但当前分析会话仍需要 load_constructed_graph 才会切换到该保存结果。由 get_graph_info 核对加载后的规模和状态，再执行分析工具。构图报告是当前构建过程的说明，不能作为后续手动编辑仍通过旧评测查询集的证明。
text.en: A successful commit increments the dataset graph revision, but the analysis session must still call load_constructed_graph to use it. Check size and state with get_graph_info before analysis. The construction report describes that build; it is not evidence that later manual edits still pass the old workload.

text.zh: 这三种“预览”用途不同：source-preview 查看上传内容；schema 展示已保存图的类型结构和字段统计；POST preview 验证版本化编辑的影响。个人与项目数据集均提供对应 construction 系列接口，项目路径前缀为 /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets/{id}，并按归属校验访问。
text.en: These views serve different purposes: source-preview inspects uploaded content, schema describes saved graph types and property statistics, and POST preview validates versioned edits. Both personal and project datasets expose the construction routes. Project routes use /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets/{id} and enforce dataset ownership.

rows.zh: bounded 配置下可提高至 64 MiB
rows.en: Can be raised to 64 MiB in the bounded profile

rows.zh: 最大行数；超限失败，不静默截断
rows.en: Maximum rows; fails instead of silently truncating

rows.zh: entities 全文字符上限；可调范围 1–4,000,000
rows.en: Full-text character cap for entities; range 1–4,000,000

rows.zh: 语义分块近似 token 数和重叠；重叠必须小于分块
rows.en: Approximate semantic chunk size and overlap; overlap must be smaller

rows.zh: 完整分块数和含重试的模型调用总上限
rows.en: Complete chunk count and total model-call cap including retries

rows.zh: 每个 Graph Engine 进程；每用户最多同时一个构图
rows.en: Per Graph Engine process; at most one simultaneous build per user

text.zh: 关系构图默认还包括 max_tool_calls=24、benchmark_repeats=5、comparison_rounds=3、min_query_seconds=0.003、llm_timeout_seconds=120；bounded 配置下单次图查询最多 10 秒与 200,000 条中间记录。语义 TXT 每个分块最多尝试 3 次，并与整个任务共享 max_seconds；字符数、分块数、调用数或图规模超限会使整个构图失败。两条路径都不会把截断数据生成的图当作完整成功结果。
text.en: Relational construction also defaults to max_tool_calls=24, benchmark_repeats=5, comparison_rounds=3, min_query_seconds=0.003, and llm_timeout_seconds=120. In the bounded profile, a graph query permits at most 10 seconds and 200,000 intermediate rows. Semantic TXT allows up to three attempts per chunk and shares max_seconds with the overall task; character, chunk, call, or graph-size overflow fails the build. Neither path treats a graph produced from truncated input as a complete success.

text.zh: 上述源解析默认值属于 resource_profile="bounded"。API/CLI 可显式选择 full_scale，将源文件、源行、SQL 导入时间上限分别提高到 8 GiB、10,000,000 行和 7,200 秒，并提高图规模及内部查询预算。它不是自动流式处理承诺：CSV 和文本仍会装入内存，只有 SQLite 镜像改为只读文件访问。HTTP 构图仍将 max_seconds 限在 1–3,600 秒，整体截止时间优先于较长的内部预算；CLI 的 full_scale 范围另行处理。部署资源和入口限制也可能先达到上限。
text.en: The source defaults above belong to resource_profile="bounded". API/CLI callers may explicitly select full_scale, raising source limits to 8 GiB, 10,000,000 rows, and 7,200 seconds for SQL import, with larger graph and internal-query budgets. This does not promise automatic streaming: CSV and text still load into memory; only SQLite images use read-only file access. HTTP construction still limits max_seconds to 1–3,600 seconds, and the overall deadline takes precedence over longer internal budgets; the CLI handles full_scale separately. Deployment resources and entry-point limits may impose lower practical bounds.

rows.zh: 执行参数、是否调用模型及模型身份。
rows.en: Execution configuration, whether a model was used, and model identity.

rows.zh: 源结构、领域类别与置信度。
rows.en: Source structure, domain category, and confidence.

rows.zh: 冻结的业务问题、DSL、评测查询集校验值及覆盖信息。
rows.en: Frozen questions, DSL plans, workload checksum, and coverage.

rows.zh: 逐题正确性、错误、答案预览与时间测量。
rows.en: Per-query correctness, errors, answer previews, and timings.

rows.zh: 候选工具参数、策略、接受状态、失败原因及当前/候选成本。
rows.en: Candidate arguments, strategy, acceptance, failure reasons, and incumbent/candidate costs.

rows.zh: 匹配上下文、检索证据、候选优先级、写入结果与更新后评分。
rows.en: Matched context, retrieved evidence, candidate priorities, write results, and updated policy scores.

rows.zh: 图规模、成本收益与各阶段耗时。
rows.en: Graph size, cost gains, and phase timings.

text.zh: evolution-report.json 使用 tabular_evolution.v1 描述一次构图。上表中的固定评测查询、基线、候选历史与策略经验适用于关系构图路径；语义 TXT 使用 construction_kind=text_entities 和 semantic_extraction 记录分块抽取情况，不执行同一套 SQL 对照评测。图版本与报告由 Graph Engine 保存，领域经验按执行路径记录；用户另行选择何时把保存结果加载到分析会话。
text.en: evolution-report.json uses tabular_evolution.v1 to describe a build. The frozen queries, baseline, candidate history, and strategy experience listed above apply to the relational path. Semantic TXT reports construction_kind=text_entities and semantic_extraction for chunked extraction rather than running the same SQL-reference evaluation. Graph Engine saves revisions and reports, with experience recorded according to the path. Users separately choose when to load the saved result into a session.

rows.zh: 冻结计划数量，显式 queries 长度必须匹配。
rows.en: Frozen-plan count; supplied queries must match.

rows.zh: LLM 演化响应轮数；rules 模式限制已尝试候选数。
rows.en: LLM evolution responses; limits attempted candidates in rules mode.

rows.zh: 评测查询集生成与演化共享的模型工具调用预算。
rows.en: Model tool-call budget shared across generation and evolution.

rows.zh: 模型冻结合法评测查询集的响应尝试次数。
rows.en: Model-response attempts to freeze a valid workload.

rows.zh: 每条图查询的计时样本数；每个样本可能重复执行多次。
rows.en: Timing samples per graph query; each sample may execute the query repeatedly.

rows.zh: 每表向构图模型提供的样本数；不改变前端源数据预览固定的 5 行上限。
rows.en: Samples per table sent to the construction model; does not change the source preview’s fixed five-row cap.

rows.zh: 摊销索引准备成本时的预期运行次数。
rows.en: Expected runs for amortizing preparation cost.

rows.zh: 单次模型请求上限，同时受总剩余时间限制。
rows.en: Per-request timeout, also bounded by remaining total time.

rows.zh: HTTP 构图入口的整个任务时间上限；环境可调整默认值。
rows.en: Overall task deadline for the HTTP build endpoint; deployment settings can change the default.

rows.zh: 全部正确时所需成本改善比例。
rows.en: Required cost gain when all queries are correct.

rows.zh: 相对初始节点与边总数的最大倍数。
rows.en: Maximum multiple of initial nodes plus edges.

rows.zh: 最多检索的领域策略记录数。
跨构图经验检索与写入开关。
rows.en: Enable cross-build experience reads and writes.

rows.zh: 当前图与候选图交替顺序的成对比较轮数。
rows.en: Paired comparison rounds with alternating current/candidate order.

rows.zh: 每个计时样本的目标执行秒数；仍受实际次数和截止时间约束。
rows.en: Target seconds per timing sample, still bounded by iteration and deadline limits.

text.zh: 显式 options 优先于对应 GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION_<字段大写> 环境变量，最后使用默认值。query_count 等计数必须为真正的整数，布尔值不能冒充 1；超时和比例要求有限数值并落在允许区间。mode 只能为 llm 或 rules；domain_category 支持 auto 与六个领域类别。源文件大小、行数和 SQL 导入时间属于单独的源解析选项，不要把任意配置名称都推导成可用环境变量。
text.en: Explicit options override corresponding GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION_<UPPERCASE_FIELD> variables, followed by defaults. Counts require actual integers; booleans do not stand in for 1. Timeouts and ratios must be finite and within range. mode is llm or rules; domain_category accepts auto and six domains. Source byte, row, and SQL-import limits are separate parsing options; not every arbitrary setting has an environment-variable equivalent.

text.zh: 总时间预算通过上下文局部的 deadline 向下传递。嵌套解析、变换和查询使用更早的截止时间；长序列扫描在进入、每 1,024 项和结束时检查。单次模型请求的超时为 llm_timeout_seconds 与剩余总时间中的较小值；SQL 导入和单题执行也受自己的上限及总剩余时间双重约束。服务模式还有进程监督，用于处理无法在 Python 检查点及时返回的本地代码或网络调用。
text.en: The overall deadline propagates through context-local state. Nested parsing, transformations, and queries use the earlier applicable deadline; long scans check on entry, every 1,024 items, and on exit. A model request uses the smaller of llm_timeout_seconds and remaining overall time. SQL import and queries obey both their own limits and remaining total time. Service mode adds process supervision for native code or network calls that cannot return promptly at Python checkpoints.

rows.zh: 通过最终验证的 directed、nodes、edges；图 JSON 本身不包含报告内容，CLI 不会额外加入 version 字段。
rows.en: Validated directed, nodes, and edges; graph JSON excludes the report, and the CLI adds no version field.

rows.zh: tabular_evolution.v1；含阶段、冻结计划、基线、候选历史、最终验证、配置和经验状态。按阶段原子更新，可用于定位失败。
rows.en: tabular_evolution.v1 with phases, frozen plans, baseline, history, final validation, options, and experience status. Atomically updated by phase for diagnosis.

rows.zh: 用户隔离的结构化策略经验。部署路径由通过访问检查的数据源目录确定，不由模型传入任意用户路径。
rows.en: User-isolated experience. Deployment resolves its path from the access-checked source location, not arbitrary model-supplied user paths.

rows.zh: 包含 build_id、graph.json 文件名及文件 SHA-256，或 failure_code；监督进程据此核对本次产物，不把旧文件当作成功。
rows.en: Contains build_id, the graph.json filename and file SHA-256, or failure_code. Supervision uses it to identify this run’s output rather than an old file.

text.zh: 运行报告的 source_sha256 是输入文件字节摘要，workload_sha256 是规范查询集合摘要，final_graph_sha256 是规范图内容摘要；它们各自验证不同对象。跨构图来源去重另用逻辑源摘要，工作进程回执的 sha256 则针对实际 graph.json 文件字节。不要把这些字段互相替换，尤其不要用“文件摘要变化”推断出现了一个新的逻辑数据来源。
text.en: Report hashes identify different objects: source_sha256 hashes input bytes, workload_sha256 hashes normalized plans, and final_graph_sha256 hashes normalized graph content. Deduplication uses a separate logical-source digest, while the worker receipt’s sha256 hashes actual graph.json bytes. They are not interchangeable; changed file bytes do not necessarily indicate a new logical source.

rows.zh: 模型在尝试上限内未提交合法查询集合；检查 workload_validation_errors。
rows.en: No valid workload within the attempt limit; inspect workload_validation_errors.

rows.zh: 评测查询集与演化工具调用总数超限；检查 tool_calls 与调用轨迹。
rows.en: Combined tool-call budget exceeded; inspect tool_calls and its trace.

rows.zh: LLM 模式没有候选通过前置检查并到达查询评估。
rows.en: No LLM-mode candidate passed prechecks and reached evaluation.

rows.zh: 最终图未通过所有冻结计划；检查 final.results，不能发布为成功。
rows.en: The final graph failed frozen plans; inspect final.results.

rows.zh: 总截止时间耗尽，也可能在嵌套步骤中检测到；缩小数据/查询规模或在支持范围内调整预算。
rows.en: The overall deadline expired, possibly detected inside a nested step; reduce data/workload size or adjust supported budgets.

text.zh: 工作台展示构图状态、进度与保存结果，目前没有完整 evolution-report.json 的专用下载按钮。CLI 报告位于 --output 指定目录；服务部署的报告位于 Graph Engine 数据根目录下 users/<user_id>/datasets/<dataset_id>/construction/evolution-report.json。排查时由有权访问该部署的人员读取对应文件，不应把页面进度摘要当作完整报告。
text.en: The workspace shows construction status, progress, and saved results but currently has no dedicated download button for the complete evolution-report.json. CLI reports reside in the --output directory; a deployed Graph Engine stores them under its data root at users/<user_id>/datasets/<dataset_id>/construction/evolution-report.json. An authorized operator can read the relevant file for diagnosis; the UI progress summary is not the complete report.

description.zh: Graph Engine 为数据分析提供可计算的实体关系表示与结构化证据：解析数据、查询和算法后端、检索索引、图学习，以及并发任务中的版本一致性。
description.en: Graph Engine supplies computational entity-relationship representations and structured evidence for data analysis through queries, algorithms, indexes, learning, and version-consistent execution.

text.zh: Graph Engine 是图驱动分析的表示与计算层。智能体提出具体证据需求，Graph Engine 按工具参数访问当前图或指定数据集，执行查询、算法或学习任务，再返回可定位的对象、数值、结构和状态。构图子智能体在需要时准备或优化这些表示；已有图上的读取、统计和学习不依赖每次重新执行构图。
text.en: Graph Engine is the representation and computation layer of graph-driven analysis. The agent requests specific evidence; Graph Engine accesses the active graph or specified dataset according to tool arguments, executes queries, algorithms, or learning tasks, and returns identifiable objects, values, structures, and state. Its construction subagent prepares or optimizes representations when needed; reading, statistics, and learning on existing graphs do not require reconstruction for each analysis.

text.zh: Graph Engine 对外提供 HTTP 与 MCP 两种适配器。Backend 通过 HTTP 访问数据与任务；智能体通过 MCP 调用图工具。graph_engine 是一级模块入口，graph_data_service 承载 HTTP、图数据与计算实现，mcp_service 负责工具协议适配。它们共享工具规格和资源读写策略。
text.en: Graph Engine exposes HTTP and MCP adapters. Backend uses HTTP for data and jobs; the agent invokes graph tools through MCP. graph_engine is the top-level entry point, graph_data_service implements HTTP, graph state, and computation, and mcp_service adapts the tool protocol. They share tool specifications and resource read/write policies.

rows.zh: 统一入口、工具 JSON Schema、执行策略元信息。
rows.en: Entrypoints, tool JSON schemas, and execution metadata.

rows.zh: 当前图、稳定节点/关系标识、版本切换和派生缓存。
rows.en: Active graph, stable node/relationship identities, version selection, and derived caches.

rows.zh: 资源隔离、读写冲突、排队与调度和生命周期。
rows.en: Resource isolation, read/write conflicts, admission queues, and lifecycle.

rows.zh: 源数据解析、查询工作负载、候选转换、成本验收与领域经验。
rows.en: Source parsing, workloads, transformations, cost validation, and domain experience.

rows.zh: 算法后端、隔离工作进程、训练/推理与模型文件。
rows.en: Algorithm backends, isolated workers, training/inference, and model artifacts.

text.zh: HTTP 工具转发使用 POST /sessions/{session_id}/tools/{tool_name}，请求体为 {"arguments": {...}}。GraphDataClient 注入用户、会话、Run、generation 和操作身份；这是服务间入口，浏览器使用 Backend 公共 API。构图工具另有数据集作用域适配。
text.en: HTTP tool forwarding uses POST /sessions/{session_id}/tools/{tool_name} with {"arguments": {...}}. GraphDataClient injects user, session, run, generation, and operation identity. This is an internal service entrypoint; browsers use the Backend public API. Construction tools have additional dataset-scoped adaptation.

title.zh: 图结果如何成为分析证据
title.en: How graph results become analysis evidence

text.zh: 图结果需要同时保留数值或对象本身，以及解释它们所需的上下文。节点名称、关系方向、边权含义、图版本和返回范围共同决定一条结果能支持什么说明。HTTP 或 MCP 请求成功不等于业务成功；工具结果中的 success、错误、截断标记和作业终态都参与后续判断。
text.en: Graph results need both their values or objects and the context required to interpret them. Node names, relationship directions, weight semantics, graph version, and returned scope jointly determine what a result supports. HTTP or MCP transport success is not business success; success flags, errors, truncation, and terminal job states all inform subsequent analysis.

rows.zh: 已加载状态、graph_version、真实名称与类型，以及候选是否歧义。
rows.en: Load state, graph_version, actual names and types, and candidate ambiguity.

rows.zh: 方向、权重解释、图是否完整、所选算法及多重边投影规则。
rows.en: Direction, weight interpretation, graph completeness, selected algorithm, and parallel-edge projection policy.

rows.zh: model_id、任务、特征来源、输入图或数据集、评估划分及完成状态。
rows.en: model_id, task, feature source, input graph or dataset, evaluation split, and completion state.

rows.zh: 展示节点是否截断，报告 source_results 是否来自已完成操作；视图和报告不改变原始证据含义。
rows.en: Whether displayed nodes are truncated and report source_results come from completed operations; views and reports do not change the meaning of the underlying evidence.

text.zh: 版本与资源调度帮助同一批相关操作围绕正确的输入执行，但不能消除数据缺失或分析方法选择不当带来的限制。例如，有界查询范围内未找到路径不能证明全图不可达，社区分组不能直接证明业务类别，链接预测分数不能充当因果关系证据。后续各节分别说明这些数据与算法契约。
text.en: Versioning and resource scheduling keep related operations aligned with the correct input, but cannot remove limitations caused by missing data or an unsuitable method. A failed bounded path search cannot prove global unreachability, communities do not establish business classes, and link-prediction scores do not establish causation. The following sections detail these data and algorithm contracts.

text.zh: create_analysis_report 返回用于界面展示的 analysis_report.v2 报告结构，不会自动生成 Markdown 或 PDF 文件。需要下载文件时，由 Agent Runtime 工作区工具在 Ephemeral 中生成内容，再用 workspace_publish(path=..., name=...) 发布到 Derived；显式指定带扩展名的 name。这些工作区工具不属于 Graph Engine 的 72 项默认工具目录。
text.en: create_analysis_report returns an analysis_report.v2 structure for the interface; it does not automatically create a Markdown or PDF file. For a downloadable file, Agent Runtime workspace tools generate content under Ephemeral and publish it to Derived with workspace_publish(path=..., name=...), explicitly including the extension in name. Workspace tools are separate from the 72 default Graph Engine tools.

text.zh: GraphData 是只读图容器。节点在计算侧使用连续整数索引，_id2node / _node2id 保存业务节点名称与整数索引的双向映射。边以 edge_index 的两行表示源和目标；节点、边的特征、类型与标签保存在独立数组中。写入流程生成新图对象或版本，而不是就地修改分析中的图。
text.en: GraphData is a read-only graph container. Computation uses contiguous integer node indices, with _id2node / _node2id mapping business names to indices and back. The two rows of edge_index store source and destination indices. Node/edge features, types, and labels use separate arrays. Mutations publish a new graph object or revision instead of modifying a graph under analysis.

rows.zh: 关系的源与目标节点索引。
可选边权；构图属性图保留 float64 数值。
rows.en: Optional edge weights; constructed property graphs preserve float64 values.

rows.zh: 模型输入特征；与语义属性分离。
rows.en: Model input features, separate from semantic properties.

rows.zh: 分类等监督任务的标签。
保留节点/边 ID、属性及构图语义。
rows.en: Retains node/edge IDs, properties, and construction semantics.

text.zh: 属性图可以在相同端点之间保留多条关系。查询边时，端点对与唯一 edge_id 不等价：端点只确定一组候选关系，修改或定位具体关系应使用返回的 ID。通用 append 对已构建属性图返回 UNSUPPORTED_PROPERTY_GRAPH_APPEND，避免把不同关系和属性压缩成普通边表。
text.en: Property graphs may contain multiple relationships between the same endpoints. An endpoint pair identifies candidate relationships, not a unique edge_id. Use returned IDs when selecting or editing a relationship. Generic append returns UNSUPPORTED_PROPERTY_GRAPH_APPEND for constructed property graphs to avoid collapsing relationship identities and properties into a plain edge list.

text.zh: 构造 GraphData 时先把 edge_index 转成 int64，并要求它是两行数组；节点名称与整数索引的映射必须成对提供且彼此一致。特征默认转成 float32，训练/验证/测试掩码转成布尔数组。node_feat 的第 i 行、node_label 的第 i 项及 id2node[i] 都指向同一节点，不能分别重排。边属性也必须和 edge_index 的列顺序对齐。
text.en: GraphData converts edge_index to int64 and requires two rows. Name/index mappings must be provided together and agree. Features use float32 and training/validation/test masks use boolean arrays. Row i of node_feat, item i of node_label, and id2node[i] refer to the same node and must not be reordered independently. Edge attributes must also align with edge_index columns.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np
from graph_data_service.graph_data import GraphData

# Three named nodes and three directed edges.
graph = GraphData(
    num_nodes=3,
    edge_index=np.array([[0, 0, 1], [1, 2, 2]], dtype=np.int64),
    id2node={0: "customer:10", 1: "order:100", 2: "region:1"},
    node2id={"customer:10": 0, "order:100": 1, "region:1": 2},
    edge_weight=np.array([2.0, 5.0, 1.0]),
    semantic_type="directed",
)
# Columns represent customer:10 -> order:100,
# customer:10 -> region:1, and order:100 -> region:1.

text.zh: 上例说明数组与节点名称如何对齐，不代表电商外键的默认方向。对源表构图时，记录节点与外键方向由构图模块决定；手工导入图则应由调用方明确边的业务含义。
text.en: This example illustrates array/name alignment, not the default direction of commerce foreign keys. Source-table construction determines row nodes and FK direction in the construction module; manually imported graphs require the caller to define edge semantics.

text.zh: 图的业务属性与模型特征分开存储。properties.data 中的订单金额、字符串状态等不会自动变成 node_feat。单图学习缺少 node_feat 时使用归一化的 [入度, 出度, 总度, 1] 结构特征；这不等于模型读取了业务字段。图分类另使用约定数据集中的节点类别编号。构图图对象将原始属性图保存在 graph_metadata.construction_graph 中，转换、切换版本及查询时据此保留属性和关系标识。
text.en: Business properties and model features are stored separately. Order amounts and status strings in properties.data do not automatically become node_feat. Single-graph learning without node_feat uses normalized [in-degree, out-degree, total-degree, 1] features; this does not mean the model reads business fields. Graph classification instead uses node-category IDs in its dataset format. graph_metadata.construction_graph preserves the original property graph, including properties and relationship identities, through conversions, version switches and queries.

title.zh: 图的方向与边的存储方式

text.zh: 判断“是否有向”需要读取业务语义，不能只检查邻接数据是否对称。例如，两个账号互相关注是两条有向关系；一条无向关系也可能以正反两条记录保存。Graph Engine 用 semantic_type 表示图语义，用 storage_type 表示边记录的实际组织方式。
text.en: Direction is a semantic property, not just adjacency symmetry. Two accounts following each other form two directed relationships, while one undirected relationship may also use two stored records. Graph Engine separates semantic_type from the physical edge organization described by storage_type.

rows.zh: 分别表示有向、无向和缺少足够证据；显式设置优先于数据结构推断。
rows.en: Directed, undirected, or insufficient evidence. Explicit settings take precedence over structural inference.

rows.zh: 表示单向存储、成对双向存储或混合存储；不是第二套业务关系类型。
rows.en: Single-direction records, paired bidirectional records, or mixed storage; these are not business relationship types.

rows.zh: 原始记录数 / 逻辑边数
rows.en: Stored record count / logical edge count

rows.zh: 前者是 edge_index 列数，后者按方向语义及关系标识统计。
rows.en: The former is the edge_index column count; the latter accounts for semantic direction and relationship identifiers.

rows.zh: 识别自环及重复条目。重复判定使用端点与关系键，不逐项比较权重、特征或属性；构图属性图使用关系 ID，普通图使用关系类型作为关系键。
rows.en: Detect self-loops and duplicate entries. Duplicate checks use endpoints and a relationship key, not an attribute-by-attribute comparison of weights, features, or properties. Constructed graphs use relationship IDs; ordinary graphs use relationship types as keys.

text.zh: 方向解析依次考虑显式 semantic_type、元数据、预定义数据集规则及结构证据。对称结构在没有其他信息时仍可能是 unknown。Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 使用预定义的无向语义。to_undirected 产生新图，并可能在数组中补齐反向记录；计算逻辑边数或节点度时应先去除这类存储副本。
text.en: Direction resolution considers explicit semantic_type, metadata, predefined dataset rules, and structural evidence in that order. A symmetric structure can remain unknown without other information. Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed have predefined undirected semantics. to_undirected creates a new graph and may add reverse array records; logical edge counts and node degrees account for these storage copies.

blocks.code:
edge_index = [[0, 1], [1, 0]]

semantic_type = "directed"   -> two directed edges
semantic_type = "undirected" -> one logical undirected edge
no semantic evidence        -> symmetry alone is ambiguous

text.zh: 节点度与邻居数也不同。无向图中，一个自环对节点度贡献 2，但只对应一个不同的邻居节点；有向图分别统计入度、出度和总度。多个关系可以连接同一个邻居，因此不能用去重后的邻居数量替代关系条数。
text.en: Degree and neighbor count also differ. In an undirected graph, a self-loop contributes two to degree but identifies only one distinct neighbor. Directed graphs report incoming, outgoing, and total degree. Several relationships may connect the same neighbor, so unique-neighbor counts cannot replace relationship counts.

text.zh: 会话中的加载、无向转换、子图提取和回滚改变当前图版本。get_graph_info 可读取 graph_version；list_graph_versions 列出版本，load_graph_version 切换已保存版本。构图数据集另有 revision：只有显式 load_constructed_graph 后，构图结果才成为会话活动图。
text.en: Loading, undirected conversion, subgraph extraction, and undo change the active graph version. get_graph_info reports graph_version, list_graph_versions lists versions, and load_graph_version selects a saved version. Constructed datasets have a separate revision; load_constructed_graph explicitly makes a constructed result the session’s active graph.

text.zh: 算法需要的 NetworkX 表示和实体检索索引是派生数据。按图版本复用缓存可避免同一图被每个工具重复转换；版本变化后必须使用对应的新表示。缓存重建属于图读取，不应发布图版本。大图第一次转换仍有与节点、边规模相关的成本。
text.en: NetworkX representations and entity-search indexes are derived data. Version-keyed reuse avoids repeated conversion by tools; a changed version must use its corresponding representation. Rebuilding a cache is a graph read and must not publish a new revision. The first conversion still incurs a cost proportional to graph size.

text.zh: 版本按会话隔离，图数据存为 NPZ，graph_versions.json 记录清单。普通 save_snapshot 路径按 GRAPH_VERSION_HISTORY_LIMIT 裁剪历史，默认 50；受控 publish_snapshot 路径目前不执行该裁剪。切回旧版本后，新版本号仍在历史最大值之后递增。隔离工作进程写入暂存目录，Graph Engine 父进程检查 generation 与 graph_version 后原子发布清单，并记录 Run、Job 与 generation 回执，避免过期执行覆盖新的状态。
text.en: Versions are isolated per session, with graph data in NPZ files and a graph_versions.json manifest. Ordinary save_snapshot calls prune history using GRAPH_VERSION_HISTORY_LIMIT, which defaults to 50; controlled publish_snapshot calls currently do not apply that pruning. New version numbers remain monotonic after switching to an older revision. Isolated workers write staging data; the Graph Engine parent process checks generation and graph_version before atomically publishing the manifest and recording a run/job/generation receipt, preventing stale executions from overwriting newer state.

text.zh: 图对象、算法转换缓存与搜索索引均以版本为边界。GraphCompute 缓存 NetworkX 表示，EntitySearchIndex 保存创建时的 graph_version；版本不一致时重建。只读缓存的创建不会增加图版本号。请求应先读取实际 graph_version，再把该值记录在实验或分析结果中，避免把不同版本的指标直接比较。
text.en: Graph objects, algorithm conversions, and search indexes are version-bound. GraphCompute caches the NetworkX representation and EntitySearchIndex retains its creation graph_version, rebuilding when versions differ. Creating a read cache does not increment graph_version. Read the actual version before recording an experiment or comparing results across runs.

text.zh: 构图修订号 revision、会话 graph_version 与运行 execution_generation 各自解决不同问题：revision 防止数据集编辑覆盖较新的修改；graph_version 选择算法输入；execution_generation 防止已停止的旧运行回写结果。只提供其中一个编号，不能替代其他两类校验。
text.en: Construction revision, session graph_version, and execution_generation serve different purposes. revision protects dataset edits from stale overwrites; graph_version selects algorithm input; execution_generation prevents a stopped, older run from writing results. One identifier cannot substitute for the other checks.

rows.zh: 最短路径 / 接近中心性
平行边取最小代价，路径结果按节点序列区分。
rows.en: Use the minimum parallel-edge cost; paths are distinguished by node sequence.

rows.zh: 最大流 / s-t 最小割
同一方向平行边的容量累加。
rows.en: Sum capacities for parallel edges in the same direction.

rows.zh: 按无向端点对保留最小权重。
rows.en: Keep the minimum weight for each undirected pair.

rows.zh: 明确拒绝，避免隐式丢失关系语义。
rows.en: Reject rather than silently discard relationship semantics.

text.zh: 边权必须是有限数值，布尔值和非数值不能作为合法权重。不同算法对权重的意义不同：路径使用代价，流/割使用容量，社区和部分中心性使用强度；调用前应先明确业务解释。
text.en: Weights must be finite numeric values; booleans and nonnumeric values are invalid. Their meaning depends on the algorithm: path cost, flow/cut capacity, or strength for communities and some centralities. Establish the business interpretation before calling a tool.

text.zh: 转换到 NetworkX 时，普通图沿用简单图表示；构图属性图若同一端点间存在不同关系标识，则使用 MultiGraph 或 MultiDiGraph。无向图同一业务关系的反向存储副本会去重。业务 edge_id 保存在属性中，NetworkX 的内部多重边键使用边索引，因此二者不能混用。
text.en: NetworkX conversion retains simple graph representations for ordinary graphs. Constructed property graphs use MultiGraph or MultiDiGraph when endpoints have distinct relationship identifiers. Reverse storage copies of the same undirected relationship are deduplicated. Business edge_id remains in attributes while NetworkX multiedge keys use edge indices; the two identifiers are not interchangeable.

text.zh: 假设 A→B 有两条平行边，权重分别为 2 和 5。最短路径把它们解释为两个可选代价，投影后使用 2；最大流把它们解释为并行容量，合计为 7。这两种结果都遵循各自的算法定义。调用方必须先确定权重含义，再选择工具，不能把交易金额默认当作距离。
text.en: Suppose A→B has parallel edges weighted 2 and 5. Shortest paths interpret them as alternative costs and use 2 after projection. Maximum flow interprets them as parallel capacity and uses 7. Both follow their algorithm definitions. Establish what the weight means before choosing a tool; a transaction amount is not automatically a distance.

text.zh: 未声明多重图策略的方法返回 UNSUPPORTED_MULTIGRAPH_OPERATION。参数组合也参与检查：社区发现只批准了部分算法，子图提取中的 ego_graph 与 node_subset 可以保留关系，其余方法有各自限制。这个检查发生在算法执行前，避免转换时悄悄合并关系。
text.en: Methods without a declared multigraph policy return UNSUPPORTED_MULTIGRAPH_OPERATION. Parameter choices also matter: only some community methods are approved, while ego_graph and node_subset preserve relationships and other subgraph methods have separate restrictions. Validation runs before computation to prevent silent relationship merging.

text.zh: 每个工具声明 reads、writes、barrier、background。资源还要加上用户/会话归属：graph、models、documents 等通常按会话隔离，datasets 与 construction:{dataset_id} 按用户或数据集隔离。RAW、WAR、WAW 冲突形成有向依赖，独立读操作可以并行；未知工具按 barrier 保守执行。
text.en: Each tool declares reads, writes, barrier, and background. Resources are qualified by identity: graph, models, and documents are generally session-scoped, while datasets and construction:{dataset_id} are user/dataset-scoped. RAW, WAR, and WAW conflicts create dependency edges. Independent reads can overlap; unknown tools are conservative barriers.

blocks.code:
load_constructed_graph (writes graph)
  ├─ node_centrality       (reads graph)
  ├─ community_detection  (reads graph)
  └─ shortest_path        (reads graph)
       ↓ all finished
load_graph_version        (writes graph)

text.zh: subgraph_extraction 默认写入新版本，只有 create_version=false 才按只读调度。前置工具失败或等待审批时，依赖项返回 TOOL_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED。模型必须在得到真实结果后再传入依赖它的 ID 或 revision；依赖调度不会补造参数。
text.en: subgraph_extraction writes a new version by default and is read-only only with create_version=false. Failed or approval-blocked predecessors cause TOOL_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED. The model must obtain real results before submitting dependent IDs or revisions; scheduling does not fabricate arguments.

text.zh: 智能体侧的 tool_dag 调度同轮调用，Graph Engine 的 tool_scheduler 控制跨请求资源调度。后台任务提交后，资源租约持续到实际工作结束；仅返回 job_id 不能释放租约。状态查询和取消绕开图写锁等待，防止任务无法停止。
text.en: Agent-side tool_dag schedules calls within a model turn; Graph Engine’s tool_scheduler controls admission across requests. Background jobs retain resource leases until execution actually finishes, not merely until job_id is returned. Status checks and cancellation avoid waiting on graph write leases so tasks remain controllable.

text.zh: 跨请求调度保留冲突请求的到达顺序。假设读取 R1 已进入执行，写入 W2 随后排队，新的读取 R3 不能绕过 W2；否则持续到来的读请求会使写请求长期无法执行。不同用户的资源互不冲突，同一用户的不同会话仍可能争用 datasets 或 construction:{dataset_id} 这类共享资源。
text.en: Cross-request scheduling preserves arrival order among conflicting requests. If read R1 is running and write W2 is queued, a new read R3 cannot bypass W2; otherwise continuous readers could starve the writer. Different users do not conflict, but sessions for the same user can share datasets or construction:{dataset_id}.

text.zh: 资源依赖和计算配额是两层控制。依赖检查决定是否会读取正在变化的数据；信号量决定最多同时运行多少普通计算或训练任务。即使两个训练任务只读同一张图，也可能因 GPU、随机数状态或用户计算配额而串行执行。
text.en: Resource dependencies and compute quotas are separate controls. Dependencies prevent reading changing data; semaphores limit simultaneous ordinary or heavy computation. Two training jobs that only read the same graph may still serialize because of GPU use, random-number state, or per-user quotas.

text.zh: NetworkX 算法的兼容路径使用有界 ProcessPool，其他同步处理器可走线程执行。受控执行在具备 execution host 与 Run 身份时使用可终止的隔离 WorkerProcess，维护停止确认与最终状态持久化。取消观察不等于计算停止；容量与租约在任务真正退出后回收。
text.en: The compatibility path for NetworkX algorithms uses a bounded ProcessPool, while other synchronous handlers may use threads. With an execution host and run identity, controlled execution uses terminable isolated WorkerProcess instances with stop confirmation and persisted terminal state. Cancelling observation does not stop computation; capacity and leases are reclaimed when execution actually exits.

rows.en: Ready tool calls within a turn.

rows.zh: 默认跟随计算 worker 数
全局普通计算并发限制。
单用户普通计算并发限制。

rows.en: Heavy tasks such as training and inference.

text.zh: get_job_status 返回作业状态与进度，普通作业完成结果位于 job.result；也可通过 get_job_result 读取结果。GraphMCPTools 在图工具返回后台句柄时等待最终结果，支持嵌套作业，并拒绝循环引用或缺失结果。监督学习的 infer 加载已训练模型执行前向计算，预训练的 infer 查询保存的节点向量。图分类数据绑定与当前单图绑定分开管理。
text.en: get_job_status returns status and progress, with ordinary completed output under job.result; get_job_result also retrieves results. GraphMCPTools waits for final output from graph-tool job handles, supports nested jobs, and rejects cycles or missing output. Supervised infer loads a trained model and runs a forward pass; pretraining infer queries saved node vectors. Graph-classification dataset binding is separate from active single-graph binding.

text.zh: 此结构展示 get_job_status 的字段位置；最终业务结果位于 job.result。状态值和 result 的具体字段由实际任务决定，轮询可用 after_seq 增量读取进度。
text.en: This shape illustrates get_job_status field placement: final business output lives in job.result. Actual status values and result fields depend on the job; after_seq supports incremental progress polling.

text.zh: search_node 与 search_edge 用于把用户描述解析为可传给图工具的节点或边标识。节点索引包含名称、类型、标签、入度、出度及邻居预览；语义文本优先来自 node_text，没有文本时使用名称、类型和标签。索引不会自动把 properties.data 中全部业务字段转成可检索文本。
text.en: search_node and search_edge resolve descriptions into identifiers for graph tools. Node indexes contain names, types, labels, degrees, and neighbor previews. Semantic text prefers node_text, otherwise names, types, and labels. The index does not automatically turn every business field in properties.data into searchable text.
