text.zh: 实体语义检索依赖 Graph Engine 自己的嵌入服务配置：EMBEDDING_PROVIDER 可显式选择 sentence-transformers、openai 或 lexical。默认先尝试本地 Sentence Transformers（需要依赖与模型权重），失败后在存在 OPENAI_API_KEY 时选择 OpenAI，否则使用词法哈希。当前 OpenAI 分支调用固定的 api.openai.com/v1/embeddings；Agent Runtime 的聊天模型或 EMBEDDING_BASE_URL 配置不会自动改写这个地址。词法模式不为实体查询提供语义相似度排序；索引编码失败时也会禁用语义检索，应检查 semantic_enabled 与检索错误信息。 显式选择 openai 时必须提供 OPENAI_API_KEY；显式提供方初始化失败不会执行上述自动选择。首次实体索引会编码全图节点与边文本，远程服务的可达性、延迟和额度也影响可用性。
text.en: Entity semantic search depends on Graph Engine’s own embedding configuration. EMBEDDING_PROVIDER explicitly selects sentence-transformers, openai or lexical. Automatic selection first tries local Sentence Transformers, requiring its dependency and model weights, then OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, and otherwise lexical hashing. The current OpenAI branch calls the fixed api.openai.com/v1/embeddings endpoint; Agent Runtime chat-model or EMBEDDING_BASE_URL settings do not override it. Lexical mode does not provide semantic ranking for entities. Index-encoding failures also disable semantic search; inspect semantic_enabled and retrieval errors. Explicit openai selection requires OPENAI_API_KEY; failure to initialize a forced provider does not run the automatic selection sequence. Initial entity indexing encodes node and edge documents for the entire graph, so remote reachability, latency and quota also affect availability.

rows.zh: 先检查业务名称是否命中 node2id，再尝试有效整数节点索引；边可按边名称或明确端点定位。
rows.en: Try business names in node2id first, then valid integer node indices. Edges can be resolved by name or explicit endpoints.

rows.zh: 节点支持 node_type、label 和入度/出度/总度上下界；边支持 edge_type、label 与权重上下界。
rows.en: Nodes support type, label, and bounds on incoming/outgoing/total degree. Edges support type, label, and weight bounds.

rows.zh: 可用嵌入服务生成 float32 向量，按归一化向量内积排序；默认 top_k=8，最大 50。
rows.en: An available embedding provider generates float32 vectors ranked by normalized inner product; top_k defaults to 8 and is capped at 50.

rows.zh: 查询向量按查询字符串缓存，最多 128 项；向量生成在缓存锁外执行。
rows.en: Cache query vectors by query string, up to 128 entries. Vector generation occurs outside the cache lock.

rows.zh: 除 best 外还返回 candidates、ambiguous 与检索模式；多个相近候选不能只凭排序第一项确定实体。
rows.en: Return candidates, ambiguous, and retrieval mode alongside best. A first-ranked item alone does not resolve several close matches.

text.zh: 当前置信度是规则分级，不是概率校准结果。精确命中对应 high；非精确查询短于 3 个字符会标记歧义；候选分数差小于 0.05 时也可能标记歧义。semantic_enabled=false 时，普通实体检索回退到精确定位和结构过滤，未匹配项的语义得分为 0，不能解释为仍在做语义相似度排序。
text.en: Confidence is rule-based rather than probability-calibrated. Exact matches receive high confidence. Non-exact queries shorter than three characters are ambiguous, and score gaps below 0.05 can also trigger ambiguity. With semantic_enabled=false, entity search falls back to exact resolution and structural filters. Non-exact semantic scores are zero; this is not continued semantic ranking.

text.zh: 这是按客户类型和度数筛选候选的参数示例。不同数据集的真实 node_type 值应先通过图概览或节点信息确认。rerank 当前用于返回配置状态，没有单独运行交叉编码器重排序模型。遇到 ambiguous=true 时，可补充类型、端点或节点 ID 后重新检索。
text.en: This example filters candidate customers by type and degree. Confirm actual node_type values from graph or node information for your dataset. rerank currently reports configuration state without running a separate cross-encoder. If ambiguous=true, refine the request with type, endpoint, or node ID.

text.zh: 平行关系检索还有一项限制：search_edge 按精确端点定位时只取得最后一条关系，索引中的属性读取也通过端点查找，并不完整枚举同端点关系。逐条核对和编辑应以 get_constructed_graph 返回的真实 edge_id 为准，不能仅凭 best 或 ambiguous=false 确认关系唯一。
text.en: Parallel-edge retrieval has an additional limitation: search_edge resolves exact endpoints to only the last relationship, and indexed properties are also looked up by endpoints. It does not exhaustively enumerate relationships sharing endpoints. Inspect and edit individual relationships using the actual edge_id from get_constructed_graph; best or ambiguous=false does not establish uniqueness.

title.zh: 文档分块与上下文检索

text.zh: 文档检索由 LightweightRAG 管理，和图节点检索使用不同索引。upload_document 把会话文档写入文档目录，保存 doc_index.json 与 doc_embeddings.npy；retrieve_context 根据查询向量返回相关文本块。文档命中说明文本相关，不等于图中存在相应关系，分析结论仍需图工具提供证据。
text.en: LightweightRAG maintains a document index separate from node search. upload_document stores session documents plus doc_index.json and doc_embeddings.npy; retrieve_context returns text chunks based on query vectors. Relevant text does not establish a graph relationship; graph tools still provide the structural evidence.

text.zh: 默认分块长度是 512 个按空白划分的片段，相邻块重叠 128 个片段，步长为 384。这不是模型分词器的 token 数；没有空格的长中文段落不会按汉字数量切成 512 字的块。准备中文资料时应保留合理分段，并检查返回 chunks 的实际数量和内容长度。
text.en: The default splitter uses 512 whitespace-separated items with 128 items of overlap and a stride of 384. These are not model-tokenizer tokens; a long Chinese paragraph without spaces is not split every 512 characters. Prepare appropriately segmented Chinese text and inspect actual chunk counts and lengths.

text.zh: 嵌入提供方可以是本地 Sentence Transformers、远程嵌入接口或词法哈希。文档检索在词法模式下使用 384 维哈希向量；Python 哈希受进程影响，因此旧文本块会在当前进程重新编码，避免把不同进程的哈希空间混合。向量维度改变时，检索返回错误，需重建该会话文档索引。
text.en: Providers include local Sentence Transformers, a remote embedding API, or lexical hashing. Document retrieval uses 384-dimensional hash vectors in lexical mode. Because Python hashing depends on the process, old chunks are re-encoded in the current process rather than mixing hash spaces. Dimension changes require rebuilding the session document index.

text.zh: 受控文档写入通过 .rag_versions 保存候选目录，再由 rag_manifest.json 选择当前版本。这样读请求可以定位一套完整的文本索引和向量文件。返回结果中的 doc_id、chunk_id、offset 与 score 用于定位引用片段；offset 是块序号，不是原文字符偏移。
text.en: Controlled document writes stage a version under .rag_versions, then rag_manifest.json selects the active directory. Readers therefore resolve one complete index/vector set. Returned doc_id, chunk_id, offset, and score identify cited text. offset is the chunk ordinal, not a character offset in the source document.

text.zh: 内存表示至少包含 [2,E] 的 int64 边索引，即约 16E 字节；普通 float32 边权另需 4E 字节，N 个节点、F 维 float32 特征另需 4NF 字节。这只是数组主体，不含字符串、Python 对象、图属性、NetworkX 对象、向量索引和工作进程副本。评估大图内存时，不能只按源文件大小估算。
text.en: The array representation needs roughly 16E bytes for the [2,E] int64 edge index, another 4E for ordinary float32 edge weights, and 4NF for N nodes with F float32 features. These figures exclude strings, Python objects, properties, NetworkX representations, retrieval indexes, and worker copies. Source-file size alone is not a memory estimate.

text.zh: 结构化大图还可以走独立的分区快照路径：prepare_large_graph 流式准备已上传的边列表或三元组文件，run_large_graph_algorithm 在发布版本上提交持久化作业。该路径不会先创建完整 GraphData 或 NetworkX 图。运行前读取 get_large_graph_capabilities，核对算法的精确、近似或有界语义及资源限制；完成后获取摘要、预览和结果文件引用。分区版本与普通活动图表示有独立的读取入口，不能把大图预览当作已加载的完整会话图。
text.en: Structured large graphs also have a separate partitioned-snapshot path. prepare_large_graph streams an uploaded edge-list or triples file, and run_large_graph_algorithm submits a persistent job against a published version without first creating a full GraphData or NetworkX graph. Inspect get_large_graph_capabilities for exact, approximate or bounded semantics and resource limits, then read summaries, previews and artifact references. Partitioned versions and ordinary active-graph representations have separate access paths; a large-graph preview is not a fully loaded session graph.

text.zh: 图服务当前通过 GRAPH_STORAGE_BACKEND 选择 local 或 nebula。NebulaGraph 模式需要显式启用连接；部分查询在数据库端执行，需要 NetworkX 的算法则先按能力和规模限制载入内存。默认载入上限为 50,000 个节点、200,000 条边，分别通过 NEBULA_MAX_MATERIALIZE_NODES 和 NEBULA_MAX_MATERIALIZE_EDGES 配置。materialized_scope、target_in_scope、complete_for_query 用于说明结果范围；有限跳数范围内未找到目标，不能直接解释为全图不可达。
text.en: GRAPH_STORAGE_BACKEND currently selects local or nebula. NebulaGraph mode requires an enabled connection. Some queries run in the database; NetworkX algorithms materialize data within capability and size limits. Defaults are 50,000 nodes and 200,000 edges, controlled by NEBULA_MAX_MATERIALIZE_NODES and NEBULA_MAX_MATERIALIZE_EDGES. materialized_scope, target_in_scope, and complete_for_query describe coverage; absence within a bounded hop neighborhood does not establish global unreachability.

text.zh: Graph Engine 管理源文件、图版本、构图报告、领域经验和模型文件；Agent Runtime 管理消息、Run、Memory 和 Trace。图服务可以配置 NebulaGraph 存储，但不能假定所有算法都在数据库内计算：远端图查询与有界物化是不同路径。
text.en: Graph Engine owns source files, graph revisions, construction reports, domain experience, and model artifacts. Agent Runtime owns messages, runs, memory, and traces. NebulaGraph storage is configurable, but algorithms do not all run inside the database: remote queries and bounded materialization are separate paths.

text.zh: 当前 Graph Engine API 的资源调度在单个进程内维护。多个 API 实例写同一存储时，需要额外的跨进程锁或资源所有者路由，不能仅增加副本数。
text.en: Graph Engine API currently maintains resource admission within one process. Multiple API instances writing the same storage require cross-process locking or resource-owner routing, beyond increasing replica count.

description.zh: 从分析问题选择算法，明确边权、方向和结果范围，并把工具输出转化为可以验证的结论。
description.en: Choose algorithms for the question, establish weight and direction semantics, and interpret tool outputs as verifiable conclusions.

title.en: From a question to a tool call

text.zh: 一次图分析通常由数据确认、实体定位、算法计算和结果呈现四步组成。先用 get_graph_info 确认活动图版本、方向和属性；再用精确节点名称或实体检索解析输入；随后执行算法；最后把完整计算结果交给可视化或报告工具。模型负责组织分析过程，数值结果来自 Graph Engine 的实际执行。
text.en: Graph analysis usually proceeds through data inspection, entity resolution, computation, and presentation. Confirm version, direction, and properties with get_graph_info, resolve inputs by exact name or search, execute the algorithm, and then pass its results to visualization or reporting. The model organizes the analysis; Graph Engine supplies computed values.

rows.zh: 哪些节点直接连接最多？
rows.en: Which nodes have the most direct connections?

rows.zh: 区分入度、出度、关系条数和不同邻居数。
rows.en: Distinguish incoming/outgoing degree, relationship count, and distinct neighbors.

rows.zh: 哪些节点控制重要路径？
rows.en: Which nodes lie on important paths?

rows.zh: 边权是距离或代价，且满足权重约束。
rows.en: Weights represent distance/cost and satisfy the weight constraints.

rows.zh: 明确方向，以及要找最少跳数还是最低成本。
rows.en: Specify direction and whether to minimize hops or cost.

rows.zh: 确认无向投影与边权表示的连接强度。
rows.en: Confirm undirected projection and connection-strength weights.

rows.zh: 容量的单位、源点、汇点和并行关系。
rows.en: Capacity units, source, sink, and parallel relationships.

rows.zh: 哪些关系值得进一步验证？
结构相似度只是候选得分，不是已存在关系。
rows.en: Structural scores rank candidates; they do not establish existing relationships.

text.zh: 同一轮模型响应中的独立算法可以并行，但依赖真实结果的下一步需要等结果返回。例如，不能在 search_node 尚未返回时猜测节点 ID 再调用 shortest_path。准备清空、覆盖或保存子图时，还应检查工具是否会改变当前活动图。
text.en: Independent algorithms in one model response may run concurrently, but a step needing actual output must wait. Do not guess a node ID for shortest_path before search_node returns. Before clearing, replacing, or saving a subgraph, check whether the tool changes the active graph.

text.zh: 查询 72 个业务工具的参数、返回字段及具体约束。
text.en: Inspect parameters, result fields, and constraints for all 72 business tools.

title.zh: 平行关系会限制可用算法

text.zh: 存在平行关系时，社区发现仅支持 louvain 与 greedy_modularity。VoteRank、percolation、maximum_cycle、link_prediction_score、k_core/k_truss/k_corona，以及 transitivity、average_clustering、degree_assortativity 会返回 UNSUPPORTED_MULTIGRAPH_OPERATION。应先检查图结构，再选择支持的方法；不要未经说明就删除关系来绕过限制。
text.en: With parallel relationships, community detection supports only louvain and greedy_modularity. VoteRank, percolation, maximum_cycle, link_prediction_score, k_core/k_truss/k_corona, transitivity, average_clustering, and degree_assortativity return UNSUPPORTED_MULTIGRAPH_OPERATION. Inspect graph structure before selecting a supported method; do not silently drop relationships to bypass the restriction.

text.zh: shortest_path 的 use_weight=true 按边权总和寻找最低成本路径；false 按跳数计算。两者优化目标不同。默认加权路径使用 NetworkX 的最短路径实现，单源到所有节点的请求使用 Dijkstra；无权路径按跳数遍历。不存在路径是一次有效查询的结果，应读取 found=false，而不是把它当成服务故障。
text.en: shortest_path with use_weight=true minimizes total edge weight; false minimizes hop count. These are different objectives. Weighted paths use NetworkX shortest-path routines, and all-target single-source requests use Dijkstra. Unweighted paths traverse by hops. A missing path is a valid query outcome represented by found=false, not necessarily a service failure.

blocks.code:
A -> B : 2
A -> C : 5
B -> C : 1
B -> D : 4
C -> D : 1

Weighted minimum: A -> B -> C -> D, cost = 4, hops = 3
Minimum hops:     A -> B -> D or A -> C -> D, hops = 2

text.zh: algorithm=yen_k_shortest 返回按成本排序的若干简单路径，路径之间的成本可以不同；all_shortest_paths 返回相同最优成本的路径。path_analysis(method=all_simple_paths) 则枚举满足 cutoff 的简单路径，可能包含大量非最短路径。简单路径不重复经过节点，因此它与允许绕圈的步行序列不同。
text.en: algorithm=yen_k_shortest returns several simple paths ordered by cost, possibly with different costs. all_shortest_paths returns paths tied at the optimal cost. path_analysis(method=all_simple_paths) enumerates simple paths within cutoff, potentially including many nonoptimal routes. Simple paths do not revisit nodes, unlike general walks.

text.zh: target="all" 会执行单源可达路径计算，默认只展示最近的 10 条路径，并同时返回 reachable_count 和距离统计。all_shortest_paths 也默认最多展示 10 条。展示条数不能当作可达节点总数或最短路径总数；必须同时读取 truncated、count_returned 等字段。
text.en: target="all" computes single-source reachability and paths, showing the nearest 10 by default alongside reachable_count and distance statistics. all_shortest_paths also displays up to 10 by default. Display counts are not total reachable nodes or total shortest paths; inspect truncated and count_returned.

text.zh: 属性图中的平行边按最小权重投影后参与路径计算，路径按节点序列区分。同一节点序列上存在多条等价关系，不会自动变成多条不同结果。NebulaGraph 上的部分路径工具只加载有限跳数邻域，此时未找到路径仅说明当前查询范围内未找到。
text.en: Property-graph parallel edges use minimum-weight projection and paths are distinguished by node sequence. Multiple equivalent relationships along one node sequence do not automatically create different returned paths. Some NebulaGraph tools load a bounded hop neighborhood, where a missing path only describes that scope.

title.zh: 中心性：不同意义上的重要节点

text.zh: 中心性没有统一的“重要程度”定义。度中心性描述直接连接数量，介数中心性关注最短路径经过的中介位置，PageRank 关注来自其他重要节点的连接。解释排名前，先说明研究问题及边的方向含义；不要把所有中心性值放在一个量纲下比较。
text.en: Centralities do not share one definition of importance. Degree counts direct connectivity, betweenness emphasizes mediation along shortest paths, and PageRank considers links from other important nodes. State the question and edge direction before interpreting rankings; scores from different centralities do not share a common scale.

rows.zh: 度中心性：连接数量的归一化统计。
不按权重强度求和；度分布的原始计数用 degree_analysis。
rows.en: Does not sum weight strength; use degree_analysis for raw degree counts.

rows.zh: 介数中心性：最短路径经过该节点的比例之和。
rows.en: Betweenness: sum of shortest-path fractions passing through a node.

rows.zh: 使用 weight 作为距离；属性图要求严格正权重，不暴露抽样 k 参数。
rows.en: Uses weight as distance. Property graphs require strictly positive weights; a sampling k is not exposed.

rows.zh: 接近中心性：其他节点到该节点的平均最短距离的倒数。
rows.en: Closeness: inverse average shortest distance from other nodes to the node.

rows.zh: 有向图使用入向距离，并采用 NetworkX 的连通范围修正。
rows.en: Uses incoming distances in directed graphs with NetworkX reachability scaling.

rows.zh: 调和中心性：可达节点距离倒数之和。
rows.en: Harmonic centrality: sum of reciprocal reachable distances.

rows.zh: 使用加权距离，不能把无法到达的节点当作零距离。
rows.en: Uses weighted distances; unreachable nodes are not zero-distance nodes.

rows.zh: PageRank：沿连接传播的稳态重要度。
rows.en: PageRank: stationary importance propagated along links.

rows.zh: weight 表示连接强度，平行关系的权重累加。
rows.en: weight represents connection strength; parallel weights are summed.

rows.zh: 特征向量中心性：与高中心性节点相连会提高得分。
rows.en: Eigenvector centrality: connectivity to high-scoring nodes raises the score.

rows.zh: 幂迭代上限为 1,000；不收敛时尝试 NumPy 求解。
rows.en: Power iteration allows 1,000 iterations, then attempts a NumPy solver on nonconvergence.

rows.zh: Katz 中心性：考虑不同长度的连接路径并衰减远距离影响。
rows.en: Katz centrality: attenuated contributions from walks of different lengths.

rows.zh: 固定 alpha=0.1、beta=1.0、max_iter=1000，仍可能不收敛。
rows.en: Fixed alpha=0.1, beta=1.0, max_iter=1000; convergence is not guaranteed.

rows.zh: 负载中心性：按最短路径分配负载。
rows.en: Load centrality: load distributed along shortest paths.

rows.zh: 使用 weight 作为距离，属性图要求严格正权重。
rows.en: Uses weight as distance with strictly positive property-graph weights.

rows.zh: VoteRank：用投票过程选择影响节点。
rows.en: VoteRank: selects influential nodes using a voting process.

rows.zh: 返回的是选中节点的顺序评分，不是全部节点的概率。
rows.en: Returns ordinal scores for selected nodes, not probabilities for all nodes.

rows.zh: 渗流中心性：考虑节点渗流状态的路径指标。
rows.en: Percolation centrality: path importance weighted by node percolation state.

rows.zh: 读取节点 percolation 属性，缺失时按 1.0 处理。
rows.en: Reads the percolation node attribute, defaulting to 1.0.

text.zh: node_centrality 返回 top_nodes、bottom_nodes、value_stats 和 total_nodes，数值通常保留 6 位小数。top_nodes 默认最多 20 项；bottom_nodes 只补充不与前列重叠的末尾节点。total_nodes 表示该算法实际生成的得分数量，VoteRank 等方法不能据此推断完整图规模。
text.en: node_centrality returns top_nodes, bottom_nodes, value_stats, and total_nodes, generally rounded to six decimals. top_nodes defaults to 20, while bottom_nodes avoids overlap with the leading entries. total_nodes counts scored nodes, which need not establish the graph size for methods such as VoteRank.

label.zh: NetworkX：接近中心性与有向距离

text.zh: 社区发现把连接较密集的节点分为组。Graph Engine 先按当前算法规则构造无向分析图，再计算社区及模块度。模块度衡量分组中的内部连接相对于随机基线是否更集中；它用于比较同一图和同一权重语义下的划分，不能直接当作预测准确率。
text.en: Community detection groups densely connected nodes. Graph Engine constructs the algorithm’s undirected analysis graph and computes communities and modularity. Modularity compares within-group connectivity with a random baseline. It compares partitions under the same graph and weight semantics, not predictive accuracy.

rows.zh: 基于加权模块度优化；固定 seed=42。
给出一次层次聚合后的分组。
rows.en: Returns a partition from the aggregation process.

rows.zh: 贪心合并以提高加权模块度。
在当前无向分析图上分组。
rows.en: Partitions the current undirected analysis graph.

rows.zh: 标签传播，当前分支不向算法传入边权。
rows.en: Label propagation without passing weights in this branch.

rows.zh: 异步加权标签传播，固定 seed=42。
rows.en: Asynchronous weighted label propagation with seed=42.

rows.zh: 随机过程由该固定种子控制。
rows.en: The configured seed controls stochastic choices.

rows.zh: 按边介数逐步拆分网络。
rows.en: Progressive splits based on edge betweenness.

rows.zh: 当前只取生成器的第一次划分。
rows.en: Currently returns the generator’s first partition.

rows.zh: 异步流体社区算法，目标组数至多 3。
rows.en: Asynchronous fluid communities, targeting at most three groups.

rows.zh: 图不连通时只处理最大连通分量。
rows.en: Uses only the largest component for disconnected graphs.

rows.zh: 通过 python-igraph 与 leidenalg 计算；当前转换未传入边权。
rows.en: Uses python-igraph and leidenalg; the current conversion passes no weights.

rows.zh: 发生异常时回退到加权 Louvain；返回的 algorithm 仍为请求值。
rows.en: Exceptions fall back to weighted Louvain; algorithm still reports the requested value.

text.zh: 默认返回最大的 5 个社区，每组只预览 10 个节点。num_communities、communities_shown、communities_truncated 与 nodes_truncated 分别说明总组数、已展示组数以及两层截断。community_id 来自本次计算，不是跨图版本稳定的业务标识。
text.en: By default, show the five largest communities with ten node previews each. num_communities, communities_shown, communities_truncated, and nodes_truncated distinguish total groups, displayed groups, and both truncation levels. community_id belongs to this computation and is not a stable business identifier across graph versions.

text.zh: 比较算法时应记录图版本、是否使用权重、是否进行了无向投影和实际覆盖节点。对于 Leiden，需要额外注意回退和权重传递的实现限制；对于 asyn_fluidc，需要检查遗漏的其他连通分量。这些条件会改变结果含义。
text.en: Record graph version, weight usage, undirected projection, and covered nodes when comparing algorithms. Leiden has fallback and weight-transfer limitations, while asyn_fluidc can omit other connected components. These conditions change what the result means.

text.zh: focus_nodes 最多接受 200 个真实节点名，用于把指定节点关联到同一次社区划分，避免另一次调用产生不同编号。普通活动图与大图路径的同名算法不能混为一谈：大图社区入口当前将七个名称映射到可扩展的加权同步标签传播近似，max_iterations 默认 5；要求原算法语义时先查能力目录，并考虑 strict_semantics=true 拒绝近似映射。
text.en: focus_nodes accepts up to 200 actual node names to associate them with the same community partition rather than IDs from another run. Identical algorithm names do not imply identical implementations across ordinary and large-graph paths: large-graph community analysis currently maps all seven names to scalable weighted synchronous label propagation, with max_iterations=5 by default. Inspect capabilities and consider strict_semantics=true to reject approximate mappings when the named algorithm’s semantics are required.

title.zh: 网络流、最小割与生成树

text.zh: 最大流把边权解释为容量。对给定源点和汇点，求满足容量约束和中间节点流量守恒的最大流量。指定 source/sink 的 minimum_cut 寻找把它们分开的最小容量割；在相同网络和容量约定下，最大流值应等于最小割值，可据此检查分析是否使用了一致的输入。
text.en: Maximum flow treats edge weights as capacities and maximizes flow from source to sink under capacity and conservation constraints. minimum_cut with source/sink finds the minimum-capacity separating cut. Under identical network and capacity conventions, maximum flow and minimum cut have equal values, providing an input-consistency check.

blocks.code:
s -> a : 3
s -> b : 2
a -> b : 1
a -> t : 2
b -> t : 3

Feasible flow: s-a-t = 2, s-a-b-t = 1, s-b-t = 2
Maximum flow = 5; a minimum cut is {s} | {a,b,t}, capacity = 5

text.zh: 这是按容量手工计算的说明例子。maximum_flow 返回 max_flow_value 与非零流边预览，minimum_cut 返回 min_cut_value、分区规模和割边预览。具体流量分配或最小割分区可能不唯一，因此不应把单次返回的边集合解释为唯一瓶颈方案。
text.en: This illustrative network is calculated by hand. maximum_flow returns max_flow_value and nonzero-edge previews; minimum_cut returns min_cut_value, partition sizes, and cut-edge previews. Flow assignments and minimizing partitions may not be unique, so one returned edge set is not necessarily the only bottleneck solution.

text.zh: global_minimum_cut 不指定源汇，当前使用无向 Stoer–Wagner 算法。有向输入需要 treat_as_undirected=true，成对连接的权重会合并，自环不参与割；图已不连通时割值为 0。它回答的是全局最易分离的位置，与两点间的最小割问题不同。
text.en: global_minimum_cut has no fixed terminals and currently uses undirected Stoer–Wagner. Directed input requires treat_as_undirected=true; pair weights are combined and self-loops do not participate. Disconnected graphs have a cut value of zero. This asks for the easiest global separation rather than a cut between two chosen terminals.

text.zh: minimum_spanning_tree 寻找连接所有节点且总权重最小的无环边集。图不连通时返回最小生成森林摘要。它优化整张网络的总连接成本，不保证每个节点到源点的路径最短；路径规划应使用 shortest_path。
text.en: minimum_spanning_tree minimizes total edge weight while connecting nodes without cycles. Disconnected input returns a minimum spanning forest summary. It minimizes total network connection cost, not every source-to-node path; use shortest_path for routing.

text.zh: 最小生成树基于无向分析图。构图属性图按无向端点对选择最小权重关系；普通有向图则直接通过 NetworkX 转为无向图，不能假定相反方向边自动取较小权重。需要比较生成树结果时，应明确采用哪一种输入与投影规则。
text.en: Minimum spanning trees use an undirected analysis graph. Constructed attributed graphs select the minimum-weight relationship per unordered endpoint pair. Ordinary directed graphs are converted directly by NetworkX, which does not guarantee choosing the smaller weight between opposite directions. Record the input representation and projection rule when comparing results.

title.zh: 结构分析、子图与候选关系

text.zh: 有向图的强连通分量要求组内节点沿方向互相可达；弱连通分量忽略方向后判断连通。graph_connectivity 会分别报告两者。topological_sort 只适用于有向无环图，如果业务依赖含环，应先用 find_cycles 定位冲突，再决定是否修改关系。
text.en: Strongly connected components require mutual directed reachability; weak components ignore direction. graph_connectivity reports both. topological_sort requires a directed acyclic graph. When business dependencies contain cycles, inspect find_cycles before deciding how to change relationships.

text.zh: find_cycles 采用有限展示上限时，会流式读取“上限加一”个环来判断是否截断；请求全部结果时，会枚举并保存全部简单环。maximum_cycle 在 max_cycles 范围内寻找最长或权重最大的简单环，默认最多枚举 10,000 个；search_exhausted=false 表示搜索未穷尽，返回的只是已搜索候选中的最好结果。
text.en: With a finite display limit, find_cycles streams one more cycle than the limit to detect truncation. Requesting all results enumerates and stores all simple cycles. maximum_cycle searches at most max_cycles candidates for the longest or greatest-weight simple cycle, defaulting to 10,000. search_exhausted=false means the result is only the best candidate examined, not a proven global optimum.

rows.zh: 给定节点集合的诱导子图。
保留这些节点之间已有的关系。
rows.en: Retains existing relationships among those nodes.

rows.zh: 围绕中心节点按指定半径扩展。
rows.en: Expand around a center by radius.

rows.zh: 递归去除度不足 k 的节点。
rows.en: Recursively remove nodes with degree below k.

rows.zh: 强调整体上维持至少 k 度的结构。
rows.en: Finds a structure maintaining minimum degree k.

rows.zh: 保留至少参与 k−2 个三角形的边所形成的子图。
rows.en: Subgraph whose edges participate in at least k−2 triangles.

rows.zh: 用于分析三角关系密集的区域。
k-core 中度恰好为 k 的节点诱导子图。
rows.en: Induced subgraph on nodes with degree exactly k within the k-core.

rows.zh: 不是所有原图度等于 k 的节点。
rows.en: Not all nodes whose original-graph degree equals k.

text.zh: subgraph_extraction 默认 create_version=true，会把提取结果保存为当前活动图。仅为了解释结果或预览结构时，应显式传 false。后续中心性、社区或训练会读取活动图，因此保存子图会改变分析输入；需要记录新 graph_version。
text.en: subgraph_extraction defaults to create_version=true and makes the extracted graph active. Pass false explicitly for explanatory previews. Later centrality, community, and training calls read the active graph, so saving a subgraph changes their input; record the new graph_version.

text.zh: 结构链接预测不需要训练模型。Jaccard 衡量共同邻居占并集的比例；Adamic–Adar 与资源分配指数降低高度数共同邻居的贡献；优先连接使用两端节点度数的乘积。未指定两个端点时，工具遍历不存在边的节点对并保留最高分候选，top_k 限制结果保存量，但不把候选评分工作变成常数时间。
text.en: Structural link prediction needs no trained model. Jaccard measures shared neighbors relative to their union; Adamic–Adar and resource allocation discount high-degree common neighbors; preferential attachment multiplies endpoint degrees. Without two endpoints, the tool scores non-edge pairs and retains the best candidates. top_k bounds retained results, not total scoring work.

label.en: NetworkX: definitions of k-core, k-truss, and k-corona

rows.zh: 树、森林、DAG、二部图和平面性等判定，BFS/DFS 树、拓扑序和 WL 哈希。遍历必须指定 source；不会保存为新的活动图。
rows.en: Tree, forest, DAG, bipartite and planarity checks; BFS/DFS trees, topological orders and WL hashing. Traversals require source and do not save a new active graph.

rows.zh: 点/边连通度、割集、割点、桥和分量；局部连通度与割集成对提供 source/target。condensation 要求有向图。
rows.en: Node/edge connectivity, cuts, articulation points, bridges and components. Local connectivity and cuts take source/target together; condensation requires a directed graph.

rows.zh: 最大/随机生成树、最近公共祖先、支配关系、DAG 最长路与反链。LCA 需要 node1/node2，支配关系需要 source；有向无环类方法会检查前提。
rows.en: Maximum/random spanning trees, lowest common ancestors, dominators, DAG longest paths and antichains. LCA needs node1/node2, dominators need source, and DAG methods check their prerequisites.

rows.zh: 无向视图上的匹配、边覆盖与着色。极大匹配不等于最大匹配；均衡着色要求 num_colors 大于最大度，最小边覆盖拒绝孤立节点。
rows.en: Matching, edge covers and coloring on an undirected view. Maximal is distinct from maximum matching; equitable coloring needs num_colors above the maximum degree, and minimum edge cover rejects isolates.

rows.zh: 中心、边缘、离心率、Wiener 指数、效率、互惠性等。中心、边缘、离心率、Wiener 指数与重心只在最大无向连通分量计算；无环图的围长为 null 并标记 acyclic=true。
rows.en: Center, periphery, eccentricity, Wiener index, efficiency, reciprocity and more. Center, periphery, eccentricity, Wiener index and barycenter use the largest undirected component; acyclic girth is null with acyclic=true.

text.zh: 这五组扩展工具目前拒绝多重图。普通路径的列表预览默认 20，正整数上限钳制为 200；all 的含义要看具体方法。全部拓扑序、反链、collider 与 v-structure 枚举仍受 200 条硬上限约束。读取 truncated、hard_limit、count_is_exact 等字段，不能把预览条数当作全体数量。大图路径另有能力、预算和结果文件约束；本页描述源码契约，不表示所有算法和参数组合都已在当前部署逐项运行。
text.en: These five groups currently reject multigraphs. Ordinary list previews default to 20 and positive integer limits are capped at 200; the meaning of all depends on the method. All topological orders, antichains, colliders and v-structures retain a hard limit of 200. Read truncated, hard_limit and count_is_exact rather than treating preview length as a total count. The large-graph path has separate capability, budget and artifact constraints. This page documents source contracts, not execution of every algorithm and parameter combination on the current deployment.

rows.zh: 在当前方向语义下计算图密度。自环或多重关系会影响对“密度”的解释。
rows.en: Density follows graph direction; self-loops and multiple relationships affect its interpretation.

rows.zh: 先转为无向图，再取最大连通分量，使用无权距离。
rows.en: Convert to undirected, select the largest component, and use unweighted distances.

rows.zh: 在无向分析图上计算全局三角闭合程度。
rows.en: Compute global triangle closure on the undirected analysis graph.

rows.zh: 在无向图上计算加权平均聚类系数。
rows.en: Compute weighted average clustering on the undirected graph.

rows.zh: 在无向图上衡量两端度数的相关性。
rows.en: Measure correlation between endpoint degrees on the undirected graph.

text.zh: 直径和半径的有限数值不代表原始有向图完全连通；它们可能只描述最大无向连通分量。部分指标在空图或度数无变化的图上无定义。global_metrics 用 defined=false、value=null 表示非有限结果；度同配系数还返回 undefined_reason_code 与 undefined_reason，区分无边和端点度数方差为零。无定义不是数值 0，也不等于引擎不支持这个指标；其他参数或图结构错误仍可能返回 success=false。
text.en: Finite diameter and radius do not establish connectivity of the original directed graph; they may describe only its largest undirected component. Some metrics are undefined on empty graphs or graphs with no degree variation. global_metrics represents nonfinite results with defined=false and value=null. Degree assortativity also includes undefined_reason_code and undefined_reason for no edges or zero endpoint-degree variance. Undefined is neither zero nor evidence that the engine lacks the metric; other input or structural errors can still return success=false.

text.zh: 输出中的 summary、preview、top_nodes、truncated 表达不同层次的信息。全局指标可能基于完整输入图计算，而列表只展示其中一部分；远端有限范围查询则连计算输入本身也可能被限定。写报告时应同时标明“计算范围”和“展示范围”。
text.en: summary, preview, top_nodes, and truncated describe different levels of output. Global metrics may use the full input graph while lists display only part of it; bounded remote queries can restrict the input itself. Reports should distinguish computation scope from display scope.

text.zh: visualize_subgraph 的目录默认值为 max_nodes=800、include_community=true；引擎的省略值和边数上限可由 VISUALIZE_MAX_NODES、VISUALIZE_MAX_EDGES 配置，默认分别为 800 和 2,000。超出范围时使用确定性的概览选择，结合高亮、节点类型、社区代表、高度数节点和连接路径。高亮本身过多也可能截断，需检查 overview.required_nodes_truncated。total_nodes/total_edges 表示请求范围内的原始规模，num_nodes/num_edges 是实际展示规模。视图不能证明范围外没有路径；报告同样应使用真实 source_results，并单独说明计算与展示范围。
text.en: The visualize_subgraph catalog defaults are max_nodes=800 and include_community=true. Engine fallback and edge limits are configurable with VISUALIZE_MAX_NODES and VISUALIZE_MAX_EDGES, defaulting to 800 and 2,000. Oversized inputs use deterministic overview selection combining highlights, node types, community representatives, high-degree nodes and connecting paths. Even requested highlights can be truncated; inspect overview.required_nodes_truncated. total_nodes/total_edges describe the original requested scope, while num_nodes/num_edges describe the displayed view. A view cannot establish absence of paths outside it; reports likewise require actual source_results and explicit computation and display scopes.

description.zh: 管理个人与项目数据集，区分源文件、构图结果和会话活动图，并把可用数据接入分析。
description.en: Manage personal and project datasets, distinguish retained sources from saved constructions and active session graphs, and load data for analysis.

text.zh: 工作台通过 /api/personal-datasets 管理个人数据，通过 /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets 管理项目数据。Backend 保存目录、原始文件及归属信息，Graph Engine 管理构图状态和图版本。数据集 ID 以接口返回值为准，不能根据文件名推测；个人数据集与项目内的副本也有各自独立的 ID。
text.en: The workspace manages personal data through /api/personal-datasets and project data through /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets. Backend retains the catalog, original files, and ownership, while Graph Engine manages construction state and graph revisions. Use the dataset ID returned by the API, not a filename-derived ID. A personal dataset and its project copy have independent IDs.

rows.en: POST /api/personal-datasets — multipart/form-data: file, or files + csv_schema
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/datasets — multipart/form-data: file, or files + csv_schema

rows.zh: 构图工作台接收 .sql、.csv、.txt。UTF-8 文本可带 BOM；.sql 也可保存受支持的 SQLite 数据库镜像。上传后需构图。
rows.en: The construction workspace accepts .sql, .csv, and .txt. UTF-8 text may include a BOM, and .sql can contain a supported SQLite database image. Construction is required after upload.

rows.zh: 一次选择一个或多个 CSV，检查表名、表头和键定义。上传 files + csv_schema，保存为同一数据集；多文件请求只允许 CSV。
rows.en: Select one or more CSV files and review table names, headers, and keys. Upload files + csv_schema to retain them as one dataset; multi-file requests allow CSV only.

rows.zh: 数据集/会话导入还有 .json、.npz、.pt、.tsv、.edgelist、.dat 等入口；实际结构必须符合对应加载器要求。后缀本身不保证文件可加载，构图工作台也不接收所有这些格式。
rows.en: Dataset/session import also exposes formats including .json, .npz, .pt, .tsv, .edgelist, and .dat, subject to the relevant loader’s data format. An extension alone does not establish compatibility, and the construction workspace does not accept all these formats.

rows.zh: .pt 等文件须按内容区分单图和多图分类数据。分类数据需要图集合、标签和划分；加载单图不会自动得到这些训练条件。
rows.en: Files such as .pt must be interpreted according to whether they contain a single graph or graph-classification data. Classification needs a graph collection, labels, and splits; loading one graph does not supply those requirements.

text.zh: SQL 构图使用受支持的 SQLite DDL 与字面值 INSERT，不是 MySQL/PostgreSQL 任意 dump 兼容层，也不连接在线数据库。CSV 中数值外观的单元格仍是字符串；TXT 的自动识别、逐行记录和语义关系抽取是不同模式。先核对数据内容和用途，再选择入口。
text.en: SQL construction supports a subset of SQLite DDL and literal INSERTs, not arbitrary MySQL/PostgreSQL dumps or live database connections. Numeric-looking CSV cells remain strings. TXT auto-detection, line records, and semantic relationship extraction are different modes. Choose the entry point based on the data and intended use.

items.zh: 上传 CSV、TXT 或 SQL 后，目录状态为 source_ready，构图状态为 not_built；这一步保存源文件，不代表图已生成。
items.en: A new CSV, TXT, or SQL upload has catalog status source_ready and construction status not_built. It retains the source; it does not create a finished graph.

items.zh: 打开构图面板，先查看原始样本、表头和字段说明；多表 CSV 确认主外键，TXT 选择所需导入模式。
items.en: Open the construction panel to inspect source samples, headers, and descriptions. Confirm keys for multi-table CSV and choose the intended TXT mode.

items.zh: 发起 construction/build，并持续检查状态。ready 后可查看实例图、类型结构和保存版本；失败时先依据错误消息和报告修正问题。
items.en: Start construction/build and monitor status. Once ready, inspect the instance graph, type schema, and saved revision; on failure, correct the issue using the message and report.

items.zh: 在会话中选择或加载构图结果，再核对当前图信息。保存构图和更新会话活动图是两个动作。
items.en: Select or load the construction result in a session and verify the current graph. Saving construction and updating an active session graph are separate actions.

items.zh: 图算法、子图检索和可视化使用会话活动单图。图分类训练使用另行加载的多图数据及划分，不能拿单个构图结果替代完整训练数据。
items.en: Algorithms, subgraph retrieval, and visualization use the active single graph. Graph classification uses separately loaded multi-graph data and splits; one constructed graph is not a substitute for that training dataset.

label.zh: 源数据预览与含义来源

title.zh: 把个人构图结果用于项目
title.en: Reuse a personal construction in a project

text.zh: 项目可以导入当前用户已经完成构图的个人数据集。可选列表只包含目录状态和构图状态均为 ready 的个人数据；未构图、失败或其他用户的数据不在此列表中。导入会复制源文件和保存的图，生成独立项目数据集，不移动原始个人数据，也不在项目中直接引用个人数据集 ID。
text.en: A project can import a personal dataset already constructed by the current user. The selection includes only personal datasets whose catalog and construction states are both ready, excluding unbuilt, failed, or other users’ data. Import copies the retained source and saved graph into an independent project dataset; it does not move the personal data or directly bind its ID into the project.

text.zh: 后续操作使用响应中的新 dataset_id。源文件、CSV 表组定义和构图结果随副本保存，imported_from 记录来源 ID 与修订。只有项目尚未设置默认数据集时，导入结果才自动成为默认数据集；这仍不等于已替换某个正在使用的会话活动图。需要分析该副本时，在相应项目会话中选择并加载它。
text.en: Use the new dataset_id returned by the response. The copy retains the source, CSV-bundle metadata, and constructed graph; imported_from records the source ID and revision. It becomes the project default only if no default is already set. This does not itself replace an active session graph. Select and load the copy in the appropriate project session for analysis.

rows.zh: dataset_id 由上传接口返回；源文件存在不代表已完成构图。
rows.en: Upload returns dataset_id; an existing source file does not establish a constructed graph.

rows.zh: 读取构图状态，确认是否需要首次构建。
rows.en: Inspect construction state to decide whether an initial build is needed.

rows.zh: revision 标识数据集内保存的构图成果，用于编辑并发检查。
rows.en: revision identifies a saved construction result and supports concurrent-edit checks.

rows.zh: 读取真实元素和 revision，再提交基于该版本的预览与修改。
rows.en: Read actual elements and revision before previewing and committing edits against that base.

rows.zh: graph_version 标识当前会话内的图状态；加载保存结果后可生成独立的会话版本。
rows.en: graph_version identifies graph state within a session; loading saved results can produce a separate session version.

rows.zh: 算法、检索缓存和可视化使用当前会话图，不能用数据集 revision 替代。
rows.en: Algorithms, retrieval caches, and visualization use the session graph; dataset revision is not a substitute.

rows.zh: 绑定的是多张图及其划分；与会话活动单图分开保存。
rows.en: Binds multiple graphs and their splits separately from the active single graph.

rows.zh: 训练读取分类数据；查看某个分子时再把那张图加载为活动单图。
rows.en: Training reads the classification data; load an individual molecule as the active graph for inspection.

rows.zh: generation 标识同一运行的执行阶段，用于取消、审批继续和结果发布。
rows.en: generation identifies an execution phase within a run for cancellation, continuation, and publication.

rows.zh: 它属于执行控制，不能作为图版本或构图修订号。
rows.en: It belongs to execution control, not graph versioning or construction revisions.

text.zh: 构图保存与会话加载是两个步骤。例如，数据集保存到 revision=3 后，会话仍可能保留此前加载的图。需要继续分析新版数据时，使用 load_constructed_graph 加载保存成果，再通过 get_graph_info 核对当前图。切换会话图也不会反向覆盖数据集；如需保存会话中的派生图，应显式调用相应的数据集保存接口。
text.en: Saving construction and loading a session graph are separate actions. After a dataset reaches revision=3, a session may still hold a previously loaded graph. Load the saved result with load_constructed_graph and verify it with get_graph_info before analyzing the update. Switching a session graph does not overwrite the dataset; persisting a derived session graph requires an explicit dataset-save operation.

text.zh: 两个客户端同时编辑同一构图结果时，都必须携带各自读取的 revision。一个客户端先提交后，另一个客户端的旧版本请求应按冲突处理：重新读取图、重新预览，再确认修改。预览只展示将发生的变化；重复发送旧预览并不能解决版本冲突。
text.en: Concurrent editors must supply the revision each read. If one commits first, the other handles its stale request as a conflict: reread the graph, preview again, and confirm the new edits. A preview describes prospective changes; resending the old preview does not resolve a version conflict.

text.zh: 旧 /api/datasets、会话 load-dataset / save-dataset 仍保留兼容。它们面向 Registry，不能简单地把路径替换为 personal-datasets：两个目录的 ID 和加载、删除语义不同。旧个人构图路径是例外，其 construction 系列允许只替换路径前缀。
text.en: Legacy /api/datasets and session load-dataset / save-dataset endpoints remain compatible. They address the registry, so replacing their prefixes with personal-datasets is not a general migration: IDs and loading/deletion semantics differ. Legacy personal construction routes are aliases and do allow a prefix-only substitution.

text.zh: 登录用户可调用 GET /api/dataset-api-migration 获取结构化迁移说明。现有兼容声明没有安排删除日期；智能体的 list_datasets、load_dataset、save_as_dataset 工具继续维护。
text.en: Authenticated users can request GET /api/dataset-api-migration for structured migration guidance. No removal date has been scheduled. Agent tools list_datasets, load_dataset, and save_as_dataset remain maintained.

description.zh: 从图数据、标签与划分出发，理解四类图学习任务的模型结构、训练目标、评估协议，以及模型保存和推理流程。
description.en: Understand four graph-learning tasks through their data, labels, splits, model architectures, training objectives, evaluation protocols, saved models, and inference workflows.

text.zh: 图机器学习通过 train、infer 和 visualize_model_architecture 工具使用。节点分类、链接预测与预训练读取会话的活动单图；图分类读取独立的多图数据集。这里的节点分类回答‘这个节点属于哪一类’，链接预测估计节点对的连接分数，图分类预测整张图的标签，预训练则生成后续任务可复用的节点嵌入向量。
text.en: Use graph machine learning through train, infer, and visualize_model_architecture. Node classification, link prediction, and pretraining read the session's active single graph; graph classification reads a separate collection of graphs. These tasks predict node classes, score node pairs, predict graph-level labels, and produce reusable node embeddings, respectively.

rows.zh: 必填 model：APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER；单图节点特征与标签
rows.en: Required model: APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER; single-graph node features and labels

rows.zh: 交叉熵；输出节点类别与 softmax 概率
rows.en: Cross-entropy; node classes and softmax probabilities

rows.zh: 必填 model：APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER；单图结构
rows.en: Required model: APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER; single-graph structure

rows.zh: 正负边二元交叉熵；输出节点对分数与连接概率
rows.en: Binary cross-entropy on positive and negative edges; pair scores and connection probabilities

rows.zh: 必填 model：APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER；HIV / PCBA 多图数据集
rows.en: Required model: APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER; HIV / PCBA graph collections

rows.zh: 忽略缺失标签的二元交叉熵；输出图级单任务或多任务预测
rows.en: Binary cross-entropy excluding missing labels; single-task or multi-task graph predictions

rows.zh: 不要求 model；读取单图结构，在 CPU 上训练
rows.en: No model required; single-graph structure, trained on CPU

rows.zh: 随机游走正负上下文学习；保存节点嵌入向量
rows.en: Positive/negative random-walk context learning; saved node embeddings

rows.zh: 必填 model：APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER；单图特征与结构
rows.en: Required model: APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER; single-graph features and structure

rows.zh: 这些名称目前共享同一个 GNN 边重构训练分支
rows.en: These names currently share the same GNN edge-reconstruction training branch

text.zh: 已注册的骨干网络名称为 APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER；SAGE 对应 GraphSAGE。pretrain 必须填写 method；其余三个监督任务及 GNN 预训练必须填写 model。GNN 预训练方法名称不意味着分别实现了图增广对比学习、特征掩码或掩码自动编码器，应以实际损失函数为准。
text.en: Registered backbone names are APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER; SAGE means GraphSAGE. pretrain requires method, while all three supervised tasks and GNN pretraining require model. The GNN pretraining names do not establish separate graph-augmentation, feature-masking or masked-autoencoder implementations; use the actual loss described below.

text.zh: 设 N 为节点数、E 为存储边数、F 为输入特征维度、D 为输出嵌入维度。模型读取 GraphData 的节点顺序与 edge_index，不先转成文本再重建图。消息传递使用形状为 [2, E] 的边索引；语义为无向的图会生成双向边索引副本，供邻居聚合使用，不改写活动图。边权重和边属性当前没有传入当前 GNN 骨干网络。
text.en: Let N be the node count, E the stored edge count, F the input feature dimension, and D the embedding dimension. Models use GraphData's node order and edge_index directly, without converting the graph to text. Message passing uses a [2, E] edge index. Semantically undirected graphs receive a bidirectional copy for aggregation without modifying the active graph. Edge weights and edge attributes are currently not passed to the current GNN backbones.

rows.zh: 转换为 float32。[N] 扩展为 [N, 1]；高于二维时按节点展平为 [N, F]。已有特征不会自动标准化。
rows.en: Converted to float32. [N] becomes [N, 1]; tensors with more than two dimensions are flattened per node to [N, F]. Existing features are not automatically standardized.

rows.zh: 生成 [入度, 出度, 总度, 常数 1]，得到 [N, 4]；每列除以该列最大值与 1 中的较大者。
rows.en: Generate [in-degree, out-degree, total degree, constant 1] with shape [N, 4]; divide each column by the larger of its maximum and 1.

rows.zh: 标量类别值映射到连续类别索引；缺失标签不进入监督样本。训练需要足够的已标注节点和至少两个类别。
rows.en: Scalar class values are mapped to contiguous class indices. Missing labels are excluded from supervision. Training needs enough labeled nodes and at least two classes.

rows.zh: 沿类别维度取 argmax；行和为零的节点视为未标注。这是单标签分类路径，不是多标签节点分类。
rows.en: Take argmax across classes; zero-sum rows are treated as unlabeled. This is a single-label classification path, not multi-label node classification.

rows.zh: 使用 upstream_model_id 的embedding.npy，按 node_names.json 中的节点名对齐；新图中未匹配的节点填零向量。
rows.en: Use embedding.npy from upstream_model_id, aligned by names in node_names.json; unmatched nodes in the new graph receive zero vectors.

text.zh: data.feature_source 默认是 graph。改为 embedding 时，还必须给出同一会话作用域内的 upstream_model_id；上游模型必须实际保存了节点嵌入文件。这个选项复用的是输入特征，不会载入上游 GNN 权重继续优化，也不恢复优化器状态。节点名变化会影响对齐结果，因此复用前应检查名称一致性与缺失匹配数量。
text.en: data.feature_source defaults to graph. Setting it to embedding also requires an upstream_model_id in the same session scope, and that model must contain saved node embeddings. This reuses input features; it neither resumes the upstream GNN's weights nor restores optimizer state. Node-name changes affect alignment, so check naming consistency and missing matches before reuse.

title.zh: 节点分类：标签划分与训练
title.en: Node classification: labels, splits, and training

text.zh: 节点分类先生成 [N, F] 特征，再由 GNN 得到 [N, D] 嵌入，最后用线性分类头映射到 [N, C] 类别分数。每轮对整张图做一次训练前向传播，仅对训练节点的分数计算交叉熵并反向传播。优化完成后切换到评估模式，在同一张图上重新计算训练准确率与验证准确率，关闭 dropout 对评估的随机影响。
text.en: Node classification maps [N, F] features through a GNN to [N, D] embeddings, then applies a linear head to produce [N, C] class logits. Each epoch performs a full-graph training forward pass and computes cross-entropy only on training nodes. After optimization, evaluation mode recomputes training and validation accuracy on the same graph with dropout disabled.

items.zh: data.target_nodes 可将监督范围限制到指定节点名；无法识别或没有标签的节点不会成为有效监督样本。
items.en: data.target_nodes can restrict supervision to named nodes; unrecognized or unlabeled nodes are not usable supervised examples.

items.zh: 若图有 train_mask，训练集采用该掩码并与已标注节点相交。验证集优先采用 val_mask；没有 val_mask 时会使用 test_mask；两者都没有时使用其余已标注节点。
items.en: If train_mask exists, training uses its intersection with labeled nodes. Validation prefers val_mask, falls back to test_mask, and otherwise uses the remaining labeled nodes.

items.zh: 若图没有 train_mask，则用 seed 打乱已标注节点，按 train / (train + val) 划分。默认比例为 0.8 / 0.2；兼容字段 train_config.split.test 不参与此流程。
items.en: Without train_mask, labeled nodes are shuffled using seed and split by train / (train + val), defaulting to 0.8 / 0.2. The compatibility field train_config.split.test is not used by this flow.

items.zh: 随机划分仅用于该次训练，不会回写成图的 train_mask 或 val_mask。后续 infer 的 query.split 读取原图掩码，不能用它索引一份未持久化的随机划分。
items.en: Random splits are local to the training run and are not written into graph masks. infer query.split reads the original graph's masks and cannot retrieve an unpersisted random split.

text.zh: 模型选择指标是 val_acc。只有本轮验证准确率严格大于 best_val_acc + early_stop_min_delta 才更新最佳训练检查点；相同准确率不会因训练损失更低而替换检查点。训练结束后恢复最佳骨干网络与分类头，返回 train_loss、train_acc、val_acc、best_epoch、trained_epochs、stopped_early 等指标。若 test_mask 被用作验证集，这次运行没有独立的测试评估，应据实报告该评估协议。
text.en: Model selection uses val_acc. A checkpoint improves only when validation accuracy is strictly greater than best_val_acc + early_stop_min_delta; equal accuracy does not replace it for a lower training loss. Training restores the best backbone and head and reports train_loss, train_acc, val_acc, best_epoch, trained_epochs, and stopped_early. If test_mask served as validation, the run has no independent test evaluation; report that protocol explicitly.

title.zh: 链接预测：采样、解码与指标
title.en: Link prediction: sampling, decoding, and metrics

text.zh: 链接预测从图的逻辑边生成正样本，或读取 data.target_edges 中的节点名二元组；训练至少需要两条正边。正边经 seed 打乱后划分为训练与验证部分。验证负边从非自环、图中不存在的节点对中采样，固定使用 seed + 11 并去重；无向图会考虑反向边等价性。采样有尝试次数上限，因此稠密图可能得到少于请求数量的负样本。
text.en: Link prediction takes positive examples from logical graph edges or named pairs in data.target_edges; at least two positive edges are required. Positives are shuffled with seed and split into training and validation sets. Validation negatives are unique, non-self pairs absent from the graph, sampled with seed + 11 and undirected equivalence where applicable. Attempts are bounded, so dense graphs can yield fewer negatives than requested.

text.zh: 骨干网络输出节点嵌入 z，节点对的原始分数为 z[u] 与 z[v] 的内积，sigmoid 后得到 prob。每轮训练使用 PyG negative_sampling 生成负样本，损失为正边二元交叉熵与负边二元交叉熵之和。该内积解码器是对称的，即使原图是有向图，u→v 与 v→u 也得到相同分数；模型没有独立的关系类型或方向解码头。
text.en: The backbone produces node embeddings z. A pair's raw score is the dot product of z[u] and z[v], converted to prob with sigmoid. Each epoch uses PyG negative_sampling, and the loss sums binary cross-entropy for positive and negative edges. This decoder is symmetric: u→v and v→u have the same score even on a directed graph. There is no separate relation-type or directional decoder.

text.zh: 每轮在固定验证正负样本上计算 val_auc，并搜索分类阈值以提高验证准确率。分数种类较多时，阈值候选压缩为一组分位点。最佳检查点主要按 val_auc 选择，在 AUC 差值处于 min_delta 范围时再比较 val_acc；选中的 threshold 随模型保存。这里的 AUC 使用本模块的秩统计实现，与处理并列分数的其他评估库可能存在差异。
text.en: Each epoch computes val_auc on fixed validation positives and negatives and searches a threshold for validation accuracy. With many distinct scores, candidates are reduced to quantiles. Checkpoint selection primarily uses val_auc, breaking comparisons within min_delta using val_acc. The selected threshold is saved. AUC uses this module's rank-based implementation, which can differ from other libraries in how tied scores are handled.

text.zh: 这一训练流程只划分用于计算损失和指标的正边集合，GNN 的消息传递仍读取活动图完整的邻接关系，包括验证正边。因此这些指标不能直接当作‘从训练邻接中完全移除验证边’的链接预测基准结果。若目标是严格的未知边泛化实验，需要另行实现训练邻接隔离与一致的负样本协议。
text.en: This flow splits the positives used for loss and metrics, but GNN message passing still uses the active graph's complete adjacency, including validation positives. Its metrics are therefore not equivalent to a benchmark that removes validation edges from training adjacency. Strict unseen-edge generalization experiments require a separate adjacency-isolation and negative-sampling protocol.

title.zh: 预训练与嵌入向量复用

text.zh: Node2Vec 根据图结构采样随机游走，通过正负上下文损失学习节点向量。当前使用稀疏参数与 SparseAdam，计算固定在 CPU 上；指定 GPU 不会把这个分支变为 GPU 随机游走训练。walk_length、context_size、walks_per_node、num_negative_samples、p、q 控制游走与采样，批大小读取 algo_config.batch_size，默认 128，而不是图分类使用的 train_config.batch_size。
text.en: Node2Vec samples random walks and learns node vectors using positive and negative context losses. It uses sparse parameters and SparseAdam on CPU; selecting a GPU does not move this branch's walk training to the GPU. walk_length, context_size, walks_per_node, num_negative_samples, p, and q control sampling. Its batch size comes from algo_config.batch_size, default 128, rather than graph classification's train_config.batch_size.

text.zh: Node2Vec 默认 walk_length=20、context_size=10、walks_per_node=10、num_negative_samples=1、p=q=1；训练器在未传 embedding_dim 时使用 128。为避免不同任务默认值带来误解，示例显式填写嵌入维度。该分支运行完整 epochs，忽略 weight_decay 和早停选项；结束时保存最后一轮的embedding.npy，不保存可继续训练的 Node2Vec 训练检查点。
text.en: Node2Vec defaults to walk_length=20, context_size=10, walks_per_node=10, num_negative_samples=1, and p=q=1; its trainer uses embedding_dim=128 when omitted. Examples set the dimension explicitly to avoid confusion between task defaults. This branch runs all epochs, ignores weight_decay and early-stopping options, and saves final embedding.npy without a resumable Node2Vec checkpoint.

text.zh: GNN 预训练读取图特征和完整边索引，用节点嵌入内积重构正边，并对负采样边计算二元交叉熵。已命名的 contrastive_learning、graph_contrastive_learning、mask_autoencoding、graph_mask_autoencoding 都执行这一流程；没有各自独立的视图增广、掩码率或重构特征损失。它使用 Adam，保存最终骨干网络与节点嵌入，不执行验证集选择或早停。
text.en: GNN pretraining reads graph features and the complete edge index, reconstructing positive edges with embedding dot products and applying binary cross-entropy to sampled negatives. contrastive_learning, graph_contrastive_learning, mask_autoencoding, and graph_mask_autoencoding all follow this flow; they have no separate view augmentation, masking ratio, or feature-reconstruction loss. It uses Adam and saves the final backbone and embeddings, without validation selection or early stopping.

text.zh: 预训练模型的 infer 是已保存嵌入向量的查询接口：按 query.nodes 返回训练时已有节点的向量，或者按 infer_config.limit 返回前若干项，默认 200。即使 GNN 预训练保存了骨干网络，当前推理路径也不会对新图重新执行 GNN 前向传播。要为更新后的图生成新的向量，需要重新运行预训练；要将这些向量用于节点分类或链接预测，可选择 data.feature_source=embedding并填写上游 model_id。
text.en: Pretraining infer looks up saved embeddings: query.nodes selects nodes present during training, or infer_config.limit returns an initial subset, default 200. Even when a GNN checkpoint exists, this inference path does not run the GNN on a new graph. Rerun pretraining to generate embeddings for an updated graph; to use saved vectors for node classification or link prediction, set data.feature_source=embedding and provide the upstream model_id.

title.zh: 分子图分类的数据结构

text.zh: 图分类的数据单元是一张图，HIV 是 1 个二分类任务，PCBA 是 128 个二分类任务。load_graph_classification_dataset 读取会话上传目录中的 .pt 文件，dataset_profile 可设为 auto、hiv 或 pcba；数据集经校验后绑定到会话，并返回 dataset_id。它独立于活动单图：load_graph_classification_graph 可以抽取一张样本用于查看，但不会把多图训练转变为节点分类。
text.en: The unit of graph classification is an entire graph. HIV has one binary task; PCBA has 128. load_graph_classification_dataset reads a .pt file from the session upload directory with dataset_profile set to auto, hiv, or pcba, validates it, binds it to the session, and returns dataset_id. This collection is separate from the active single graph. load_graph_classification_graph can extract one sample for inspection without converting graph classification into node classification.

rows.zh: 非空 PyG Data 列表；每张图包含 x、xe、edge_index、y 张量，节点数必须大于零。
rows.en: A nonempty list of PyG Data objects; each graph contains x, xe, edge_index, and y tensors and at least one node.

rows.zh: 一维整型 [N]，存放节点类别编号；编号非负且在节点词表范围内。它不是节点的全局身份编号，也不是二维连续属性矩阵。
rows.en: An integer [N] vector of nonnegative node-category IDs within the node vocabulary. These are not global node identities or a two-dimensional continuous feature matrix.

rows.zh: xe 为一维整型 [E] 边类别编号；edge_index 为 [2, E] 整型索引且端点不越界。边类别必须由边词表覆盖。
rows.en: xe is an integer [E] vector of edge-category IDs; edge_index is an integer [2, E] tensor with valid endpoints. Categories must be covered by the edge vocabulary.

rows.zh: 每图 [T] 或 [1, T]，归一为 float32 [1, T]；允许 0、1、NaN，拒绝无穷值和其他标签值。全部图的 T 一致。
rows.en: Per-graph [T] or [1, T], normalized to float32 [1, T]; only 0, 1, and NaN are allowed, with infinities and other values rejected. T must be consistent across graphs.

rows.zh: 至少包含三个字符串列表，依次表示节点、边和标签文本；用于词表和描述，不会自动生成语言模型嵌入。
rows.en: At least three string lists for node, edge, and label text; these provide vocabularies and descriptions, not automatic language-model embeddings.

rows.zh: split[0] 包含 train、valid（或 val）、test 图索引列表；索引不重复、不重叠并覆盖全部图。split[1] 是 prompt/few-shot 元数据字典，只保留摘要，不改变训练采样。
rows.en: split[0] contains train, valid (or val), and test graph-index lists with no duplicates or overlap and complete graph coverage. split[1] is prompt/few-shot metadata whose summary is retained without changing training sampling.

text.zh: 图分类训练使用数据文件的固定划分，不能提交 train_config.split。它不接受 graph_version、method、upstream_model_id、data.target_nodes、data.target_edges 或嵌入向量特征来源。可显式传 data.dataset_id，也可使用当前绑定的数据集；其他任务不能使用这个字段。加载器计算完整文件 SHA-256 指纹，推理会据此验证数据身份，文件名相同并不代表数据相同。
text.en: Graph-classification training uses the file's fixed splits and rejects train_config.split. It does not accept graph_version, method, upstream_model_id, data.target_nodes, data.target_edges, or embedding feature input. Supply data.dataset_id explicitly or use the bound dataset; other tasks cannot use that field. The loader computes a full-file SHA-256 fingerprint that inference checks for dataset identity; an identical filename alone is insufficient.

title.zh: 模型结构、训练循环与评估

text.zh: 已注册骨干网络包括多层图卷积、注意力聚合和 APPNP 传播结构。常用默认值为 hidden_dim=64、num_layers=2、dropout=0.2；GNN 的 embedding_dim 省略时跟随 hidden_dim，因此在 hidden_dim 未改动时为 64。GAT、GATV2 与 TRANSFORMER 使用 gat_heads=2、concat=False。APPNP 先做多层线性预测，再执行个性化传播，默认 appnp_k=10、appnp_alpha=0.1。use_residual_connection 与 use_normalization 默认关闭；归一化支持 rms_norm、layer_norm、batch_norm，norm_pos 为 pre 或 post。
text.en: Registered backbones include multilayer graph convolutions, attention aggregation and APPNP propagation. Common defaults are hidden_dim=64, num_layers=2 and dropout=0.2. GNN embedding_dim follows hidden_dim when omitted, so it is 64 when hidden_dim is unchanged. GAT, GATV2 and TRANSFORMER use gat_heads=2 with concat=False. APPNP applies multilayer linear prediction followed by personalized propagation, defaulting to appnp_k=10 and appnp_alpha=0.1. use_residual_connection and use_normalization default to false; normalization supports rms_norm, layer_norm or batch_norm, with pre or post placement.

text.zh: 图分类先对节点类别做可训练的 nn.Embedding 编码，再经过 GNN、global_mean_pool 和线性图分类头。一个批次将多张图的节点与边拼接，用 batch 向量记录节点所属图：节点嵌入为 [ΣN, D]，池化结果为 [B, D]，最终 logits 为 [B, T]。train_config.batch_size 默认 64，num_workers 默认 0；训练批次打乱，验证与测试按固定顺序读取，不丢弃最后一个不足批大小的批次。
text.en: Graph classification begins with a trainable nn.Embedding of node categories, followed by the GNN, global_mean_pool, and a linear graph head. Batching concatenates nodes and edges and records graph membership in a batch vector: node embeddings are [ΣN, D], pooled features [B, D], and final logits [B, T]. train_config.batch_size defaults to 64 and num_workers to 0. Training batches shuffle; validation and test preserve order, and incomplete final batches are retained.

text.zh: 图分类采用带缺失标签掩码的 BCEWithLogitsLoss：仅在标签非 NaN 的位置取平均，一个批次全部缺失时跳过优化。训练集整轮没有有效标签会失败。HIV 用 ROC-AUC 选最佳模型；PCBA 对可评估任务分别计算 AP，再对这些任务取宏平均，同时记录有效与跳过的任务数。只有单一类别或全部缺失的任务无法贡献该指标，不能把 PCBA 指标表述为无条件平均全部 128 项。
text.en: Graph classification uses masked binary cross-entropy with logits, averaging only non-NaN labels. Batches with no observed labels skip optimization; an epoch with no valid training labels fails. HIV selects models by ROC-AUC. PCBA computes AP for each evaluable task and macro-averages those tasks, recording valid and skipped counts. Tasks with only one class or entirely missing labels do not contribute, so the result is not an unconditional mean over all 128 tasks.

text.zh: 三个监督任务使用 Adam。early_stop_patience=0 关闭早停，正整数表示连续多少轮没有改进后停止；early_stop_min_delta 默认 0，两个参数不能为负。图分类每轮只评估验证集，验证指标严格超过最佳值加 min_delta 才更新检查点；最终恢复最佳权重，再对测试集评估一次。预训练两个分支均没有这套验证选择和早停逻辑，不能把统一请求字段的存在理解为所有任务都执行它。
text.en: All three supervised tasks use Adam. early_stop_patience=0 disables early stopping; a positive integer sets consecutive non-improving epochs before stopping. early_stop_min_delta defaults to 0; neither value may be negative. Graph classification evaluates validation each epoch and updates the checkpoint only on strict improvement beyond min_delta. It restores the best weights and evaluates test once afterward. Neither pretraining branch implements this validation-selection and early-stopping flow.

rows.zh: 默认 200 / 0.05 / 0.0；示例显式设置学习率，数值不是调参结论。Node2Vec 使用 SparseAdam，忽略 weight_decay。
rows.en: Defaults are 200 / 0.05 / 0.0. Examples explicitly set the learning rate without claiming optimal tuning. Node2Vec uses SparseAdam and ignores weight_decay.

rows.zh: 默认 42，设置 Python、NumPy、PyTorch 与 CUDA 随机种子；多图 DataLoader 也使用种子与工作进程初始化。
rows.en: Defaults to 42 and seeds Python, NumPy, PyTorch, and CUDA. Multi-graph DataLoaders also use seeded generators and worker initialization.

rows.zh: cpu / cuda / auto；请求不可用的 CUDA 会失败。auto 无 GPU 时使用 CPU，多 GPU 时按空闲显存及可用利用率信息选择。Node2Vec 实际固定 CPU。
rows.en: cpu / cuda / auto; requesting unavailable CUDA fails. auto uses CPU without GPUs and chooses among GPUs using free memory and available utilization data. Node2Vec itself remains on CPU.

rows.zh: 训练逐轮报告损失与对应评估指标；监督任务报告 best_epoch、trained_epochs、stopped_early。检查这些字段以区分计划轮数、实际轮数和采用的权重。
rows.en: Training reports per-epoch loss and task metrics. Supervised tasks include best_epoch, trained_epochs, and stopped_early to distinguish scheduled epochs, actual epochs, and selected weights.

title.zh: 工具调用：提交训练与读取结果
title.en: Tool calls: submit training and retrieve results

text.zh: 以下 JSON 都是工具参数对象，在已验证身份并绑定会话的 MCP / 智能体工具环境中使用。参数示例展示数据结构，不包含测得的性能或最佳超参数。单图训练前先加载具备相应标签或结构的数据；分子图分类则先上传数据文件并执行数据集加载工具。示例中的文件名、dataset_id、model_id 与节点名应替换为实际返回值和真实数据名称。
text.en: The JSON below contains tool argument objects for an authenticated, session-bound MCP or agent tool environment. These examples demonstrate request structure, not measured performance or optimal hyperparameters. Load a suitable labeled or structured single graph before single-graph training; for molecular classification, upload and load the dataset first. Replace filenames, dataset_id, model_id, and node names with actual results and data names.

text.zh: 节点分类：调用 train，使用活动图特征，按验证准确率选择模型。对于没有 train_mask 的图，split 控制本次随机划分。
text.en: Node classification: call train with active-graph features and validation-accuracy model selection. split controls the run's random partition when train_mask is absent.

text.zh: 链接预测：调用 train，使用图中的逻辑边作为正样本。需要限定监督正边时可提供 data.target_edges，其元素是两个节点名组成的数组。
text.en: Link prediction: call train with logical graph edges as positives. To restrict supervised positives, provide data.target_edges as arrays of two node names.

text.zh: Node2Vec：调用 train，显式给出嵌入维度、随机游走配置和该分支的批大小。
text.en: Node2Vec: call train with an explicit embedding dimension, random-walk settings, and this branch's batch size.

text.zh: 分子图分类：先调用 load_graph_classification_dataset；加载完成后把返回的 dataset_id 填入第二个对象，并用它调用 train。
text.en: Molecular graph classification: first call load_graph_classification_dataset. After loading completes, insert its dataset_id into the second object and call train.

text.zh: 直接使用 MCP 时，长任务可能先返回 job_id。用 get_job_status 查询作业；首次传 after_seq=0，后续将返回的 progress_cursor 作为 after_seq 增量读取进度；progress_has_more=true 时继续翻页。完成状态为 job.status=done，训练结果位于 job.result；确认结果 success=true 后读取 model_id，再提交 infer。智能体的 GraphMCPTools 包装会自动等待并解析这些作业，通常直接交付最终结果。
text.en: Direct MCP calls may initially return job_id for long-running work. Poll get_job_status; start with after_seq=0, then pass the returned progress_cursor as after_seq for incremental progress, continuing while progress_has_more=true. Completion is job.status=done, with the training result under job.result. Confirm result success=true, read model_id, then call infer. The agent's GraphMCPTools wrapper automatically waits for and resolves these jobs, normally delivering the final result.

text.zh: 也可用 get_job_result(job_id=...) 读取最终输出。查询成功不等于训练完成：先确认返回 status=done，再检查内层训练结果的 success 与 model_id。大图算法作业的结果是摘要、预览和结果文件引用，不应当作图学习 model_id 使用。
text.en: get_job_result(job_id=...) also retrieves final output. Successful lookup is not training completion: first confirm status=done, then check the inner training success and model_id. Large-graph algorithm output consists of summaries, previews and artifact references, not a graph-learning model_id.

text.zh: infer 根据模型元数据选择任务分支。节点分类与链接预测重新构造骨干网络、加载训练检查点，在当前图上执行前向传播；图分类重新加载模型对应的数据集并检查身份；预训练返回保存的节点向量。返回的 model_id、task 与图版本或数据集标识可用于确认结果来自哪个模型和输入。
text.en: infer dispatches using saved task metadata. Node classification and link prediction rebuild the backbone, load its checkpoint, and run on the current graph. Graph classification resolves and verifies its dataset. Pretraining returns stored node vectors. The returned model_id, task, and graph-version or dataset identifier identify the model and input behind the result.

text.zh: 节点分类按节点名查询：predictions 包含 pred_class_idx、pred_label 等类别信息，标签可用时还返回真实标签及正确性；开启 return_prob 可取各类别概率。result_limit 与 result_offset 仅分页明细，评估基于请求的完整节点集合。空 query 返回划分评估摘要和抽样预测；query.split 仅能选择图中实际存在的掩码。
text.en: For node-name queries, predictions contain class information such as pred_class_idx and pred_label, plus true labels and correctness when available. Enable return_prob for class probabilities. result_limit and result_offset paginate details while evaluation covers all requested nodes. An empty query returns split evaluation summaries and sampled predictions; query.split requires an actual graph mask.

text.zh: 链接预测可指定 query.edges，也可给出 source_node 与 candidate_nodes 做候选排序。每条结果包含 score、prob、pred 与 exists_in_graph；判定使用模型保存的验证阈值。候选列表可以包含已有边，调用方可根据 exists_in_graph 筛选。空 query 会搜索非边候选，虽然 max_candidate_pairs 限制保留和评分的候选量，生成阶段仍遍历节点对，大图上优先提供明确候选范围。
text.en: Link prediction accepts query.edges or source_node with candidate_nodes for ranking. Each prediction contains score, prob, pred, and exists_in_graph, using the saved validation threshold. Candidates may include existing edges, which callers can filter by exists_in_graph. An empty query searches nonedges: max_candidate_pairs bounds retained/scored candidates, but generation still iterates over node pairs. Prefer explicit candidates for large graphs.

text.zh: 图分类 query.split 可选 train、val、test，空 query 默认 test；也可用 graph_indices 指定图索引，二者不能同时出现。HIV 明细含 probability、predicted_label 和 true_label；PCBA 默认返回概率最高的 5 个任务，可用 top_k_tasks 调整，return_all_task_probs=true 返回完整任务概率。evaluation 对完整请求集合计算，count 为请求图数，returned_count 为本页数量，truncated 表示仍有明细未显示。
text.en: Graph classification accepts query.split=train, val, or test, defaulting to test for an empty query, or explicit graph_indices; these options are mutually exclusive. HIV details include probability, predicted_label, and true_label. PCBA defaults to the five highest-probability tasks, configurable with top_k_tasks; return_all_task_probs=true includes complete task probabilities. evaluation covers the full query, count is the requested graph count, returned_count is the page size, and truncated indicates omitted details.

text.zh: 图分类推理接受 infer_config.device；节点分类与链接预测的推理路径当前自动选择设备，不能假定相同字段对它们具有相同作用。对于预训练模型，下面的调用只读取已有节点向量，返回 embeddings 数组，每项包含 node 与 embedding（数值向量）。
text.en: Graph-classification inference accepts infer_config.device. Node-classification and link-prediction inference currently select a device automatically, so the same field should not be assumed to control them. For a pretrained model, the following call only reads saved node vectors, returning an embeddings array of node and embedding entries.

title.zh: 模型文件、版本绑定与复现
title.en: Model files, version binding, and reproducibility

text.zh: 训练产物存放在 Graph Engine 的模型目录中，默认根目录为 artifacts/graph_ml，可通过 GRAPH_ML_ARTIFACT_ROOT 配置。模型目录按运行时的用户与会话作用域隔离，model_id 指向具体一次训练产物。图机器学习模块按需初始化；受控工作进程执行训练时先写入暂存目录，Graph Engine 验证作业仍有效后发布模型文件。收到 job_id 本身不等于模型已经可用。
text.en: Training outputs live in Graph Engine's model directory, defaulting to artifacts/graph_ml and configurable with GRAPH_ML_ARTIFACT_ROOT. Directories are isolated by runtime user/session scope, and model_id identifies one training output. Graph ML initializes lazily. Controlled workers write staging outputs, which Graph Engine publishes after validating that the job remains eligible. Receiving job_id does not mean the model is already available.

headers.zh: 模型目录中的主要文件
headers.en: Main files in a model directory

rows.zh: checkpoint.pt：backbone 与 head；meta.json：模型结构、特征来源、类别映射、graph_version；metrics.json 与 node_names.json。
rows.en: checkpoint.pt: backbone and head; meta.json: architecture, feature source, label mapping, and graph_version; metrics.json and node_names.json.

rows.zh: checkpoint.pt：backbone；meta.json 另记录 threshold；metrics.json 与 node_names.json。
rows.en: checkpoint.pt: backbone; meta.json also records threshold; metrics.json and node_names.json.
embedding.npy, node_names.json, meta.json, and metrics.json; no checkpoint.pt.
checkpoint.pt: backbone; plus embedding.npy, node_names.json, meta.json, and metrics.json.

rows.zh: checkpoint.pt：model 权重；meta.json：数据集指纹、词表大小、任务数、模型配置与划分大小；metrics.json、per_task_metrics.json。
rows.en: checkpoint.pt: model weights; meta.json: dataset fingerprint, vocabulary sizes, task count, model configuration, and split sizes; metrics.json and per_task_metrics.json.

text.zh: 单图 train 的 graph_version 是对当前活动版本的校验，并不会自动加载历史图。需要旧版本时先调用 load_graph_version，再训练。节点分类与链接预测推理默认要求当前图版本等于训练版本；infer_config.allow_version_mismatch=true 可跳过这项版本限制，但不会解决输入维度、标签语义或上游嵌入不兼容。预训练向量查询校验的是已保存模型版本，不依赖当前活动图；图分类则绑定 dataset_id 与完整数据集指纹。
text.en: Single-graph train treats graph_version as an assertion about the active version, not a request to load history. Call load_graph_version first to train on an older version. Node-classification and link-prediction inference require the active version to match training by default. infer_config.allow_version_mismatch=true skips this version check but cannot resolve incompatible input dimensions, label semantics, or upstream embeddings. Pretrained-vector lookup checks saved model version without relying on the active graph; graph classification binds dataset_id and the full dataset fingerprint.

text.zh: 复现实验时应另行保存完整 train 请求、源数据文件及指纹、图版本、上游 model_id、依赖版本和实际设备。现有元数据记录模型结构及结果，但没有完整保存所有训练超参数、随机数状态和优化器状态，也没有公开的断点续训接口。seed 控制主要随机源，却没有开启强制确定性算法；GPU 内核和软件环境变化仍可能造成结果差异，因此不能仅凭相同 seed 保证逐位一致。
text.en: For reproducible experiments, separately preserve the complete train request, source data and fingerprint, graph version, upstream model_id, dependency versions, and actual device. Metadata records architecture and results but does not preserve every training hyperparameter, RNG state, or optimizer state, and there is no public resume-training endpoint. seed controls major random sources but deterministic algorithms are not enforced; GPU kernels and environment changes can still affect results, so matching seed alone does not guarantee bitwise reproducibility.

text.zh: visualize_model_architecture 接收 model_id，读取保存的模型配置用于检查结构。结构图描述网络层与计算路径，不代替任务指标。比较实验时同时查看最佳轮次、实际训练轮数、数据划分协议、验证与测试样本是否独立，以及 PCBA 有效任务数量。
text.en: visualize_model_architecture accepts model_id and reads saved model configuration for architecture inspection. The visualization explains layers and computation, not predictive quality. When comparing runs, inspect best epoch, actual epochs, split protocol, validation/test independence, and PCBA's evaluable-task count alongside metrics.

items.zh: 图分类使用节点类别嵌入、已注册骨干网络（APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER）、固定全局均值池化和图级线性头。xe 已读取、校验和保留，但不进入前向传播；模型元数据记录 uses_edge_features=false。不能据此宣称模型利用了分子键类型。
items.en: Graph classification uses node-category embeddings, a registered backbone (APPNP / GCN / GAT / GATV2 / GEN / GIN / SAGE / TRANSFORMER), fixed global mean pooling and a graph-level linear head. xe is loaded, validated and retained but does not enter the forward pass; metadata records uses_edge_features=false. This implementation does not establish use of molecular bond types.

items.zh: GIN 已注册，GINE 与可切换图池化尚未提供；HIV / PCBA 加载路径也不等价于支持任意 OGB 数据集。多图任务要求约定的 .pt 数据结构与固定划分，不能在 train 中任意指定新指标或重划测试集。
items.en: GIN is registered; GINE and selectable graph pooling are not provided. The HIV/PCBA loader does not imply support for arbitrary OGB datasets. Multi-graph tasks require the specified .pt structure and fixed splits; train does not accept arbitrary new metrics or resplit the test set.

items.zh: 单图监督任务和 GNN 预训练使用整图前向传播，没有邻居采样小批训练。train_config.batch_size 不会降低这些路径的整图特征和中间激活显存需求；它用于图分类，Node2Vec 则使用自己的批大小字段。
items.en: Single-graph supervised tasks and GNN pretraining use full-graph forward passes without neighbor-sampled minibatches. train_config.batch_size does not reduce their full-graph feature or activation memory; it applies to graph classification, while Node2Vec has its own batch-size field.

items.zh: 二维节点标签经 argmax 进入单标签分类；分子图分类的 [B, T] 独立二分类才具有多任务标签语义。不要把两者的数据形状相似理解为同一种训练目标。
items.en: Two-dimensional node labels enter single-label classification through argmax. Molecular graph classification instead uses [B, T] independent binary tasks. Similar tensor shapes do not imply the same learning objective.

items.zh: 链接预测验证边仍参与消息传递，内积解码不区分方向；GNN 预训练方法名当前共享边重构实现。这些实现边界需要与指标一起说明，才能正确比较模型与研究基线。
items.en: Link-prediction validation edges remain in message passing and its dot-product decoder is direction-invariant. Named GNN pretraining methods share edge reconstruction. Describe these boundaries alongside metrics for meaningful comparison with research baselines.

items.zh: 当前接口没有提供自动超参数搜索、类别加权损失、学习率调度器、优化器状态恢复或跨环境确定性保证。本页示例是可理解的调用配置，不包含尚未执行的性能测试结论。
items.en: The current interface provides no automatic hyperparameter search, class-weighted loss, learning-rate scheduler, optimizer-state restoration, or cross-environment determinism guarantee. The examples explain request configurations and do not claim unperformed performance measurements.

description.zh: 面向客户端的 Backend HTTP 接口：身份、项目、会话、数据集、构图、文件、记忆与技能。示例请求发送到已运行的 iGraph 服务，文档站本身不执行 API。
description.en: Backend HTTP interfaces for identity, projects, sessions, datasets, construction, files, memory, and skills. Examples target a running iGraph service; the documentation site itself does not execute API calls.

text.zh: 本指南默认使用 Compose 的公共入口 http://localhost:21108；单独运行 Backend 时，可改为 http://localhost:21109。所有业务 API 使用 /api 前缀。JSON 请求带 Content-Type: application/json；上传使用 multipart/form-data。运行服务的 /openapi.json 提供完整机器可读定义，/docs 打开 Swagger。
text.en: Examples use the Compose public entry point http://localhost:21108. When running Backend separately, use http://localhost:21109 instead. Business APIs use /api. Send Content-Type: application/json for JSON and multipart/form-data for uploads. The running service serves its complete schema at /openapi.json and Swagger at /docs.

text.zh: 表中的 {sid}、{pid}、{did} 分别代表服务端返回的 session_id、project_id、dataset_id；{rid} 为 run_id，{jid} 为 job_id。路径缩写只用于阅读，实际调用时替换为对应标识。以下为主要入口索引，字段约束与完整响应以同一部署的 /openapi.json 为准。
text.en: In the tables, {sid}, {pid}, and {did} represent server-issued session_id, project_id, and dataset_id; {rid} is run_id and {jid} is job_id. Replace these readability abbreviations with the corresponding identifiers. This is an index of main entry points; use /openapi.json from the same deployment for complete request constraints and response schemas.

text.zh: 请求头 X-User-ID 为已启用用户的 ID；不需要请求体。有效身份返回用户和模型权限信息，无效身份返回 valid: false。其他业务接口缺少、无效或禁用的用户返回 401。管理员接口额外检查 admin 角色，缺失时返回 403。
text.en: Set X-User-ID to an enabled user ID. No body is required. Valid identities return user and model information; invalid identities return valid: false. Other business endpoints return 401 for missing, invalid, or disabled users. Admin endpoints also require the admin role and return 403 otherwise.

text.zh: 当前接口校验用户目录，不是密码认证或 JWT/OAuth。对外部署 Backend 时应使用可信身份网关，不要把用户 ID 当成秘密令牌。模型 API Key 属于模型服务配置，IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY 属于内部服务调用，都不能作为 X-User-ID 使用。公开只读文档站不需要这些应用凭据。
text.en: The interface validates a user directory; it is not password authentication or JWT/OAuth. Use a trusted identity gateway for an externally exposed Backend and do not treat a user ID as a secret token. Model API keys configure model services, and IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY authenticates internal service calls; neither substitutes for X-User-ID. The public read-only documentation site needs none of these application credentials.

rows.zh: 可选客户端幂等 UUID，最长 64 字符；非 UUID 返回 400。
rows.en: Optional client idempotency UUID, up to 64 characters; invalid UUIDs return 400.

rows.zh: 可选模型 ID；服务端校验用户权限。
rows.en: Optional model ID, checked against user permissions.

rows.zh: 项目归属；null 为非项目会话。
rows.en: Project ownership; null for a non-project session.

rows.zh: 可选当前数据集；必须具有访问权限。
rows.en: Optional active dataset; access is required.

rows.zh: 最长 1000 字符；作为会话标题等元信息。
rows.en: Up to 1,000 characters, used for session metadata such as title.

text.zh: 成功响应包含 success、session_id，以及当前 model、project_id、active_dataset_id 等信息。复用客户端 ID 时可能返回 reused: true。创建会话后调用 chat/stream 发送消息。
text.en: Successful responses include success, session_id, and information such as model, project_id, and active_dataset_id. Reusing a client ID may return reused: true. Send a message using chat/stream after creation.

rows.zh: 列出 / 创建当前用户的会话
rows.en: List / create sessions for the current user

rows.zh: 激活会话并恢复可用状态
rows.en: Activate a session and restore available state

rows.zh: 读取持久化消息与可恢复的界面内容
rows.en: Read persisted messages and recoverable UI content

rows.zh: 会话信息、活动数据和运行状态
rows.en: Session metadata, active data, and run state

rows.zh: 更新会话名称等元数据
rows.en: Update session metadata such as the title

rows.zh: 切换有权限使用的模型
删除会话；活动任务可能要求先停止
rows.en: Delete a session; active work may need to stop first
Submit a message and receive SSE

rows.zh: 提交工具审批决定并继续原运行
rows.en: Submit a tool-approval decision and continue the original run

rows.zh: 从 last_event_index 继续观察已有运行
rows.en: Resume observing a run from last_event_index

rows.zh: 读取阶段快照；检查 snapshot_complete
rows.en: Read a phase snapshot; inspect snapshot_complete

rows.zh: 读取停止与最新一轮编辑的能力开关
rows.en: Read cancellation and latest-turn editing capabilities

rows.zh: 停止指定运行，需要启用 run_cancel_v1
rows.en: Stop a targeted run when run_cancel_v1 is enabled

rows.zh: 按 run_id 或 start_request_id 查询控制状态
rows.en: Query control state by run_id or start_request_id

rows.zh: 停止指定后台作业，需要启用 job_cancel_v1
rows.en: Stop a targeted job when job_cancel_v1 is enabled

rows.zh: 查询作业停止与持久化状态
rows.en: Read job stop and persistence state

text.zh: 项目和数据集接口保留独立作用域：项目数据使用 /api/projects/{pid}/datasets，个人数据使用 /api/personal-datasets。项目下的会话与训练实验可分别从 conversations 和 training-runs 子路径读取；训练接口提供已记录实验的汇总，不会仅因读取列表而启动训练。
text.en: Project and dataset endpoints preserve separate scopes: project data uses /api/projects/{pid}/datasets, while personal data uses /api/personal-datasets. Read project sessions and recorded training experiments from the conversations and training-runs subpaths respectively. Reading the training summary does not start training.

rows.zh: 查看 / 修改 / 删除项目
项目训练记录与配置、指标、模型信息
rows.en: Recorded project training configuration, metrics, and model information

rows.zh: 列出服务器预置数据源
将可访问的服务器数据源加入项目
rows.en: Add an accessible server dataset to a project

rows.zh: 列出 / 保存当前用户自定义模型配置
rows.en: List / save custom model configuration for the current user

rows.zh: 删除当前用户的自定义模型配置
rows.en: Delete the current user’s custom model configuration

text.zh: 工作区、记忆与技能也有公共 API。技能上传使用 multipart/form-data 的 file 字段，支持 .md 和 .zip，当前 Backend 限制为 2 MiB。候选批准与工具执行审批是两个不同流程。
text.en: Workspace files, memories, and skills also have public APIs. Skill upload uses a multipart/form-data file field, accepts .md and .zip, and currently has a 2 MiB Backend limit. Candidate skill review is separate from approval of a pending tool execution.

rows.zh: 列出可见上传文件与已发布结果文件
rows.en: List visible uploads and published outputs

rows.zh: 鉴权下载 Derived 中的结果文件
rows.en: Download a Derived output with session authorization

rows.zh: 查询 / 创建记忆；GET 支持 scope、query、limit
rows.en: Query / create memory; GET accepts scope, query, and limit
Upload a skill file or archive

rows.zh: 读取全文 / 编辑 / 删除技能
rows.en: Read full content / edit / delete a skill

rows.zh: 导出当前用户已有会话中的输入输出样本
rows.en: Export input-output samples from the current user’s recorded sessions

text.zh: /api/export/sft 支持 format=alpaca、sharegpt 或 raw，以及 min_turns、require_tool_calls 筛选参数；返回包含 items 的 JSON。它导出已有记录，不代表样本已经经过质量筛选或可以直接用于训练。此接口未在当前前端提供独立的 SFT 导出按钮；文件下载、报告展示和会话样本导出应分别理解。
text.en: /api/export/sft accepts format=alpaca, sharegpt, or raw, plus min_turns and require_tool_calls filters, and returns JSON containing items. It exports recorded data, not automatically quality-reviewed or training-ready samples. The current frontend has no dedicated SFT export button; distinguish this API from workspace downloads and report display.

text.zh: 查看上述能力在当前界面中的入口与操作流程。
text.en: Find the available UI entry points and workflows.

text.zh: 请求标识、恢复游标、取消状态与审批反馈。
text.en: Request identities, recovery cursors, cancellation state, and approval feedback.

text.zh: 数据集上传使用 multipart/form-data。至少提供一个 file 或 files 文件字段；files 可重复用于多文件上传。多表 CSV 可连同描述关系的 schema JSON 组成同一数据集，具体支持的组合以返回的验证结果为准。项目和个人作用域使用各自的上传地址。
text.en: Dataset upload uses multipart/form-data. Supply at least one file or files field; repeat files for a multi-file upload. Multi-table CSV files can be combined with schema JSON describing relationships into one dataset, subject to upload validation. Use the matching project or personal endpoint.

rows.zh: 上传一个或多个文件，至少一项必填
rows.en: Upload one or more files; at least one is required

rows.zh: 可选的 CSV schema JSON 文本
可选的数据集名称和描述
可选关联会话，仍需通过归属校验
rows.en: Optional associated session, subject to ownership checks

rows.zh: 仅项目上传支持；默认 false
rows.en: Project upload only; defaults to false

text.zh: 聊天附件另用 POST /api/sessions/{sid}/upload 的 file 字段。响应中的 file_token 用于后续聊天请求，workspace_path 表示工作区文件位置；不能用浏览器本地路径代替 file_token。CSV、SQL、TXT 附件可登记为待构图数据源。上传成功、源数据预览成功、构图完成和当前会话加载图，是四个不同状态。
text.en: Chat attachments use the file field on POST /api/sessions/{sid}/upload. Use the returned file_token in a later chat request; workspace_path identifies the workspace file.
