A browser-local path cannot replace file_token. CSV, SQL, and TXT attachments can be registered as construction sources. Upload success, source-preview success, completed construction, and loading the graph into the current session are separate states.

text.zh: 源数据预览地址是 /api/projects/{pid}/datasets/{did}/construction/source-preview，个人数据对应 /api/personal-datasets/{did}/construction/source-preview。该只读接口可在构图前调用；CSV 可携带 delimiter。结果中的 tables、text、limits 和 warnings 表示有上限的表格样例或文本片段。SQL 字段说明标明注释、结构信息或未提供说明，不能把结构推断当成业务定义；预览解析成功也不保证 SQL 方言适用于后续构图。
text.en: Read source samples at /api/projects/{pid}/datasets/{did}/construction/source-preview or /api/personal-datasets/{did}/construction/source-preview. This read-only endpoint works before construction; CSV accepts an optional delimiter. Its tables, text, limits, and warnings describe bounded table samples or text excerpts. SQL field descriptions distinguish comments, structural information, and unavailable descriptions; structural inference is not a business definition. Successful preview parsing also does not guarantee SQL-dialect compatibility with construction.

rows.zh: 检查 X-User-ID 和服务端用户目录
rows.en: Check X-User-ID and the server user directory

rows.zh: 使用被授权的用户、角色和模型
rows.en: Use an authorized user, role, and model

rows.zh: 资源不存在或不可访问
核对资源 ID 和所属用户/项目
状态或图 revision 冲突
重新读取状态后再操作，勿盲目重试写入
rows.en: Read current state before retrying a write

rows.zh: 检查响应 detail 与字段类型
本次未启动，退避后重试。
rows.en: No build was started; back off before retrying.
Construction still running or unconfirmed: construction_running_unconfirmed

rows.zh: 先读取构图状态，避免超时后立即重复构图。
rows.en: Read construction state first; do not immediately submit a duplicate build after a timeout.

text.zh: FastAPI 的 detail 可能是字符串、结构化对象或验证错误数组，不应假定统一错误 envelope。流建立后的失败需结合 SSE 终止事件、快照与 control 状态处理。
text.en: FastAPI detail can be a string, a structured object, or a validation-error array. Do not assume one universal error envelope. After a stream starts, combine terminal events, snapshots, and control state to handle failures.

text.zh: HTTP 200 或已取得 job_id 不足以证明分析完成。继续检查 success、构图状态、作业终态及最终结果；异步提交仅表示已受理。解析失败、未支持的输入或无可用结果，应作为明确失败处理。
text.en: HTTP 200 or a returned job_id does not prove an analysis is complete. Inspect success, construction state, terminal job status, and final results; asynchronous submission only confirms acceptance. Treat parsing failures, unsupported input, and missing final results as explicit failures.

description.zh: 把会话与 Run 分开处理，通过事件游标恢复连接，并区分断开连接、取消请求和执行结束。
description.en: Treat sessions and runs separately, resume with event cursors, and distinguish disconnection from cancellation and confirmed completion.

text.zh: 客户端向聊天、反馈和 resume 请求发送 X-iGraph-Stream-Version: 2。浏览器使用 fetch 流读取器；原生 EventSource 无法直接发送这些 POST 请求及自定义身份头。服务端返回 text/event-stream。
text.en: Send X-iGraph-Stream-Version: 2 on chat, feedback, and resume requests. Browser clients use fetch streaming; native EventSource cannot directly send these POST requests with custom identity headers. The response content type is text/event-stream.

rows.zh: 为每个新请求生成 UUID；重试同一请求时保留。
rows.en: Generate a UUID for a new request; retain it when retrying that same request.

rows.zh: 附件引用包含 file_token 和可选 filename。
rows.en: Attachment references contain file_token and optional filename.

text.zh: Backend 使用原生后台流式 Run。stream/background 是前端发送的兼容字段；ChatReq 的核心契约以上述字段和 reasoning_mode / planning_mode 等模型字段为准。
text.en: Backend uses native background streaming runs. The frontend sends stream/background as compatibility fields; the core ChatReq contract uses the fields above plus model fields such as reasoning_mode and planning_mode.

text.zh: v2 的每个 SSE data 帧包含 protocol_version、session_id、run_id、event_index 和 events。一个原始事件产生的多个界面事件放在同一 events 数组中，客户端必须完整应用该数组后才推进游标。event_index 为 null 的观察状态事件不推进原始事件游标；心跳是 SSE 注释，不是业务消息。收到 EOF 时未以空行结束的残缺帧不能当成完整事件应用。
text.en: Each v2 SSE data frame contains protocol_version, session_id, run_id, event_index, and events. Multiple UI events derived from one original event are grouped in the same events array; apply the whole array before advancing the cursor. Observation-state events with event_index=null do not advance the original-event cursor. Heartbeats are SSE comments, not business messages. An incomplete frame without its terminating blank line must not be applied at EOF.

items.zh: 同页面断流：保留已有消息，从最后完整应用的 event_index 续接。消息、工具、计划与游标应在同一状态事务提交。
items.en: Same-page disconnect: keep existing messages and resume from the last fully applied event_index. Commit messages, tools, plans, and the cursor in one state transaction.

items.zh: 刷新或消息内存丢失：从 last_event_index=-1 暂存重建当前 Run，追平后发布，保留其他历史消息。
items.en: After a refresh or loss of message state: rebuild the current run into temporary state from last_event_index=-1, publish after catching up, and retain other historical messages.

items.zh: HTTP 409 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE 或 stream_recovery_required：保留内容，轮询 snapshot，直到 snapshot_complete=true 后原子替换阶段消息。
items.en: On HTTP 409 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE or stream_recovery_required: preserve content and poll snapshot, replacing phase messages atomically only once snapshot_complete=true.

items.zh: 快照 resume_cursor 当前为 null，不能将快照消息与旧游标后的原始增量拼接。使用快照恢复暂停阶段后，该 Run 保持快照模式。
items.en: Snapshots currently return resume_cursor=null. Do not combine snapshot messages with raw deltas after an old cursor. A run restored from a paused-phase snapshot stays in snapshot mode.

text.zh: 恢复观察只读取已有运行，不自动重发问题或审批。原始事件重放依赖进程内缓存；缓存不可用时使用可读的持久化结果和完整快照，不承诺在进程重启后自动续算。
text.en: Observation recovery reads an existing run without resubmitting a question or approval. Original-event replay depends on the in-process buffer; when it is unavailable, use readable persisted results and complete snapshots. This does not promise automatic computation recovery after a process restart.

text.zh: 原始事件缓存依赖运行进程。服务重启或缓存裁剪后，可从已保存消息与完整快照恢复可见结果，但这不代表业务计算从断点重新启动。快照未完整时保留当前内容并显示恢复状态，避免把中间结果当成最终回答。
text.en: Original-event buffers depend on the runtime process. After a restart or buffer eviction, saved messages and complete snapshots can restore visible results; this does not restart business computation from a checkpoint. While a snapshot remains incomplete, retain current content and show recovery state instead of treating partial results as final.

text.zh: 先调用 GET /api/capabilities；IGRAPH_RUN_CANCEL_ENABLED 默认关闭，Backend 还会检查运行服务与图服务是否都支持所需能力。run_cancel_v1 为 true 时才启用运行停止，job_cancel_v1 为 true 时才启用作业停止，edit_latest_turn_v1 决定最新一轮编辑是否可用。取消请求携带 target.run_id 或 target.start_request_id 二选一，并提供 cancel_request_id；这些字段必须是合法 UUID。同一次取消重试保留相同 cancel_request_id。
text.en: Call GET /api/capabilities first. IGRAPH_RUN_CANCEL_ENABLED defaults to false, and Backend also verifies support in both the runtime and graph service. Enable run cancellation only for run_cancel_v1=true and job cancellation only for job_cancel_v1=true; edit_latest_turn_v1 gates editing the latest turn. A cancellation request supplies exactly one of target.run_id or target.start_request_id plus cancel_request_id, all valid UUIDs. Reuse cancel_request_id when retrying the same cancellation.

text.zh: 取消后查询 GET /api/sessions/{sid}/runs/control?run_id={rid}。execution_stopped 表示执行已停止，terminal_persisted 表示最终状态已保存；只有两者都满足且服务端允许发送时才恢复编辑。AbortController 只断开观察连接，不等于取消服务器任务。
text.en: After cancelling, query GET /api/sessions/{sid}/runs/control?run_id={rid}. execution_stopped reports stopped execution; terminal_persisted reports a saved terminal state. Resume editing only when both hold and the server permits sending. AbortController disconnects the observer; it does not cancel server execution.

text.zh: 取消接口返回 200 只说明 execution_stopped 已为 true；未停止时返回 202。仍需同时确认 terminal_persisted 和 can_send，才能认定客户端已可以继续。
text.en: HTTP 200 from cancellation indicates execution_stopped is true; otherwise the endpoint returns 202. Still check terminal_persisted and can_send before allowing the client to continue.

text.zh: 作业停止使用 POST /api/sessions/{sid}/jobs/{jid}/cancel，正文包含 cancel_request_id；随后读取同一作业的 /control。运行停止和单个作业停止的目标范围不同，不应相互替代。
text.en: To cancel a job, POST to /api/sessions/{sid}/jobs/{jid}/cancel with cancel_request_id, then read that job’s /control endpoint. Cancelling a run and cancelling an individual job target different scopes.

text.zh: 当前界面提供批准与拒绝。API 的 decision 还支持 modify，可同时提交 patched_args。请求包含 run_id、request_id、decision_id，并可附 tool_call_id、tool_name、comment；标识和工具信息应来自当前暂停请求，不应从旧卡片猜测。普通 approve 使用服务端保存的原始参数，modify 才采用替换参数。
text.en: The current UI offers approve and reject. The API decision also supports modify with patched_args. Requests contain run_id, request_id, and decision_id, with optional tool_call_id, tool_name, and comment. Take identities and tool metadata from the current paused request rather than an old card. A normal approve uses persisted arguments; only modify applies replacements.

text.zh: 反馈继续原 run_id，不创建新聊天请求。前端在等待或提交审批时阻止发送新消息，接收确认后再恢复观察。过期、不匹配或已处理的暂停请求可能返回冲突；响应丢失时先读取权威状态，避免重复提交图修改。工具执行审批与技能候选批准使用不同接口。
text.en: Feedback continues the original run_id instead of creating a new chat request. The frontend blocks new messages while approval is pending or being submitted and resumes observation after acceptance. Stale, mismatched, or already handled paused requests may conflict; if a response is lost, read authoritative state before resubmitting a graph mutation. Tool execution approval and candidate skill approval use different endpoints.

description.zh: 区分应用地址、模型服务、内部凭据、数据持久化与文档站设置，并明确可选能力的启用条件。
description.en: Distinguish application addresses, model services, internal credentials, persistent storage, and documentation settings, with explicit conditions for optional capabilities.

text.zh: 仓库根目录 .env.example 给出直接在本机启动服务的示例地址，Compose 使用容器服务名连接；配置类也可能包含容器网络默认值。因此应按实际启动方式填写地址，不能把 127.0.0.1 示例直接当作容器间地址。浏览器访问地址、服务内部地址和模型提供商地址分别配置。
text.en: The root .env.example provides addresses for running services directly on one host. Compose connects through container service names, and configuration classes may also default to container-network addresses. Set URLs for the actual launch mode; localhost examples are not container-to-container addresses. Browser access, internal services, and model providers use separate configuration.

rows.zh: 本机示例为 21109 / 21112；分别监听公共 API 和运行服务
rows.en: Local examples use 21109 / 21112 for the public API and runtime

rows.zh: Backend 访问运行服务；本机示例 http://127.0.0.1:21112，配置默认 http://agent-runtime:21112
rows.en: Backend-to-runtime URL; local example http://127.0.0.1:21112, configuration default http://agent-runtime:21112

rows.zh: Backend 访问图 API；本机示例 http://127.0.0.1:21111，默认回退为 http://graph-engine-api:21111
rows.en: Backend-to-graph API URL; local example http://127.0.0.1:21111, final default http://graph-engine-api:21111

rows.zh: 运行服务发现和调用图工具；本机示例 http://127.0.0.1:21110/mcp，可回退 MCP_SERVER_URL
rows.en: Runtime tool discovery and calls; local example http://127.0.0.1:21110/mcp, with MCP_SERVER_URL fallback

rows.zh: 内部执行控制访问地址，不是模型服务地址
rows.en: Internal execution-control addresses, not model provider URLs

rows.zh: AgentOS PostgreSQL；本机示例主机 127.0.0.1，配置默认主机 postgres
rows.en: AgentOS PostgreSQL; local example host 127.0.0.1, configuration default host postgres

rows.zh: 完整部署必填；Backend、运行服务、图 API 与 MCP 使用同一随机非空、无空白 ASCII 凭据；取消关闭时仍需配置
rows.en: Required for the complete deployment; Backend, runtime, graph API, and MCP share one random non-empty ASCII credential without whitespace, even when cancellation is disabled

rows.zh: 默认 false；统一启用并通过跨服务能力检查后，/api/capabilities 才开放停止入口
rows.en: Defaults to false; cancellation becomes available through /api/capabilities after consistent enablement and cross-service checks

rows.zh: 浏览器访问 Backend 的可选基础地址，默认空字符串使用同源 /api；构建前端时读取
rows.en: Optional browser-facing Backend base URL; defaults to an empty string for same-origin /api and is read at frontend build time

rows.zh: 前端默认启用；显式设为 false 关闭对应 v2 状态处理
rows.en: Enabled by default in the frontend; explicitly false disables the corresponding v2 state handling

rows.zh: SSE 空闲心跳，默认 15 秒
作业查询间隔默认 2 秒；等待上限默认 0，表示工具层不另设上限，仍受上游 HTTP 超时影响
rows.en: Job polling defaults to 2 seconds; wait timeout defaults to 0 for no extra tool-layer limit, while upstream HTTP timeouts still apply

text.zh: 开发前端的 Vite 服务默认监听 21108，并把 /api 代理到 http://127.0.0.1:21109。Compose 的前端通过自己的反向代理连接 Backend。远端部署时，VITE_API_BASE 若设置为浏览器无法访问的容器主机名，会导致请求失败；采用同源反向代理时可保持默认空值。
text.en: The Vite development server listens on 21108 and proxies /api to http://127.0.0.1:21109. The Compose frontend uses its own reverse proxy. A VITE_API_BASE containing a container hostname unreachable from the browser causes request failures; keep the default empty value when using a same-origin proxy.

rows.zh: 模型调用的通用凭据与 OpenAI 兼容服务地址；按所选模型解析供应商配置
rows.en: Generic model credentials and OpenAI-compatible base URL; provider settings are resolved for the selected model

rows.zh: OPENAI_* / CLAUDE_* / ANTHROPIC_* / QWEN_* / DEEPSEEK_* / ARK_*
rows.en: OPENAI_* / CLAUDE_* / ANTHROPIC_* / QWEN_* / DEEPSEEK_* / ARK_*

rows.zh: 供应商模型配置，按 .env.example 和模型解析代码填写；用户仍需拥有该模型权限
rows.en: Provider model settings; follow .env.example and model resolution, and grant the user permission for the model

rows.zh: 运行服务默认模型 qwen3.6-plus；不等同于自动授予用户所有模型权限
rows.en: Runtime default model qwen3.6-plus; does not grant users permission for every model

rows.zh: 默认 text-embedding-3-small；用于可复用知识检索，不是对话模型
rows.en: Default text-embedding-3-small; used for reusable knowledge retrieval, not conversation

rows.zh: 显式值覆盖嵌入服务设置；未设置时分别回退到 OPENAI、LLM、QWEN 的对应变量
rows.en: Explicit embedding service settings; when unset, credentials and URL fall back through corresponding OPENAI, LLM, and QWEN variables

rows.zh: 技能目录；默认位于 IGRAPH_DATA_ROOT/agent_runtime/skills
默认 true / false；运行追踪与遥测为不同开关
rows.en: Default true / false; runtime tracing and telemetry are separate switches

text.zh: 用户可在界面配置自己可用的自定义模型，服务端通过 /api/models/custom 保存其模型 ID、Base URL 与 API Key。这里的 Base URL 指模型提供商接口，不能填写 iGraph 工作台网址。嵌入模型也需其服务实际支持；代码中存在后备凭据不保证供应商支持 text-embedding-3-small。密钥只写入应用配置，不应放入文档站构建目录。
text.en: Users can configure their own custom models in the UI. The server saves model ID, Base URL, and API Key through /api/models/custom. This Base URL points to the model provider, not the iGraph workspace. The resolved embedding service must support the chosen embedding model; fallback credentials do not guarantee support for text-embedding-3-small. Keep credentials in application configuration, outside the documentation build directory.

rows.zh: 数据根目录默认 data；会话工作区默认在其 workspaces 子目录，也可显式设置共享工作区根目录。Backend 与运行服务应访问同一持久存储。
rows.en: The data root defaults to data; session workspaces default to its workspaces subdirectory, with an optional explicit shared workspace root. Backend and runtime must access the same persistent storage.

rows.zh: 默认 auto，要求可运行的 bubblewrap；不可用时启动检查失败。fallback 仅作为显式本地开发选项，受要求沙箱的环境限制。
rows.en: Defaults to auto and requires working bubblewrap; startup checks fail when unavailable. fallback is an explicit local-development option and is disallowed in environments requiring a sandbox.

rows.zh: 工作区命令默认限时 30 秒、捕获输出预算 100000 字节；独立于图算法任务预算。
rows.en: Workspace commands default to a 30-second timeout and a 100000-byte captured-output budget, separate from graph computation budgets.

text.zh: 构图由 Graph Engine 运行，有独立的模型、预算与经验配置。下面的预算值来自 .env.example，供部署起步使用；单次请求支持的选项与边界以构图页面和同一部署的接口为准。关系型构图可显式使用 rules 基线，文本实体抽取需要可用的 LLM 服务。
text.en: Graph Engine runs construction with separate model, budget, and experience configuration. Budget values below come from .env.example as deployment starting points; use the construction page and API of the same deployment for request options and limits. Relational construction can explicitly use a rules baseline, while text entity extraction requires a usable LLM service.

rows.zh: 默认 llm；缺少模型配置会明确失败，rules 需显式选择
rows.en: Defaults to llm; missing model configuration fails explicitly, and rules must be selected explicitly

rows.zh: 可单独指定构图模型与服务；未提供时按模型解析供应商配置
rows.en: Optional construction-specific model and service settings, otherwise resolved from provider configuration

rows.zh: 示例 15 / 6，控制查询集与迭代预算
rows.en: Examples 15 / 6 for query-set and iteration budgets

rows.zh: 示例 24 / 900，限制工具调用与总耗时
rows.en: Examples 24 / 900 for tool-call and total-time budgets

rows.zh: 示例 3，基准测量重复次数
示例 1，按 Graph Engine 进程限制；每用户同时一个构图任务
rows.en: Example 1 per Graph Engine process; one concurrent construction per user

rows.zh: 默认 true / auto；复用同用户领域策略，每次仍在当前数据上验收
rows.en: Default true / auto; reuse user-specific domain strategies and validate them against current data

rows.zh: 图计算进程池，默认 min(4, cpu_count)
rows.en: Graph computation process pool; default min(4, cpu_count)

rows.zh: 单轮工具调度默认 4，限制在 1–32；与图计算进程池是不同设置
rows.en: Per-turn tool scheduling defaults to 4, clamped to 1–32; separate from the graph process pool

rows.zh: 训练、推理等重任务每用户默认 1
rows.en: Heavy tasks such as training and inference default to 1 per user

rows.zh: 模型请求超时示例 180 秒
rows.en: Example model request timeout of 180 seconds

rows.zh: 报告工具默认启用；false / off / 0 关闭
rows.en: Reporting tools enabled by default; false / off / 0 disables them

text.zh: 持久化部署还需保存 PostgreSQL、Graph Engine 数据、技能和会话工作区。大图计算、NebulaGraph、上传配额与文本抽取另有专门配置，不应仅调整一个构图超时来解决容量限制；按 .env.example、图计算文档和实际错误逐项核对。
text.en: A persistent deployment also needs durable PostgreSQL, Graph Engine data, skills, and session workspaces. Large-graph computation, NebulaGraph, upload quotas, and text extraction have their own settings. Check .env.example, graph-computation documentation, and the actual error instead of trying to resolve every capacity issue by increasing construction timeout.

text.zh: 分区大图采用持久化作业与工作进程，配置入口和普通图算法进程池不同。直接启动时 LARGE_GRAPH_EMBEDDED_WORKER 默认为 true；Compose 显式关闭内嵌工作进程，并启动独立 graph-engine-worker。准备阶段会把支持的文本边表或三元组转换为分区快照；并非所有二进制图格式都支持这条准备路径。
text.en: Partitioned large graphs use durable jobs and workers, separately from the ordinary graph-algorithm process pool. LARGE_GRAPH_EMBEDDED_WORKER defaults to true for direct startup; Compose disables the embedded worker and starts a separate graph-engine-worker. Preparation converts supported text edge lists or triples into partitioned snapshots; not every binary graph format supports this preparation path.

rows.zh: 默认 100 万节点 / 500 万边；达到任一阈值进入相应大图处理约束
rows.en: Default 1 million nodes / 5 million edges; reaching either activates the corresponding large-graph constraints

rows.zh: 默认 256 MiB；支持的文本上传在全量读取前转入流式大图准备
rows.en: Default 256 MiB; supported text uploads route to streaming large-graph preparation before a full read

rows.zh: 默认 64 MiB；用于提前限制不能进入分区准备器的 npz / pt / json 等输入，避免全量反序列化
rows.en: Default 64 MiB; preflight limit for inputs such as npz / pt / json that cannot use partitioned preparation, avoiding full deserialization

rows.zh: 示例 16；准备与分区计算使用的分区数
rows.en: Example 16 for preparation and partitioned computation

rows.zh: 图数据服务默认单文件 100 GiB、每用户 200 GiB；不是所有浏览器上传入口的统一上限
rows.en: Graph data service defaults to 100 GiB per file and 200 GiB per user; these are not universal limits for every browser upload endpoint

rows.zh: 聊天附件 Backend 入口默认 50 MiB；与图数据服务的大文件上限分开设置
rows.en: Backend chat attachments default to 50 MiB, separately from graph-service large-file limits

rows.zh: 服务器预置数据目录；默认在数据根目录下的 server_datasets，Compose 可映射持久目录
rows.en: Server-provided dataset directory; defaults to server_datasets under the data root and may be mapped to persistent storage in Compose

rows.zh: 文本边表预处理门槛默认 64 MiB，扫描周期默认 30 秒；门槛设为 0 可对所有文本边表启用预处理
rows.en: Text edge-list preprocessing threshold defaults to 64 MiB, with a 30-second scan interval; threshold 0 enables preprocessing for all text edge lists

text.zh: 了解准备、分区快照、工作进程及算法边界；完整调节项见仓库 .env.example。
text.en: Understand preparation, partitioned snapshots, workers, and algorithm boundaries; see .env.example for the complete configuration list.

text.zh: 独立文档站不使用模型 API Key、数据库连接、IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY 或 VITE_API_BASE。docs-site/wrangler.jsonc 配置站点名称、兼容日期与 dist 静态资源目录。可选 SITE_URL 只在构建时生成绝对 canonical 和 sitemap，应为实际文档站的 HTTPS origin，不带路径、查询参数或片段。Cloudflare 发布凭据只用于发布静态文件，不是 iGraph 应用凭据。
text.en: The independent documentation site does not use model API keys, database connections, IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY, or VITE_API_BASE. docs-site/wrangler.jsonc configures the site name, compatibility date, and dist asset directory. Optional SITE_URL generates absolute canonicals and a sitemap at build time and must be the actual documentation HTTPS origin without a path, query, or fragment. Cloudflare publishing credentials upload static files; they are not iGraph application credentials.

description.zh: 按智能体、图算法、构图和图学习整理 26 个核心术语，说明其含义及在 iGraph 中的具体用途。
description.en: 26 core terms covering agents, graph algorithms, construction and graph learning, with definitions and their use in iGraph. The first column retains Chinese terms for bilingual lookup.

rows.zh: 结合模型推理、任务状态与工具调用来完成目标的软件执行主体。
rows.en: A software actor that combines model reasoning, task state, and tool calls to pursue a goal.

rows.zh: iGraph 是图驱动的数据分析智能体：从用户问题选择证据操作，读取图查询、算法与学习结果，再组织后续分析和解释。具体图运算由 Graph Engine 执行。
rows.en: iGraph is a graph-driven data analysis agent: it selects evidence-producing operations from user questions, reads graph queries, algorithm and learning results, and organizes further analysis and interpretation. Graph Engine performs the computation.

rows.zh: 围绕一类任务组织的可复用说明、流程与辅助资源，使智能体能够按需采用相应方法。
rows.en: Reusable instructions, workflows, and supporting resources organized around a task family for an agent to apply when needed.

rows.zh: 技能指导图分析和构图流程。构图智能体结合领域经验选择结构变换，在固定查询上验收候选方案，并将可复用经验用于后续策略选择。技能不是某个图算法函数的别名。
rows.en: Skills guide analysis and construction workflows. The construction agent uses domain experience to choose transformations, validates candidates on fixed queries, and reuses learned experience in later strategy selection. A skill is not simply an alias for an algorithm function.

rows.zh: 按照工具声明的名称和参数数据结构，请求一个明确操作并接收结构化结果。
rows.en: A request for a defined operation using its declared name and parameter structure, followed by a structured result.

rows.zh: 例如 shortest_path 接收 source、target 等参数。智能体通过 MCP 调用 Graph Engine；工具返回的 success、结果字段和错误决定下一步操作。
rows.en: For example, shortest_path accepts source and target. The agent calls Graph Engine through MCP, using success, result fields, and errors to determine the next step.

rows.zh: 组织一段交互及其关联状态的隔离作用域。
rows.en: An isolated scope for an interaction and its associated state.

rows.zh: iGraph 在用户身份下按 session_id 管理活动图、上传文件、模型和作业等状态。切换会话不等于切换同一会话内的 graph_version；模型也需要在对应会话作用域内解析。
rows.en: Within a user identity, session_id scopes the active graph, uploads, models, and jobs. Switching sessions differs from switching graph_version within one session; models must also resolve in their corresponding session scope.

rows.zh: 提交后独立运行，并通过标识查询状态、进度和最终结果的执行单元。
rows.en: An execution unit that continues after submission and exposes status, progress, and a final result through an identifier.

rows.zh: 训练等长任务可能返回 job_id；get_job_status 查询该作业，完成结果位于 job.result。请求取消与确认计算已经停止是不同阶段。
rows.en: Long tasks such as training may return job_id. get_job_status queries the job and exposes the completed result under job.result. Requesting cancellation and confirming that computation has stopped are distinct stages.

rows.zh: 服务器通过持续的 HTTP 响应向客户端单向发送事件的流式传输机制。
rows.en: A streaming mechanism in which a server sends events to a client over a persistent HTTP response.

rows.zh: iGraph 用事件流向界面传递运行消息与进度。事件到达、连接断开和作业最终状态分别表示不同事实；界面应依据明确的状态字段判断完成。
rows.en: iGraph streams runtime messages and progress to the interface. Event arrival, connection closure, and a terminal job state are distinct facts; the interface should use explicit state fields to determine completion.

rows.zh: 针对某个用户保存并在后续交互中复用的偏好和背景信息。
rows.en: Preferences and context saved for a user and reused in later interactions.

rows.zh: Agentic User Memory 使用 update_user_memory；记忆面板读取用户记忆存储。保存后核对记忆列表及新会话读取结果，不能只凭模型回复判断已持久化。
rows.en: Agentic User Memory uses update_user_memory; the memory panel reads the user-memory store. Verify the stored list and recall in a new session rather than relying only on an assistant acknowledgement.

rows.zh: 从任务中提炼、供后续相关问题检索的知识或经验。
rows.en: Knowledge or experience distilled from tasks for retrieval on related future questions.

rows.zh: save_learning 写入可检索的 Learned Knowledge，与 update_user_memory 的用户记忆及构图领域经验是不同存储。知识检索成功不等于它会出现在用户记忆面板。
rows.en: save_learning writes searchable Learned Knowledge, separate from update_user_memory and construction domain experience. Successful knowledge retrieval does not mean the entry appears in the user-memory panel.

rows.zh: 同一对端点之间存在的多条独立关系；每条关系可有不同标识、类型或属性。
rows.en: Multiple distinct relationships between the same endpoint pair, potentially with different identities, types, or attributes.

rows.zh: GraphData 可保留逻辑边标识。部分算法需要临时投影视图，例如最短路径按端点对取最小权重；这种计算投影不应被理解为源关系被删除或合并保存。
rows.en: GraphData preserves logical edge identity. Some algorithms require a temporary projection, such as the minimum weight per endpoint pair for shortest paths. This calculation view does not delete or permanently merge source relationships.

rows.zh: 在给定方向与成本定义下，从起点到终点使总成本最小的路径；无权时成本通常是边数。
rows.en: A path minimizing total cost from source to target under the chosen direction and cost model; unweighted cost is usually the edge count.

rows.zh: shortest_path 的 use_weight=true 将权重解释为距离或成本，false 则按跳数计算。边权表示相似度时，需要先明确它是否适合直接作为路径距离。
rows.en: shortest_path interprets weights as distances or costs when use_weight=true, and minimizes hops when false. If weights represent similarity, first establish whether they are suitable as direct path distances.

rows.zh: 根据连接结构识别内部连接较密集、群体之间连接相对稀疏的节点集合。
rows.en: Identifying node groups that are relatively densely connected internally and more sparsely connected to other groups.

rows.zh: community_detection 可选择 Louvain 等方法，返回社区规模、节点预览和模块度。这里的社区是结构分组，不自动具有业务类别标签；结果也取决于方向、权重和算法选项。
rows.en: community_detection supports methods such as Louvain and returns community sizes, node previews, and modularity. Communities are structural groups rather than automatic business labels, and results depend on direction, weights, and algorithm choices.

rows.zh: 统计节点位于其他节点对最短路径上的份额，用于描述其在最短路径结构中的中介作用。
rows.en: The share of shortest paths between other node pairs that pass through a node, describing its intermediary role in shortest-path structure.

rows.zh: node_centrality 选择 centrality_type=betweenness 时计算此指标，可用于寻找连接群体的桥接节点。高介数是特定图和路径定义下的结构特征，不能直接等同于真实业务影响力。
rows.en: Select centrality_type=betweenness in node_centrality to identify potential bridging nodes. High betweenness is a structural property under a particular graph and path definition, not direct evidence of real-world business influence.

rows.zh: 根据节点与其他可达节点的最短路径距离衡量其接近程度；常见形式与平均距离的倒数有关。
rows.en: A measure of proximity based on shortest-path distances to reachable nodes, commonly related to the reciprocal of mean distance.

rows.zh: node_centrality 选择 centrality_type=closeness。解释数值时要考虑图是否连通、是否有向及距离语义，不能只比较连接数，也不能将不可达节点当作零距离。
rows.en: Select centrality_type=closeness in node_centrality. Interpret values using connectivity, direction, and distance semantics; the metric is not just degree, and unreachable nodes must not be treated as zero-distance nodes.

rows.zh: 在无向简单图语义下，衡量相邻两步关系闭合为三角形的比例，等于三角形数的三倍除以连通三元组数。
rows.en: Under undirected simple-graph semantics, the proportion of connected two-step triples closed into triangles: three times the triangle count divided by the number of connected triples.

rows.zh: global_metrics 的 metric=transitivity 在无向计算视图上计算该值。它与先逐节点计算局部聚类系数再取平均的 average_clustering 是不同指标。
rows.en: global_metrics with metric=transitivity computes this value on an undirected calculation view. It differs from average_clustering, which averages local clustering coefficients across nodes.

rows.zh: 标识某个会话中可保存、加载和分析的图状态。
rows.en: An identifier for a graph state that can be saved, loaded, and analyzed within a session.

rows.zh: get_graph_info 返回活动 graph_version，load_graph_version 可切换已保存版本。图学习用它校验输入一致性；构图数据集的 revision 和执行控制的 generation 不属于这套图版本编号。
rows.en: get_graph_info returns the active graph_version, and load_graph_version selects a saved one. Graph ML uses it to check input consistency. Dataset construction revision and execution generation are separate identifiers.

rows.zh: 保存的构图结果在编辑与提交过程中使用的修订编号。
rows.en: A revision number for a constructed dataset document as it is edited and committed.

rows.zh: 构图编辑请求携带 base_revision，服务端检查它与当前 revision 是否一致，防止旧编辑覆盖新内容。load_constructed_graph 才将构图结果装入会话图；修订号不应直接充当 graph_version。
rows.en: Construction edits carry base_revision, checked against the current revision to prevent stale edits overwriting newer content. load_constructed_graph loads the constructed result into the session graph; revision must not be substituted for graph_version.

rows.zh: 用于区分一次运行当前有效执行与过期执行的控制标识。
rows.en: A control identifier distinguishing the current valid execution of a run from stale executions.

rows.zh: Run、Job 和工作进程回执携带 generation。执行控制在继续运行和状态发布时校验代次，阻止过期结果进入当前状态。它描述执行有效性，不描述图内容是否发生变化。
rows.en: Run, job, and worker receipts carry generation. Execution control validates generations when continuing work and publishing state to reject stale results. It describes execution validity rather than changes to graph content.

rows.zh: 在独立参考数据上执行查询、产生用于核对的参考答案的执行器。
rows.en: An executor that evaluates queries against independent reference data to produce comparison answers.

rows.zh: 构图验收把固定查询计划编译为 SQL，在源表上生成期望结果，再与只读取候选图的 GraphExecutor 比较。这里的 oracle 是语义校验角色，不表示使用 Oracle 数据库，也不是模型自行编写的答案。
rows.en: Construction validation compiles fixed query plans to SQL against source tables, then compares those answers with GraphExecutor reading only the candidate graph. oracle denotes the validation role, not the Oracle database or model-authored answers.

rows.zh: 转换后的表示完整保留源记录标识、字段值及声明关系等语义的性质。
rows.en: The preservation of source-record identity, field values, and declared relationship semantics in a transformed representation.

rows.zh: source_integrity_errors 检查全部源记录与声明外键，覆盖固定查询没有访问的数据。查询全部通过与源数据完整性通过是两项检查，不能用其中一项替代另一项。
rows.en: source_integrity_errors checks every source record and declared foreign key, including data untouched by the fixed queries. Passing all queries and passing integrity checks are separate requirements.

rows.zh: 在比较候选方案之前确定、并在比较期间保持不变的一组查询与执行计划。
rows.en: A set of queries and execution plans fixed before candidate comparison and kept unchanged throughout that comparison.

rows.zh: 构图智能体通过 set_workload 提交查询，随后在同一工作负载上比较语义正确性与执行成本。冻结查询防止通过改题提高得分；通过率只覆盖这组查询，不代表任意问题的正确率。
rows.en: The construction agent submits queries with set_workload, then compares semantic correctness and execution cost on that same workload. Freezing prevents score improvement by changing the questions; pass rate applies to this set, not arbitrary questions.

rows.zh: 图神经网络沿边收集邻居信息，并通过聚合和变换更新节点表示的计算过程。
rows.en: A graph-neural-network computation that collects information along edges, aggregates it, and transforms node representations.

rows.zh: 已注册 GNN 骨干网络以 x 和 edge_index 计算节点表示；APPNP 在预测后进行传播。当前模型调用不把边权或 xe 传入前向计算，沿边传播不等于使用了全部边属性。
rows.en: Registered GNN backbones use x and edge_index for node representations; APPNP propagates after prediction. Current model calls do not pass edge weights or xe into the forward computation. Propagating along edges does not mean using all edge attributes.

rows.zh: 将同一张图的节点或边表示聚合为一个固定维度图表示的操作。
rows.en: An operation that aggregates representations of nodes or edges within a graph into a fixed-dimensional graph representation.

rows.zh: 图分类采用 global_mean_pool，对每张图的节点嵌入求均值，形成 [B, D] 批次表示，再送入图级线性分类头。当前接口没有提供切换求和或最大值读出的选项。
rows.en: Graph classification uses global_mean_pool to average each graph's node embeddings into a [B, D] batch representation before a graph-level linear head. The current interface does not expose a switch to sum or maximum readout.

rows.zh: 以固定维度数值向量表示节点或图等对象，使其可参与数值预测和相似性计算。
rows.en: A fixed-dimensional numerical representation of an object such as a node or graph for prediction and similarity computation.

rows.zh: 预训练保存节点 embedding.npy 与对应名称；data.feature_source=embedding 按名称复用这些向量。复用嵌入不等于恢复上游模型的训练检查点，未知节点名当前填零向量。
rows.en: Pretraining saves node embedding.npy and corresponding names. data.feature_source=embedding reuses these vectors by name. Reusing embeddings does not restore an upstream training checkpoint; unmatched node names currently receive zero vectors.

rows.zh: 以单个节点为预测对象，为其确定类别标签的监督学习任务。
rows.en: A supervised task that assigns a class label to each target node.

rows.zh: task=node_classification 在活动图上运行 GNN 和分类头，用已标注训练节点计算交叉熵。二维节点标签当前先取 argmax，仍是单标签分类；不能据此宣称支持多标签节点分类。
rows.en: task=node_classification runs a GNN and classification head on the active graph, applying cross-entropy to labeled training nodes. Two-dimensional node labels are reduced with argmax, so this remains single-label rather than multi-label node classification.

rows.zh: 以节点对为预测对象，估计其连接可能性或相关分数的任务。
rows.en: A task that scores node pairs for their likelihood of being connected.

rows.zh: task=link_prediction 使用节点嵌入内积解码，返回分数和 sigmoid 概率。该解码对称，且当前验证边仍参与消息传递；解释指标时需要说明这两项实现条件。
rows.en: task=link_prediction uses an embedding dot-product decoder and returns scores and sigmoid probabilities. The decoder is symmetric, and validation edges currently remain in message passing; both conditions matter when interpreting metrics.

rows.zh: 以整张图为预测对象，通过图级表示预测一个或多个标签的任务。
rows.en: A task that predicts one or more labels for an entire graph using a graph-level representation.

rows.zh: task=graph_classification 使用独立多图数据集：HIV 为单个二分类任务，PCBA 为 128 个二分类任务。节点消息传递后进行图级读出；整图标签与同一图中各节点的标签是不同监督对象。
rows.en: task=graph_classification uses a separate multi-graph dataset: one binary task for HIV and 128 binary tasks for PCBA. Node message passing is followed by graph-level readout. A graph label and labels of individual nodes are different supervision targets.

text.zh: 术语参考：以下官方文档用于核对中英文表达。各术语在 iGraph 中的具体数据结构、算法选项和运行边界，以本项目相应技术章节为准。
text.en: Terminology references: the official documents below provide Chinese and English usage. iGraph's data structures, algorithm options, and runtime boundaries are defined in this project's corresponding technical chapters.

label.zh: DGL：整图分类、消息传递与图读出
label.en: DGL: graph classification, message passing, and readout

description.zh: 构建、预览和发布独立的 iGraph 文档站。本页不部署工作台、Backend、Agent Runtime 或 Graph Engine。
description.en: Build, preview, and publish the independent iGraph documentation site. This page does not deploy the workspace, Backend, Agent Runtime, or Graph Engine.

text.zh: 本站通过 Node.js 将双语内容构建为 HTML、CSS、JavaScript、搜索索引和 Markdown 文件。Cloudflare Workers Static Assets 分发 docs-site/dist；当前配置没有应用 Worker 脚本、API 反向代理、数据库或登录服务。应用部署步骤见“快速开始”，不能用发布文档代替启动 iGraph。
text.en: Node.js builds the bilingual content into HTML, CSS, JavaScript, a search index, and Markdown files. Cloudflare Workers Static Assets serves docs-site/dist. The current configuration includes no application Worker script, API proxy, database, or login service. See Quickstart for application setup; publishing documentation does not start iGraph.

rows.zh: 预生成各语言页面，未知路径返回真实 404
rows.en: Pregenerated locale pages; unknown paths return a real 404

rows.zh: 按 Cloudflare 当前账户套餐与静态资源官方限制核对；本仓库 check 也实施本地文件数量和大小检查
rows.en: Check the current Cloudflare plan and official static-asset limits; the repository check also applies local file-count and size limits

text.zh: workers.dev 账号子域名由 Cloudflare 账号决定，示例不表示已完成发布。部署成功后的实际网址和版本以 Wrangler 输出为准。平台费用与限制可能变化，使用本页末尾的官方链接核对。
text.en: The Cloudflare account determines the workers.dev subdomain, and the example does not imply a completed deployment. Use the actual URL and version reported by Wrangler. Platform billing and limits may change; verify them through the official links at the end of this page.

text.zh: 使用 Node.js 22.12 或更高版本，在 docs-site 中运行下面命令。npm ci 根据提交的 package-lock.json 安装依赖；文档构建不依赖 React 前端或项目 Python 服务。npm run check 校验双语内容、链接、锚点、构建输出及静态文件边界。
text.en: Use Node.js 22.12 or later and run these commands from docs-site. npm ci installs dependencies from the committed package-lock.json. The documentation build does not require the React frontend or Python application services. npm run check validates bilingual content, links, anchors, generated output, and static-file boundaries.

blocks.code:
cd docs-site
npm ci
npm run build
npm run check
npm run dev

text.zh: 本地预览地址为 http://127.0.0.1:4173。npm run dev 只提供已生成的 dist，不会自动监听并构建内容；修改后重新 npm run build，再刷新浏览器。npm run preview 使用 Wrangler 本地运行环境，同样应先生成 dist。
text.en: Local preview runs at http://127.0.0.1:4173. npm run dev serves the existing dist and does not watch or rebuild content; run npm run build again after edits, then reload. npm run preview uses the Wrangler local runtime and also requires a generated dist.

text.zh: 每个章节已经生成 index.html，所以使用静态目录路由和 404-page，不需要 SPA fallback。省略 main 和 run_worker_first，使正常文档请求直接由静态资产服务处理。
text.en: Each chapter has a generated index.html. Static directory routing and 404-page are sufficient; no SPA fallback is needed. Omitting main and run_worker_first lets normal documentation requests go directly to the asset service.

blocks.code:
npx wrangler login
npx wrangler whoami
npm run deploy:check
npm run deploy

text.zh: 首次登录需要在浏览器完成 Cloudflare 授权。部署成功后，以 Wrangler 输出的真实 workers.dev URL 为准。检查中英文页面、章节深链接、404、搜索、代码复制和移动端目录。更新内容时再次运行 deploy，静态资产随版本一起发布。
text.en: The first login requires Cloudflare authorization in your browser. After deployment, use the actual workers.dev URL printed by Wrangler. Check both languages, chapter deep links, 404s, search, copying, and mobile navigation. Run deploy again to publish updated content and its assets as one version.

text.zh: 如需 sitemap，得到真实域名后设置 SITE_URL 再构建和部署。构建器会拒绝带路径或非 HTTPS 的站点地址。
text.en: For a sitemap, set SITE_URL to the real origin, then rebuild and deploy. The builder rejects non-HTTPS URLs and URLs containing a path.

text.zh: 上面的 SITE_URL=… 命令是 POSIX shell 写法。PowerShell 可先运行 $env:SITE_URL = "https://igraph-docs.YOUR_SUBDOMAIN.workers.dev"，再运行 npm run deploy。deploy 会先 build 和 check；deploy:check 执行同样检查并以 --dry-run 验证发布配置，不上传正式版本。
text.en: The SITE_URL=… command above uses POSIX shell syntax. In PowerShell, set $env:SITE_URL = "https://igraph-docs.YOUR_SUBDOMAIN.workers.dev" and then run npm run deploy. deploy runs build and check before publishing; deploy:check performs the same checks and validates deployment with --dry-run without uploading a production version.

text.zh: 当前仓库没有独立的 .github/workflows/docs-site.yml。文档发布不会仅因为提交代码或创建 Pull Request 自动发生。若要接入 CI，新增只针对 docs-site 的流程：安装符合要求的 Node.js，进入 docs-site，执行 npm ci、npm run build 与 npm run check；发布阶段再使用 Wrangler 和配置好的 Cloudflare 凭据。
text.en: The current repository has no separate .github/workflows/docs-site.yml. Pushing code or opening a pull request does not automatically publish these docs. To add CI, create a docs-site-specific workflow: install a supported Node.js version, enter docs-site, run npm ci, npm run build, and npm run check, then use Wrangler with configured Cloudflare credentials for deployment.

text.zh: 自动发布可使用 CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN 和 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID，SITE_URL 可作为构建环境变量。也可配置 Cloudflare Workers Builds，将根目录设为 docs-site、构建命令设为 npm run build && npm run check、发布命令设为 npx wrangler deploy。先选定一个正式发布入口，避免多个流程同时更新同一站点。
text.en: Automated publishing can use CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, with SITE_URL as a build environment variable. Alternatively, configure Workers Builds with root directory docs-site, build command npm run build && npm run check, and deploy command npx wrangler deploy. Choose one production publishing entry point to avoid competing updates to the same site.

blocks.code:
npx wrangler deployments list
npx wrangler rollback VERSION_ID --message "Restore previous docs release"

text.zh: 回滚会将线上部署切换到所选历史版本，但不会修改本地内容。记录部署版本 ID、内容来源提交和发布日期；回滚后同步修正源文件，再正常发布。
text.en: Rollback switches the live deployment to a selected historical version without changing local content. Record deployment version IDs, source commits, and publication dates. Correct the source after a rollback before publishing again.

description.zh: 从具体症状定位问题：运行环境、权限、图构建、流式恢复，以及文档站发布。
description.en: Diagnose concrete symptoms across runtime setup, permissions, construction, stream recovery, and documentation publishing.

rows.zh: 提示内部服务密钥缺失
填写 IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY；Backend、运行服务、图 API 与 MCP 使用同一非空、无空白 ASCII 值。即使取消关闭也需配置，修改后同步重启相关服务。
rows.en: Set the same non-empty ASCII IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY without whitespace in Backend, runtime, graph API, and MCP, even when cancellation is disabled. Restart affected services together after changes.

rows.zh: 工作台请求 API 失败
Vite 当前 /api 代理指向 127.0.0.1:21109，开发页面使用 21108。先确认 Backend 可达；若设置 VITE_API_BASE，确认该地址从浏览器可达并已重新构建前端。Compose 使用独立反向代理。
rows.en: Vite currently proxies /api to 127.0.0.1:21109 and serves the development page on 21108. Check Backend reachability. If VITE_API_BASE is set, ensure the browser can reach it and rebuild the frontend. Compose uses a separate reverse proxy.

rows.zh: 确认 X-User-ID 对应已启用用户及所需角色、allowed_models；自定义模型检查模型 ID、提供商 Base URL 和 API Key。模型密钥不能替代用户 ID。
rows.en: Check that X-User-ID identifies an enabled user with the required role and allowed_models. For a custom model, verify its ID, provider Base URL, and API Key. A model key cannot replace a user ID.

rows.zh: 记忆列表可用，但语义检索失败
rows.en: Memory list works but semantic retrieval fails

rows.zh: 列表管理和 LearnedKnowledge 向量检索是不同功能。检查最终解析的嵌入模型、凭据与服务兼容性；未显式设置 EMBEDDING 变量仍可能使用 OPENAI、LLM 或 QWEN 后备配置。
rows.en: Record management and LearnedKnowledge vector retrieval are different features. Check the resolved embedding model, credentials, and service compatibility; unset EMBEDDING variables may still use OPENAI, LLM, or QWEN fallbacks.

rows.zh: 没有停止或编辑最新一轮入口
rows.en: Stop or latest-turn edit is unavailable

rows.zh: 查看 /api/capabilities。取消默认关闭；统一配置开关与内部密钥后，还需运行服务和图服务能力检查通过。不能只改前端显示来启用。
rows.en: Inspect /api/capabilities. Cancellation defaults to disabled; consistent flags and internal credentials are required along with successful runtime and graph-service capability checks. Changing the frontend display alone cannot enable it.

rows.zh: 已上传或生成文件，但无法下载
rows.en: An uploaded or generated file cannot be downloaded

rows.zh: 当前下载入口面向已发布的 Derived 文件。确认工作区列表与会话归属、文件是否已由 workspace_publish 发布；Ephemeral 路径或回答中的服务器路径不是可下载结果。
rows.en: The download entry point serves published Derived files. Check workspace metadata, session ownership, and whether workspace_publish published the file. An Ephemeral path or server path in a reply is not a downloadable output.

rows.zh: 运行服务提示 workspace sandbox unavailable
确认服务用户可以运行 bubblewrap，并允许所需的用户与挂载命名空间。默认配置不会静默退回无沙箱执行；fallback 只用于明确的本地开发环境，不能替代生产沙箱配置。
rows.en: Check that the service user can run bubblewrap and create the required user and mount namespaces. The default does not silently fall back to unsandboxed execution; fallback is only for explicit local development and does not replace production sandbox setup.

items.zh: algorithm_available 为 false：检查输入类型与算法注册。当前 CSV / TXT / SQL 均有内置 builder。
items.en: algorithm_available is false: check input type and registration. Built-in builders exist for CSV, TXT, and SQL.

items.zh: LLM 模式缺少凭据：配置构图或供应商 Key / Base URL；关系型输入需要离线基线时显式选 rules。entities 必须使用 LLM，不能降级为 rules。
items.en: LLM credentials missing: configure construction/provider keys and base URL, or explicitly select rules for an offline relational baseline. entities requires an LLM and cannot fall back to rules.

items.zh: 输入限制或解析失败：核对 UTF-8 编码、TXT/CSV 分隔符和列数、SQLite 语法及源文件大小；entities 还需核对字符、分块、模型调用和图规模上限。系统不会静默截断超限输入，也不会发布部分分块的半图。
items.en: Input limit or parsing failure: check UTF-8 encoding, TXT/CSV delimiters and column counts, SQLite syntax, and source size. For entities, also inspect character, chunk, model-call, and graph-size limits. Oversized input is not silently truncated, and completed chunks are not published as a partial graph.

items.zh: 版本冲突：读取最新 revision，重新预览编辑再提交。
items.en: Revision conflict: read the latest revision and preview edits again before committing.

items.zh: 构图前看不到样例：先确认前后端版本包含 source-preview 接口，当前用户可访问此数据集，并读取预览的 warnings。CSV 分隔符变化后需要重新取样；SQL 注释缺失时不应期待系统给出确定的业务含义。
items.en: No samples before construction: confirm that the frontend and Backend support source-preview, that the current user can access the dataset, and read preview warnings. Resample after changing the CSV delimiter. Missing SQL comments do not imply that the system can supply authoritative business meanings.

items.zh: 样例显示正常但构图失败：预览是有上限的只读解析，不会验证全部数据和构图模型配置。继续核对源格式、SQL 方言、关系 schema、构图模式和实际错误；不要把预览成功当成构图成功。
items.en: Samples look correct but construction fails: preview is bounded read-only parsing, not validation of the full dataset or model configuration. Check source format, SQL dialect, relational schema, construction mode, and the actual error; preview success is not construction success.

items.zh: 数据集已 ready 但分析提示无图：数据集保存状态与会话加载状态不同。选择正确项目和数据集，加载已构建版本，再读取图信息核对节点、边和 revision。
items.en: The dataset is ready but analysis reports no graph: saved dataset state differs from the session’s loaded graph. Select the correct project and dataset, load the saved construction, then inspect nodes, edges, and revision.

items.zh: 429 容量限制：读取错误中的容量信息及 Retry-After（若提供），等待当前任务结束再重试。重复提交同一构图或训练不会扩大可用容量。
items.en: 429 capacity limit: inspect capacity details and Retry-After when present, then retry after active work finishes. Repeated construction or training submissions do not create capacity.

text.zh: 先区分观察连接关闭与 Run 终止。同页面断流保留消息并从已应用游标续接；刷新丢失消息则从 -1 暂存重建。遇到 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE 时等待完整快照；resume_cursor 为 null 时不要把快照与旧游标增量混用。start_request_id 使用 UUID，且同一次请求的重试保持相同 ID。
text.en: Distinguish observer disconnection from run termination. Keep messages and resume from the applied cursor on same-page disconnects; rebuild from -1 after losing message state. On REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE, wait for a complete snapshot. Never combine a snapshot with old-cursor deltas when resume_cursor is null. Use a UUID start_request_id and retain it across retries of the same request.

text.zh: 代理需要流式转发并关闭响应缓冲。取消是否完成以 execution_stopped 和 terminal_persisted 为准；浏览器断开不代表后端计算停止。
text.en: Proxies must stream responses without buffering. Use execution_stopped and terminal_persisted to determine whether cancellation has completed. A browser disconnect does not imply backend computation has stopped.

text.zh: 停止请求可能先返回 202，或在尚未完成确认时返回 CANCEL_NOT_CONFIRMED。继续读取权威控制状态，分别核对 execution_stopped、terminal_persisted 和 can_send；不要因为页面静止或 HTTP 200 就立即重发相同任务。服务重启可恢复已有记录，但不保证自动继续中断的计算。
text.en: A stop request may initially return 202 or CANCEL_NOT_CONFIRMED before confirmation completes. Continue reading authoritative control state and inspect execution_stopped, terminal_persisted, and can_send separately. A static page or HTTP 200 alone is not a reason to resubmit the task. Restart recovery can restore existing records but does not guarantee automatic continuation of interrupted computation.

text.zh: 审批按钮冲突时，重新读取当前会话与待确认工具。界面提供批准和拒绝，参数修改需使用相应 API；旧卡片的 run_id 或 tool_call_id 不能用于确认新的操作。训练或报告在刷新后暂未显示时，先等待会话消息与快照恢复，核对项目训练列表或工作区已发布文件，避免为恢复界面重复计算。
text.en: If an approval button conflicts, reread the current session and pending tool. The UI offers approve and reject; argument modification requires the corresponding API. An old card’s run_id or tool_call_id cannot approve a new operation. If training or reports are temporarily absent after reload, let message and snapshot recovery finish and inspect project training records or published workspace files before rerunning computation.

rows.zh: Wrangler 要求更高 Node 版本
rows.en: Wrangler requires a newer Node version

rows.zh: 使用 Node.js 22.12+，重新 npm ci。
rows.en: Use Node.js 22.12+ and rerun npm ci.

rows.zh: 本地运行 wrangler login；CI 检查账号 ID 和 API token 权限。
rows.en: Run wrangler login locally; in CI, check the account ID and API token permissions.

rows.zh: 重新 build，确认 dist 中存在对应语言目录与 index.html。
rows.en: Rebuild and verify the locale directory and index.html exist in dist.

rows.zh: 检查 /search-index.json 是否随 dist 发布，刷新后重试。
rows.en: Check that /search-index.json was deployed with dist, then reload.

rows.zh: 找不到应用登录和数据
rows.en: Application login or data is missing

rows.zh: 这是独立文档站。要使用 iGraph，按快速开始启动项目服务。
rows.en: This is an independent documentation site. Start the project services using Quickstart to use iGraph.

rows.zh: 修改内容后预览仍是旧版
rows.en: Preview remains stale after content edits

rows.zh: npm run dev 仅提供已生成的 dist。重新 npm run build 和 npm run check，再刷新；Wrangler preview 也使用已构建文件。
rows.en: npm run dev only serves the generated dist. Rerun npm run build and npm run check, then reload; Wrangler preview also uses built files.
Pushing changes does not publish the site

rows.zh: 当前仓库没有独立 docs-site.yml 发布工作流。手动运行 deploy，或按部署页配置单独的 CI / Workers Builds。
rows.en: The repository has no separate docs-site.yml deployment workflow. Run deploy manually or configure CI / Workers Builds as described on the deployment page.

rows.zh: 使用文档站真实 HTTPS origin，移除路径、查询参数、片段和用户凭据；不要填应用 API 地址或示例占位域名。
rows.en: Use the real documentation HTTPS origin without a path, query, fragment, or user credentials. Do not use an application API address or a placeholder domain.

description.zh: 文档内容、工具参考与示例的更新记录。
description.en: Changes to documentation, tool references, and examples.

items.zh: 按当前代码重新核对功能、工具参数、配置和前端入口；补充工作台操作指南与源数据预览说明。
items.en: Rechecked capabilities, tool parameters, configuration, and UI controls against current code; added a workspace guide and source-preview documentation.

items.zh: 补充个人构图结果导入项目、图版本区别、训练对比、报告文件下载、用户记忆与技能管理。
items.en: Documented importing personal graphs into projects, distinct graph versions, training comparison, report downloads, user memory, and skill management.

items.zh: 修正服务数量、文本构图范围、可选搜索与取消功能的前提，以及文档发布流程中的过时说明。
items.en: Corrected service counts, text-construction scope, optional search and cancellation prerequisites, and outdated publishing instructions.

items.zh: 统一中文术语，按具体语境解释评测查询、参考执行器、结果文件和接口约定，并同步中英文事实。
items.en: Revised Chinese terminology in context and synchronized factual changes across Chinese and English.

items.zh: 明确 iGraph 的核心定位为“图驱动的数据分析智能体”，扩写问题、图表示、工具证据、解释与后续分析之间的关系。
items.en: Clarified iGraph’s core positioning as a graph-driven data analysis agent and expanded the connections between questions, graph representations, tool evidence, interpretation, and follow-up analysis.

items.zh: 新增分析流程图与说明性工具证据示例，补充图查询、结构指标和模型结果各自的解释边界。
items.en: Added an analysis-flow diagram and an illustrative tool-evidence example, with interpretation boundaries for graph queries, structural metrics, and model results.

items.zh: 调整系统架构、智能体运行机制和 Graph Engine 的导语；保留构图闭环及详细实现，将技能与自进化构图明确为分析流程和表示准备的支撑能力。
items.en: Reframed architecture, runtime, and Graph Engine introductions while retaining construction details and positioning skills and self-evolving construction as support for analysis procedures and representation preparation.

items.zh: 新增智能体运行机制、图算法与结果解读、术语表；补充工具依赖、审批继续、取消确认与状态保存。
items.en: Added runtime mechanics, algorithm interpretation, and a glossary, including tool dependencies, approval continuation, cancellation confirmation, and persistence.

items.zh: 扩展技能驱动构图：说明源类型、键与关系标识、查询计划、独立验证、候选变换、经验检索和执行预算。
items.en: Expanded skill-guided construction with source types, keys and relationship identity, query plans, independent validation, transformations, experience retrieval, and budgets.

items.zh: 扩展 Graph Engine 与图学习：增加张量和索引、方向与边权语义、训练损失、数据划分、模型文件及调用示例。
items.en: Expanded Graph Engine and graph learning with tensors and indexes, direction and weight semantics, training losses, splits, model files, and invocation examples.

items.zh: 新增 Graph Engine 内部设计、12 类图工具参考与两轮电商构图报告；展开技能、查询验收和领域经验的执行机制。
items.en: Added Graph Engine internals, a 12-category tool reference, and a two-run commerce construction report covering skills, query validation, and domain experience.

items.zh: 重绘系统架构、图工具执行与构图进化图，提供中英文及深浅主题版本。
items.en: Redrew system architecture, graph execution, and construction evolution diagrams in both languages and themes.

items.zh: 新增独立中英文静态文档：架构、快速开始、构图、数据集、图 ML、API、恢复、配置与部署。
items.en: Added an independent bilingual static documentation site covering architecture, quickstart, construction, datasets, graph ML, APIs, recovery, configuration, and deployment.

items.zh: 新增本地全文搜索、语言切换、主题切换、代码/页面复制、Markdown 与 llms.txt。
items.en: Added local full-text search, language and theme switching, code/page copying, Markdown, and llms.txt.

items.zh: 记录 TXT builder、CSV 数值类型、图分类边特征和 X-User-ID 身份校验的当前限制。
items.en: Documented current limits around the TXT builder, CSV numeric types, graph-classification edge features, and X-User-ID identity validation.

items.zh: 提供 Cloudflare Workers Static Assets 发布配置和独立文档 CI。
items.en: Added Cloudflare Workers Static Assets configuration and a separate documentation CI workflow.
